Pachhī Madhyāhn same Shrījī Mahārāje sarve nānā nānā vidyārthī sādhune potānī samīpe bolāvyā ane em kahyu je, “Tame sarve vidyārthī mane prashna pūchho.” Pachhī Moṭā Shivānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Jene Bhagwānno achaḷ nishchay hoy te kem oḷakhāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene achaḷ nishchay hoy tene Bhagwān sārī kriyā kare athavā narasī kriyā kare te sarve kalyāṇkārī bhāse; ane Bhagwān jīte athavā hāre; athavā koīk ṭhekāṇe bhāge; athavā kyārek rājī thāy, kyārek shok kare; ityādik anant prakārnī Bhagwānnī kriyāo tene joīne nishchayvāḷo bhakta hoy te em kahe je, ‘Prabhunī sarva kriyā kalyāṇne arthe chhe.’ Te jyāre bole tyāre evu ne evu bolato hoy, to tene paripakva nishchayvāḷo jāṇavo.”

Pachhī Nirmānānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Bhagwān ane Bhagwānnā Sant tene viṣhe doṣhbuddhi na āve teno sho upāy chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jevo pratham kahyo evo Bhagwānno achaḷ nishchay[315] hoy to tene koī rīte Bhagwānne viṣhe doṣhbuddhi āve nahī; ane evā moṭā je Bhagwān tenā dāsno mahimā jyāre vichāre tyāre Bhagwānnā bhaktano paṇ koī rīte avaguṇ āve nahī.”

Pachhī Nirmānānand Swāmī ane Nānā Pragnānānand Swāmī e bee maḷīne pūchhyu je, “Jāgrat, swapna ane suṣhupti e traṇe avasthāne viṣhe Bhagwānnī mūrti akhanḍ kem jaṇāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Pūrvajanmano koīk shubh-sanskār[316] baliṣhṭh hoy tene Bhagwānnī mūrti traṇe avasthāmā akhanḍ dekhāy chhe; athavā bhay, kām ane sneh e traṇ jene viṣhe akhanḍ hoy tene Bhagwān vinā bījo padārth hoy te paṇ traṇ avasthāmā akhanḍ dekhāy chhe, to Bhagwān dekhāy emā shu kahevu? E to dekhāy ja.”

Pachhī Nānā Shivānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Satsangne viṣhe achaḷ pāyo jeno hoy te kem jaṇāy? Ek to e prashna chhe ane bījo prashna e chhe je, mān, kām, krodh, lobh, mad, matsar ane īrṣhyā ityādik je shatru te kaye prakāre karīne nāsh pāme chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene satsangno ati draḍh pakṣh hoy te jyāre koī satsangnu ghasātu bole tyāre khamī shake nahī. Jem potānā kuṭumbī hoy ne te sāthe kachavāṇ thaī hoy toy paṇ jyāre tenu ghasātu bole tyāre khamāy nahī; evī rīte jevo dehnā sambandhīno pakṣh chhe tevo jene satsangno pakṣh hoy teno pāyo satsangne viṣhe achaḷ chhe. Ane bījā prashnano e uttar chhe je, jene evo satsangno pakṣh chhe, te sant athavā satsangī te sangāthe mān, matsar, īrṣhyā kem rākhī shake? Māṭe jene satsangno pakṣh hoy tenā mān, mad, matsar, īrṣhyā ādik sarva shatruno nāsh thaī jāy chhe. Ane jene satsangīno pakṣh na hoy ane satsangī ne kusangīne viṣhe samabhāv hoy to game tevo satsangmā moṭo kahevāto hoy paṇ ante jatā jarūr vimukh thāy.”

Pachhī Nānā Ātmānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Bhagwān ane Bhagwānnā sant te koīkne to nidhaḍak thaīne jem kahevu ghaṭe tem kahe chhe ane tenī korno em bharūso āve chhe je, ‘Ānu mān karīshu athavā tiraskār karīshu toy paṇ koī rīte e pāchho nahī paḍe;’ evo je bharūso te Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā santne kem āve? Ek to e prashna chhe. Ane bījo prashna e chhe je, je santne pāse rahetā hoīe tene jevu āpaṇā upar het hoy tevu samagra santne kem rahe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jevo Shivānand Swāmīnā prashnano uttar karyo chhe tevo satsangno jene draḍh pakṣh hoy to tene kahetā-sāmbhaḷtā Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā santne sanshay thāy nahī ane eno koī rīte kuvishvās āve nahī je, ‘Āne kaheshu to ā satsangmāthī jato raheshe.’ Tenī korno draḍh vishvās ja hoy je, ‘Eno satsang to achaḷ chhe, māṭe ene kaheshu tenī kāī fikar nathī.’ Ane bījā prashnano uttar e chhe je, jene pāse pote pratham raheto hoy ane tene sāthe potāne na banyu tyāre bījā pāse jaīne rahe, to paṇ jene pāse pratham rahyo hoy tenu jo koīk ghasātu bole to khamī shake nahī, tyāre sarve santne em samajāy je, ‘Ā to kṛutaghnī nathī, jene pāse chār akṣhar bhaṇyo chhe teno guṇ mūkato nathī māṭe bahu rūḍo sādhu chhe,’ em jāṇīne sarve santne het rahe. Ane jenī pāse pratham rahyo hoy tene mūkīne bījā pāse jāy tyāre pratham jenī pāse rahyo hoy tenī nindā kare, tyāre sarve santne em jaṇāy je, ‘Ā kṛutaghnī puruṣh chhe, te jyāre āpaṇī sāthe nahī bane tyāre āpaṇī paṇ nindā karashe,’ pachhī te upar koīne het rahe nahī.”

Pachhī Daharānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Bhagwān to Akṣharātīt chhe ane man-vāṇī thakī par chhe ane sarvane agochar chhe, te sarvane pratyakṣh dekhāy chhe teno sho hetu chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Akṣharātīt ne man-vāṇī thakī par ne agochar evā je Bhagwān te ja pote kṛupā karīne em dhāre chhe je, ‘Gnānī-agnānī evā je Mṛutyuloknā manuṣhya te sarve mane dekho,’ em dhārīne satyasankalp evā je Bhagwān te kṛupāe karīne Mṛutyuloknā sarve manuṣhya dekhe evā thāy chhe.”

Pachhī Tyāgānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Bhagwān rājī kem thāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene Bhagwānne rājī karavā hoy tene to dehnā sukhne ichchhavu nahī ane darshanno paṇ lobh rākhavo nahī ne Bhagwān jem kahe tem karavu; e ja Bhagwānne rājī thayānu sādhan chhe.”

Pachhī Lakṣhmaṇānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā santno je samāgam te āshcharya sarakho kem samajīe tyāre jaṇāy? Ane āṭhe pahor ‘aho aho’ sarakhu kem rahe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Je bhakta em samaje je, ‘Ā Bhagwān ne ā Sant te sarve Vaikunṭh, Golok ane Brahmapur tenā nivāsī chhe. Te Sant ne Parameshvar jyā virājmān chhe tyā ja e sarve dhām chhe ane e sant bheḷo māro nivās thayo chhe te māru ati baḍu bhāgya chhe.’ Evī rīte samaje to āṭhe pahor āshcharya sarakhu rahe ane āṭhe pahor ānandnā samudramā zīlato rahe.”

Pachhī Paramātmānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Santnā Ekādash Skandhmā je trīs lakṣhaṇ[317] kahyā chhe, te sho upāy kare to āve?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Je trīs lakṣhaṇe yukta Sant hoy tene viṣhe gurubuddhi ne devbuddhi rākhīne man-karma-vachane eno sang kare, to e sangnā karanārāne viṣhe paṇ e trīs lakṣhaṇ āve chhe. Evī rīte sarva shāstramā kahyu chhe je, ‘Santne seve tyāre sant sarakho thāy chhe.’”

Pachhī Shāntānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Ek to akhanḍ Bhagwānnā swarūpmā vṛutti rākhato hoy ane bījo to Bhagwānnu bhajan-smaraṇ paṇ kare ane kathā-kīrtan paṇ kare ne sāmbhaḷe; e be prakārnā je Bhagwānnā bhakta temā kyo shreṣhṭh chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene nirvikalp samādhi[318] thatī hoy ane dehnī khabar rahe nahī evo hoy to te kathā-kīrtan na kare to paṇ shreṣhṭh chhe. Ane jene dehnī khabar rahetī hoy ne bhajanmāthī potānī meḷe ūṭhīne khāvu, pīvu, dehnī kriyā, te sarve karato hoy ane jo Bhagwānnī kathā-kīrtan na kare ne na sāmbhaḷe, to te thakī Bhagwānnī kathā-kīrtan karato hoy ne sāmbhaḷato hoy te shreṣhṭh chhe.”

Pachhī Ādhārānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Kevī rīte vartīe to Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā Sant prasanna thāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Panch vartamān sampūrṇa rākhīe ne temā koī rīte khoṭ āvavā daīe nahī, to Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā Sant prasanna thāy chhe emā leshmātra sanshay nathī.”

Pachhī Vedāntānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Jeṇe pratham kāīk gobaru vartāṇu hoy, pachhī te sho upāy kare tyāre tenī upar Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā Sant rājī thāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Je potāmā bhūnḍo swabhāv hoy tene dekhīne Bhagwān ane Bhagwānnā Sant kurājī thatā hoy, te swabhāv sāthe jyāre vair karīe tyāre jene je sāthe vair hoy te to sarva jagat jāṇe evu hoy, te Santne paṇ khabar paḍe. Pachhī Sant to te swabhāvnā vairī chhe, te āpaṇā pakṣhmā bhaḷīne ane āpaṇī upar dayā kare ane je prakāre te swabhāvne jītīe evo upāy batāve. Māṭe je swabhāve potāne fajet karyo hoy, te swabhāv sāthe sūdhu draḍh vair bāndhīne tenu mūḷ ūkhaḍī jāy evo upāy karavo. Ane jyāre evī rīte vartīe tyāre Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā Sant āpaṇā upar pūrṇa dayā kare. Ane jyāre Harinī ne Harijannī je upar dayā thāy tyāre tenā haiyāmā atishay sukh vartyā kare ane kalyāṇne mārge chālyānī paṇ sāmarthī vadhe ane potānā shatru je kām, krodh, lobhādik tenu baḷ ghaṭī jāy chhe. Māṭe je potānā hṛudayne viṣhe atishay shatru pīḍato hoy te sāthe atishay vair karīe to tenī Parameshvar sahāy kare chhe. Māṭe potānā shatru je kāmādik te sāthe jarūr vair karavu ghaṭe chhe. Ne potānā antahshatru sāthe vair karyāmā ghaṇo ja lābh chhe.”

Pachhī Bhagwadānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “He Mahārāj! Jevī Bhagwānnī bīk pāse beṭhā hoīe ne rahe chhe, tevī ne tevī bīk chheṭe jaīe to paṇ rahe; te kem samajīe to rahe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jevī pāse Bhagwānnī maryādā rahe chhe tevī chheṭe jāy toy paṇ rahe, jo Bhagwānnu pūru māhātmya samaje to. Te māhātmya em samajavu je, ‘Akṣharātīt evā je Puruṣhottam Bhagwān tenī ichchhāe karīne anant koṭi brahmānḍnī utpatti thāy chhe ane te brahmānḍne potānī shaktie karīne dharī rahyā chhe. Ane te Bhagwān vyatirek thakā sarvamā anvaypaṇe rahyā chhe ane anvay thakā paṇ vyatirek chhe. Ane Bhagwān jevā pratyakṣh pramāṇ chhe tevā ne tevā aṇu-aṇu pratye antaryāmīrūpe virājmān chhe. Ane te Bhagwānnā ḍolāvyā vinā ek tṛuṇ paṇ ḍolavāne samarth nathī. Ane anant koṭi brahmānḍne viṣhe je utpatti, sthiti, pralay thāy chhe ane tene viṣhe sukh-dukhno jīvone sambandh thāy chhe, te sarve Puruṣhottam Bhagwānnā hāthmā chhe. Jeṭalu Bhagwān kare teṭalu ja thāy chhe. Evā je Bhagwān te jīvonā kalyāṇne arthe pṛuthvī upar padhāre chhe, tyāre pote ghoḍe chaḍīne chāle tyāre ghoḍo Bhagwānne upāḍī chāle chhe, paṇ e to ghoḍānā ādhār chhe. Ane pṛuthvī upar beṭhā hoy tyāre em jaṇāy je, pṛuthvī Bhagwānne dharī rahī chhe, paṇ e to sthāvar-jangam sahit samagra pṛuthvīne dharī rahyā chhe. Ane jyāre rātri hoy tyāre chandramā ke dīvo ke mashāl tene ajavāḷe karīne Bhagwānnu darshan thāy ane divase sūryane ajavāḷe karīne darshan thāy, paṇ e Bhagwān to sūrya, chandramā, agni e sarvane prakāshnā dātā chhe. Evī adbhut sāmarthī chhe, to paṇ jīvonā kalyāṇne arthe manuṣhya jevā thaīne mane darshan āpe chhe.’ Evī rīte māhātmya samaje to jevī pāse rahye maryādā rahe chhe, tevī ne tevī chheṭe jāy toy paṇ rahe.”

Pachhī vaḷī Bhagwadānand Swāmīe bījo prashna pūchhyo je, “Bhagwānnā karyā vinā kāī thatu nathī, sarve Bhagwānnu ja karyu thāy chhe; tyāre Bhagwānne athavā Bhagwānnā bhaktane kāīk jyāre bhūnḍo deshkāḷ āve chhe tyāre te dukhne kem Bhagwān ṭāḷatā nathī ane tene ṭāḷyānā mansūbā kem kare chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “E to jyāre Bhagwān manuṣhya deh dhāraṇ kare chhe tyāre Bhagwānnī evī rīti ja chhe je, manuṣhyanī peṭhe sarve vyavahār kare, paṇ alaukik sāmarthīne pragaṭ kare nahī. Evī rīte sarva shāstramā Bhagwānnā charitra kahyā chhe; tethī jyāre Bhagwān kāīk navā charitra kare tyāre sanshay karajyo, paṇ jyā sudhī pūrve avatār thayā chhe tenā jevā charitra kare tyā sudhī to sanshay karavo nahī.”

Pachhī Nirmaḷānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Kem samajīe tyāre Prabhunā Santno mahimā atishay jaṇāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Matsya, Kachchh, Varāh, Vāman, Parshurām ane Rām-Kṛuṣhṇādik e je Bhagwānnā anant avatār teno mahimā vichāre je, ‘Je Bhagwāne Rām-Kṛuṣhṇādik avatāre karīne anant jīvono uddhār karyo chhe te Bhagwānnā ā Sant chhe, teno māre samāgam maḷyo chhe, te māṭe hu paṇ ati baḍbhāgī chhu.’ Em samaje to divase divase santno mahimā atishay jaṇāto jāy.”

Pachhī Nārāyaṇānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Sthūḷ, sūkṣhma ane kāraṇ e traṇ dehne viṣhe jīv anvaypaṇe kem chhe ne vyatirekpaṇe kem chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jyāre dehne viṣhe sukh-dukhno yog thāy chhe tyāre te sukh-dukhne jīv potāne viṣhe māne tyāre te jīv anvaypaṇe chhe ane jyāre traṇe dehnā sukh-dukhthī potāne nyāro samaje tyāre e jīv vyatirek chhe.”

Pachhī Shūnyātītānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Jyāre satsang kare chhe tyāre to santmā ne satsangīmā atishay het hoy ane pachhī kem ochhu thaī jāy chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Pratham to ene santne viṣhe alaukik mati hoy ane pachhī to te santno alp doṣh joīne potānī kubuddhie karīne zāzo doṣh paraṭhe chhe. Pachhī enī asadvāsanā thaī jāy chhe, teṇe karīne santne viṣhe ochho bhāv thaī jāy chhe. Te jo vichārīne asadvāsanāne ṭāḷe to pratham hato tevo shuddha thāy; ane jo asadvāsanā na ṭāḷe to ante jatā vimukh thaī jāy chhe.”
Pachhī Prasādānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Jīvne mokṣhano sho hetu chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jem Sant kahe tem ja sanshayrahit thako kare, e ja jīvne mokṣhano hetu chhe.”

Pachhī Triguṇātītānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Desh, kāḷ, kriyā, sang tenu viṣhampaṇu hoy tyāre tyā sho upāy karavo?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Deshādik viṣham hoy tyā to ūgaryāno e ja upāy chhe je, tyāthī je te prakāre karīne bhāgī chhūṭavu.”

Pachhī Nānā Nirvikārānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Bhagwānno nishchay chhe to paṇ asadvāsanā kem ṭaḷatī nathī?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Bhagwānnu māhātmya yathārth jāṇyu nathī eṭale asadvāsanā ṭaḷatī nathī.”

Pachhī Moṭā Yogānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Bhagwānno nishchay paripūrṇa chhe, to paṇ Bhagwānne viṣhe ne Bhagwānnī kathāne viṣhe het kem thatu nathī?” pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Bhagwānnu jevu māhātmya chhe tevu ene samajyāmā āvyu nathī, ane jo yathārth Bhagwānnu māhātmya samajāy to Bhagwān vinā bījāmā het rākhe to paṇ rahe nahī ne ek Bhagwān ane Bhagwānnā Sant ane Bhagwānnī kathā-kīrtan tene viṣhe ja achaḷ het thāy chhe.”

Pachhī Pratoṣhānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Bhagwānnī bhakti achaḷ kem rahe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Aniruddha, Pradyumna, Sankarṣhaṇ ane Vāsudev e je Chaturvyūh tathā Keshavādik chovīs mūrtio tathā Varāhādik je avatār e sarvenā kāraṇ evā je pratyakṣh Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Puruṣhottam Bhagwān teno mahimā atishaypaṇe karīne samaje to tene Bhagwānnī shravaṇādik je navadhā bhakti te achaḷ rahe.”

Evī rīte sarva Muninā prashnano uttar karīne pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj sarvene pūchhatā havā je, “Kām, krodh ane lobh e traṇ naraknā dvār chhe, emāthī jene je atishay jītyāmā āvyo hoy te sarve kaho.” Pachhī jene je vātnī atishay draḍhatā hatī te tevī rīte bolyā. Te Muninā vachan sāmbhaḷīne Shrījī Mahārāj atishay rājī thayā. Ane Ātmānand Swāmī tathā Yogānand Swāmī tathā Bhagwadānand Swāmī tathā Shivānand Swāmī e chār jaṇāne rājī thaīne hṛudayne viṣhe charaṇārvind dīdhā ane em bolyā je, “Jem Mahānubhāvānand Swāmī ādik je moṭerā chhe, te bheḷā ā chār paṇ chhe; māṭe emanu koīne apamān karavā desho mā.” Em Muktānand Swāmī ādik je moṭerā sādhu temane bhalāmaṇ karīne Shrījī Mahārāj ‘Jay Sachchidānand’ kahīne potāne utāre jamavā padhāryā.
૩૧૪. તત્ત્વાર્થસૂત્ર, ઉત્તરાધ્યયનસૂત્ર, ગણધરગાથા વગેરે શાસ્ત્રોમાં.
૩૧૫. માહાત્મ્યજ્ઞાનપૂર્વક.
૩૧૬. પૂર્વજન્મમાં સંપાદન કરેલી પ્રેમપૂર્વક નવધા ભક્તિરૂપી ભાવના.

૩૧૭. ૧. કૃપાલુ - સ્વાર્થની અપેક્ષા વિના પારકું દુઃખ સહન ન થાય તે અથવા પરદુઃખ ટાળવાની ઇચ્છાવાળો. ૨. સર્વદેહિનામ્ અકૃતદ્રોહ - સર્વદેહીઓમાં મિત્રાદિભાવ છે માટે કોઈનો પણ દ્રોહ નહિ કરનાર. ૩. તિતિક્ષુ - દ્વન્દ્વને સહન કરનાર. ૪. સત્યસાર - સત્યને જ એક બળ માનનાર. ૫. અનવદ્યાત્મા - દ્વેષ-અસૂયા આદિ દોષથી રહિત મનવાળો. ૬. સમ - સર્વમાં સમદૃષ્ટિવાળો. ૭. સર્વોપકારક - સર્વને ઉપકાર જ કરનાર. ૮. કામૈરહતધી - વિષય-ભોગથી બુદ્ધિમાં ક્ષોભ નહિ પામનાર. ૯. દાન્ત - ઇન્દ્રિયોનું દમન કરનાર. ૧૦. મૃદુ - મૃદુ ચિત્તવાળો. ૧૧. શુચિ - બાહ્ય અને આન્તર શુદ્ધિવાળો, તેમાં સ્નાન વગેરેથી થતી બાહ્ય શુદ્ધિ અને ભગવાનનાં ચિંતનથી થતી આન્તર શુદ્ધિ કહી છે. ૧૨. અકિંચન - અન્ય પ્રયોજને રહિત. ૧૩. અનીહ - લૌકિક વ્યાપારે રહિત કોઈ પણ પ્રકારની ઇચ્છાએ રહિત. ૧૪. મિતભુક્ - મિતાહાર કરનાર. ૧૫. શાન્ત - અંતઃકરણ જેનું નિયમમાં છે. ૧૬. સ્થિર - સ્થિરચિત્તવાળો. ૧૭. મચ્છરણ - હું જ શરણ (રક્ષિતા અને પ્રાપ્તિનો ઉપાય) જેને છે. ૧૮. મુનિ - શુભાશ્રયનું મનન કરનાર. ૧૯. અપ્રમત્ત - સાવધાન. ૨૦. ગભીરાત્મા - જેનો અભિપ્રાય જાણી શકાય નહિ તે. ૨૧. ધૃતિમાન્ - આપત્કાળમાં ધૈર્યવાળો. ૨૨. જિતષડ્ગુણ - ભૂખ, તરસ, શોક, મોહ, જરા, મૃત્યુ એ છ દ્વંદ્વોને જીતનાર. ૨૩. અમાની - પોતાના દેહના સત્કારની અભિલાષા નહિ રાખનાર. ૨૪. માનદ - બીજાઓને માન આપનાર. ૨૫. કલ્પ - હિતોપદેશ કરવામાં સમર્થ. ૨૬. મૈત્ર - કોઈને નહિ ઠગનારો. ૨૭. કારુણિક - કરુણાથી જ પ્રવર્તનારો, પણ સ્વાર્થ કે લોભથી નહિ. ૨૮. કવિ - જીવ, ઈશ્વર, માયા, બ્રહ્મ અને પરબ્રહ્મ - આ પાંચ તત્ત્વોને યથાર્થ જાણનાર. ૨૯. આજ્ઞાયૈવં ગુણાન્ દોષાન્ મયાદિષ્ટાનપિ સ્વકાન્। ધર્માન્ સન્ત્યજ્ય યઃ સર્વાન્ માં ભજેત સ સત્તમઃ॥ - મેં વેદ દ્વારા ઉપદેશ કરેલા ગુણદોષોને જાણીને, પોતાના સર્વ ધર્મોનો ફળ દ્વારા ત્યાગ કરીને, મને સર્વભાવથી ભજનાર. ૩૦. જ્ઞાત્વાજ્ઞાત્વાઽથ યે વૈ માં યાવાન્ યશ્ચાસ્મિ યાદૃશઃ।
ભજન્ત્યનન્યભાવેન તે મે ભક્તતમા મતાઃ॥ - હું જેવા સ્વરૂપવાળો છું, જેવા સ્વભાવવાળો છું અને જેટલી વિભૂતિવાળો છું, તેવી રીતે જાણી જાણીને એટલે વારંવાર વિચાર કરીને અનન્યભાવથી મારી ભક્તિ કરનાર. એવી રીતે સાધુનાં ત્રીસ લક્ષણ કહ્યાં છે. (શ્રીમદ્‎‍ભાગવત: ૧૧/૧૧/૨૯-૩૩).
૩૧૮. નિર્વિકલ્પ સમાધિનું નિરૂપણ વચનામૃત ગ. પ્ર. ૪૦ તથા તેની ટીપણીમાંથી જાણવું.
314. Tattvārtha-sūtra, Uttarādhyayana-sūtra, Gaṇdhargāthā vagere shāstromā.
315. Māhātmya-gnān-pūrvak.
316. Pūrva-janmamā sampādan karelī prem-pūrvak navadhā bhaktirūpī bhāvanā.

317. 1. Kṛupālu - svārthnī apekṣhā vinā pāraku dukh sahan na thāy te athavā pardukh ṭāḷavānī ichchhāvāḷo. 2. Sarvadehinām akṛut-droh - sarva-dehīomā mitrādibhāv chhe māṭe koīno paṇ droh nahi karanār. 3. Titikṣhu - dvandvane sahan karanār. 4. Satyasār - satyane ja ek baḷ mānnār. 5. Anavadyātmā - dveṣh-asūyā ādi doṣhthī rahit manvāḷo. 6. Sam - sarvamā sam-draṣhṭivāḷo. 7. Sarvopkārak - sarvane upakār ja karanār. 8. Kāmairahatadhī - viṣhay-bhogthī buddhimā kṣhobh nahi pāmnār. 9. Dānt - indriyonu daman karanār. 10. Mṛudu - mṛudu chittavāḷo. 11. Shuchi - bāhya ane āntar shuddhivāḷo, temā snān vagerethī thatī bāhya shuddhi ane Bhagwānnā chintanthī thatī āntar shuddhi kahī chhe. 12. Akinchan - anya prayojane rahit. 13. Anīh - laukik vyāpāre rahit koī paṇ prakārnī ichchhāe rahit. 14. Mitbhuk - mitāhār karanār. 15. Shānt - antahkaraṇ jenu niyammā chhe. 16. Sthir - sthir-chittavāḷo. 17. Machchharaṇ - hu ja sharaṇ (rakṣhitā ane prāptino upāy) jene chhe. 18. Muni - shubhāshraynu manan karanār. 19. Apramatta - sāvadhān. 20. Gabhīrātmā - jeno abhiprāy jāṇī shakāy nahi te. 21. Dhṛutimān - āpatkāḷmā dhairyavāḷo. 22. Jitṣhaḍguṇ - bhūkh, taras, shok, moh, jarā, mṛutyu e chha dvandvone jītnār. 23. Amānī - potānā dehnā satkārnī abhilāṣhā nahi rākhnār. 24. Mānad - bījāone mān āpanār. 25. Kalp - hitopdesh karavāmā samarth. 26. Maitra - koīne nahi ṭhagnāro. 27. Kāruṇik - karuṇāthī ja pravartnāro, paṇ svārth ke lobhthī nahi. 28. Kavi - jīv, īshvar, māyā, Brahma ane Parabrahma - ā pāch tattvone yathārth jāṇnār. 29. Āgnāyaivam guṇān doṣhān mayādiṣhṭānapi swakān | Dharmān santyajya yah sarvān mām bhajet - me Ved dvārā updesh karelā guṇ-doṣhone jāṇīne, potānā sarva dharmono faḷ dvārā tyāg karīne, mane sarva-bhāvthī bhajanār. 30. Gnātvā gnātvā’tha ye vai mām yāvān yashchāsmi yādrashah || Bhajantyananyabhāven - hu jevā swarūpvāḷo chhu, jevā swabhāvvāḷo chhu ane jeṭalī vibhūtivāḷo chhu, tevī rīte jāṇī jāṇīne eṭale vāramvār vichār karīne ananyabhāvthī mārī bhakti karanār. Evī rīte sādhunā trīs lakṣhaṇ kahyā chhe. (Shrīmad-Bhāgwat: 11/11/29-33).
318. Nirvikalp samādhinu nirūpaṇ Vachanāmṛut G. Pra. 40 tathā tenī ṭīpaṇīmāthī jāṇavu.
79: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 5 Panchamīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “‘Jitam jagat ken mano hi yena’[1] e shlokmā em kahyu chhe je, jeṇe potānu man jītyu teṇe sarva jagat jītyu; te man jītyu kem jaṇāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Shabda, sparsh, rūp, ras ane gandh e je panch-viṣhay temāthī jyāre indriyo pāchhī haṭhe ane koī viṣhay pāmavānī ichchhā rahe nahī tyāre sarve indriyo vash thāy chhe. Ane jyāre indriyo viṣhayno sparsh ja na kare tyāre man paṇ indriyo lagaṇ āve nahī ane haiyāmā ne haiyāmā rahe. Evī rīte jene panch-viṣhayno tyāg ati draḍhpaṇe karīne thayo tyāre tenu man jītyu jāṇavu. Ane jo viṣhay upar kāī prīti hoy to man jītyu hoy to paṇ jītyu na jāṇavu.”

Pachhī vaḷī Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Viṣhaynī nivṛutti thayānu kāraṇ te vairāgya chhe ke Parameshvarne viṣhe prīti chhe?”[2] Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ek to viṣhaynī nivṛuttinu kāraṇ ātmaniṣhṭhā chhe ane bīju māhātmye sahit je Bhagwānnu gnān te chhe. Temā ātmaniṣhṭhā[3] to evī rītnī joīe je, ‘Hu chaitanya chhu ne deh jaḍ chhe, ane hu shuddha chhu ne deh narakrūp chhe, ane hu avināshī chhu ne deh nāshvant chhe, ane hu ānandrūp chhu ne deh dukhrūp chhe.’ Evī rīte jyāre deh thakī potānā ātmāne sarva prakāre atishay vilakṣhaṇ samaje, tyāre dehne potānu rūp mānīne viṣhaymā prīti kare ja nahī. Evī rīte ātmagnāne karīne viṣhaynī nivṛutti thāy chhe. Ane Bhagwānno mahimā em vichāre je, ‘Hu ātmā chhu ane je pratyakṣh Bhagwān maḷyā chhe te Paramātmā chhe. Ane Golok, Vaikunṭh, Shvetdvīp tathā Brahmapur tathā anant koṭi brahmānḍnā pati je Brahmādik dev, e sarvanā Swāmī je Shrī Puruṣhottam Bhagwān te mane pratyakṣh maḷyā chhe ane te mārā ātmāne viṣhe paṇ akhanḍ virājmān chhe. Ane te Bhagwānnu je ek nimiṣhmātranu darshan te upar anant koṭi brahmānḍnā je viṣhaysukh chhe te sarvene vārīferīne nākhī deīe ane Bhagwānnā ek rommā jeṭalu sukh rahyu chhe teṭalu sukh jo anant koṭi brahmānḍnā viṣhaysukh bheḷā karīe to paṇ tenā koṭimā bhāgnī barobar paṇ thāy nahī. Ane je Bhagwānnu Akṣhardhām chhe tenī āgaḷ bījā je devatānā lok chhe, tene Mokṣhadharmane viṣhe narak tulya kahyā chhe.[4] Evā je Bhagwān te mane prakaṭ maḷyā chhe. Tene mūkīne naraknā kunḍ jevā je viṣhaynā sukh tene hu shu ichchhu? Ane viṣhay sukh to kevaḷ dukhrūp ja chhe.’ Evī rīte Bhagwānnu māhātmya jāṇave karīne viṣhaynī nivṛutti thāy chhe. Ane evī rīte je ātmagnān ane Paramātmānu gnān temāthī je vairāgya prakaṭe te vairāgye karīne sarva viṣhaysukhnī vāsanānī nivṛutti thaī jāy chhe. Ane jeṇe evī rīte samajīne viṣhaysukhno tyāg karyo tene pāchhī viṣhaymā prīti thāy ja nahī. Ane enu ja man jitāṇu kahevāy. Ane evī samajaṇ vinā zāzu het jaṇātu hoy, paṇ jyāre koīk sārā viṣhaynī prāpti thāy tyāre Bhagwānne paḍyā mūkīne viṣhaymā prīti kare athavā putra-kaltrādikne viṣhe prīti kare; athavā rogādik sambandhī pīḍā thāy athavā panch-viṣhaynu sukh hoy te maṭī jāy, tyāre Bhagwānne viṣhe prīti rahe nahī ane vikaḷ jevo thaī jāy. Ane jem kūtarānu galūḍiyu hoy te paṇ nānu hoy tyāre sāru dīse, tem evānī bhakti pratham sārī dīse paṇ ante shobhe nahī.”[5]
1. जितं जगत् केन मनो हि येन॥

૩. જેનામાં આત્મનિષ્ઠા આવે છે તેનામાં વૈરાગ્ય પણ સહજે જ આવી જાય છે અને જેને માહાત્મ્યજ્ઞાન સિદ્ધ થાય છે તેનામાં સ્વધર્મ અને પ્રીતિ પણ આવી જાય છે; માટે તમે કહેલાં વૈરાગ્યાદિ ત્રણ સાધનની અપેક્ષાએ આત્મનિષ્ઠા અને માહાત્મ્યજ્ઞાન તે જ વિષયની નિવૃત્તિ થવામાં અતિ ઉત્કૃષ્ટ સાધન છે.
૪. “એતે વૈ નિરયાસ્તાત સ્થાનસ્ય પરમાત્મનઃ” (મહાભારત, શાંતિપર્વ: ૧૯૧/૬) આ શ્લોકથી કહ્યું છે.
૫. આત્મનિષ્ઠા અને માહાત્મ્યજ્ઞાન વગરનો સ્વધર્મ પણ શોભે નહિ એમ પણ જાણી લેવું.

3. Jenāmā ātmaniṣhṭhā āve chhe tenāmā vairāgya paṇ sahaje ja āvī jāy chhe ane jene māhātmya-gnān siddha thāy chhe tenāmā swadharma ane prīti paṇ āvī jāy chhe; māṭe tame kahelā vairāgyādi traṇ sādhannī apekṣhāe ātmaniṣhṭhā ane māhātmya-gnān te ja viṣhaynī nivṛutti thavāmā ati utkṛuṣhṭ sādhan chhe.
4. “Ete vai nirayāstāt sthānasya paramātmanah” (Mahābhārat, Shāntiparva: 191/6) ā shlokthī kahyu chhe.
5. Ātmaniṣhṭhā ane māhātmya-gnān vagarno swadharma paṇ shobhe nahi em paṇ jāṇī levu.
80: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 6 Chhaṭhne divas Shrījī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarī upar ḍholiyo bichhāvyo hato te upar uttarāde mukhārvinde virājmān hatā ne shvet pāgh mastak upar bāndhī hatī ne shvet pachheḍī oḍhī hatī tathā shvet khes paheryo hato ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj muni pratye bolyā je, “Māhomāhī prashna-utar karo.” Pachhī Swayamprakāshānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Bhagwānnā bhaktane Bhagwānnī mūrtimā[6] atishay het kaye prakāre thāy?” Pachhī te prashnano uttar Munie māhomāhī karavā mānḍyo paṇ thayo nahī. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje teno uttar karavā mānḍyo je, “Sneh to rūpe karīne paṇ thāy chhe tathā kāme karīne paṇ thāy chhe tathā lobhe karīne paṇ thāy chhe tathā svārthe karīne paṇ thāy chhe tathā guṇe karīne paṇ thāy chhe. Temā rūpe karīne je sneh thāy chhe te to jyāre tenā dehmā pitta nīsare athavā koḍh nīsare tyāre sneh thayo hoy te nāsh pāme chhe; tem ja lobh, kām ane svārthe karīne je het thayu hoy te paṇ[7] ante nāsh pāme chhe ane je guṇe karīne[8] sneh thayo hoy te to ante rahe chhe.” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj pratye Somalo Khāchar bolyā je, “E te guṇ kayā? uparlā[9] ke māhīlā?”[10] Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Uparle guṇe shu thāy?[11] E to vachane karīne, dehe karīne ane mane karīne je guṇ hoy ane te guṇe karīne je het thayu hoy te nathī nāsh pāmatu. Ane tame pūchho chho te bhaktane Bhagwān upar sneh thāy em ja kevaḷ pūchho chho? Ke Bhagwānne bhakta upar sneh thāy em paṇ pūchho chho?” Tyāre Svāyamprakāshānand Swāmī bolyā, “E beyne pūchhīe chhīe.”

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje tenī vistāre karīne vārtā karavā mānḍī je, “Vachane karīne to koī jīv-prāṇīmātrane dukhavavā nahī. Ane Parameshvar sāthe athavā Moṭā Sant sāthe prashna-uttar karatā hoīe ane temā paraspar vād-vivād thato hoy ane temā pote jītīe em jaṇāy, to paṇ je moṭāthī nāno hoy tene moṭānī samīpe namī devu; ane āpaṇ karatā Moṭā Sant hoy te sabhāmā prashna-uttare karīne bhoṭhā paḍe em karavu nahī, Moṭā Sant āgaḷ ane Parameshvar āgaḷ to jarūr hārī javu. Ane Parameshvar tathā Moṭā Sant te potāne koī vachan yogya kahe athavā ayogya kahe, tyāre te vachanne tatkāḷ snehe sahit mānavu. Temā yogya vachan hoy temā to āshankā thāy nahī, paṇ koī ayogya vachan kahyu hoy ane temā āshankā thāy evu hoy to paṇ te samāne viṣhe nā pāḍavī nahī, e to hā ja pāḍavī ane em kahevu je, ‘He Mahārāj! Jem tame kahesho tem hu karīsh.’ Ane te vachan potāne manāy nahī evu hoy, to Parameshvar tathā Moṭā Sant tenī marajī hoy to temane hāth joḍīne bhaktie sahit em kahevu je, ‘He Mahārāj! Tame je vachan kahyu te to ṭhīk chhe, paṇ āṭalī mane temā āshankā thāy chhe.’ E prakārnu dīn thaīne vachan kahevu. Ane jo Parameshvarnī marajī na hoy to temane samīpe rahetā hoy je Moṭā Sant tathā haribhakta temane āgaḷ kahevu je, ‘Āvī rīte Parameshvare vachan kahyu chhe, te to mane mānyāmā āvatu nathī.’ Pachhī tenu Moṭā Sant samādhān kare tathā Parameshvar āgaḷ kahīne e vachannu samādhān karāve, paṇ Parameshvare vachan ayogya ke yogya kahyu hoy te same nā pāḍavī nahī. Evī rītnī yuktie moṭānā vachanne pāchhu ṭhelavu, paṇ kahyu ne tatkāḷ nā pāḍavī nahī. Evī rīte to vachanne guṇe karīne vartavu. Pachhī te bhaktane upar Parameshvar tathā Moṭā Sant tene sneh thāy chhe. Ane te bhaktane paṇ Bhagwānne viṣhe draḍh sneh thāy chhe.

“Have dehne guṇe kem vartavu?[12] To potānā dehmā jo kāī unmattpaṇu jaṇāy to bhajanmā besave karīne athavā chāndrāyaṇ vrate karīne dehne nirbaḷ karī nākhavu; pachhī tene dekhīne tenā dehnī Moṭā Sant athavā Parameshvar khabar rakhāve to bhale, paṇ potāne jāṇe dehnu jatan karavu nahī. Tathā dehe karīne Bhagwānnī ane Bhagwānnā bhaktanī ṭel-chākarī karavī. Evī rīte jyāre e dehne guṇe karīne varte, tyāre tene dekhīne tene upar Parameshvar ne e Moṭā Sant tene sneh thāy chhe ane e bhaktane paṇ Bhagwānne viṣhe prīti thāy chhe.

“Have manne guṇe jem vartavu[13] tenī rīt kahīe chhīe je, Parameshvarnā jyāre darshan karavā tyāre mane sahit draṣhṭine ekāgra rākhīne karavā. Ane Parameshvarnā darshan karato hoy ne tyā koī manuṣhya āvyu athavā shvān āvyu ke bīju koī pashu-pakṣhī āvyu, tyāre Parameshvarnā darshanmāthī vṛutti toḍīne āḍī-avaḷī, ūnchī-nīchī draṣhṭi karīne tenā paṇ bheḷā darshan karato jāy. Pachhī evī fāṭel draṣhṭivāḷāne Parameshvar ke Moṭā Sant dekhīne rājī thatā nathī. Ane e darshan kare chhe te kevā kare chhe? To jem anya manuṣhya kare chhe tem te paṇ kare chhe. Ane evī laukik draṣhṭivāḷo to jem khilkhoḍī bole chhe te bheḷe pūchhaḍu ūnchu kare chhe tevo jāṇavo; shā sāru je, Parameshvar bheḷe bījā darshan kare chhe. Ane evā laukik darshan jyāre e karavā mānḍe tyāre jevo pratham sāro hoy tevo rahe nahī ane te divase divase ūtarto jāy. Te māṭe Parameshvarnā darshan karatā karatā āḍī-avaḷī draṣhṭi karavī nahī. Parameshvarnā darshan to pratham pahele navīn thayā hoy ne te samayne viṣhe jevu antarmā alaukikpaṇu hoy, tevu ne tevu manmā alaukikpaṇu rahetu jāy. Ne ekdraṣhṭie karīne mūrtine jote javu ane draṣhṭi palaṭīne antarmā tevī ne tevī te mūrtine utāravī. Jem Dharmapurmā Kushaḷ Kunvarbāī hatā, te amārā darshan karatā jatā hatā ane draṣhṭi palaṭāvīne mūrtine antarmā utārtā; tem darshan to mane yukta draṣhṭine ekāgra rākhīne karavā, paṇ jem bījā darshan kare chhe tem na karavā. Ane jo Parameshvarnā darshan bheḷe bījā darshan manuṣhyanā ke kūtarā-balāḍānā kare chhe, to tene jyāre swapna thāy tyāre Parameshvar paṇ dekhāy ane te anya padārth paṇ bheḷe dekhāy. Te māṭe Parameshvarnā darshan to ekdraṣhṭie karavā, paṇ chapaḷ draṣhṭie na karavā. Ane Parameshvarnā darshan draṣhṭine niyammā rākhīne kare chhe tene e darshan navīnnā navīn rahe chhe, ane Parameshvare je je vachan kahyā hoy te paṇ tene navīnnā navīn rahe chhe. Ane laukik bāhyadraṣhṭie karīne darshan karyā hoy tene Parameshvarnā darshan tathā vachan e sarve jūnā thaī jāy chhe. Te roj darshan karyā kare, paṇ evāne to jem na thayā hoy tevā ne tevā rahe chhe. Te jyāre bhajanmā bese tyāre tenu man sthir rahe nahī, bahudhārāe yukta thāy; ane Parameshvarne dhāre tyāre te bheḷe bījā darshan je je karyā chhe te paṇ vagar dhāryā āvīne haiyāmā sfure chhe. Te māṭe darshan to ek Parameshvarnā ja karavā. Ane em je darshan kare chhe, tenu man bhajan-smaraṇ karate ek Parameshvarmā ja rahe chhe; paṇ tenī bahudhārā nathī rahetī, ek rahe chhe. Ane je chapaḷ draṣhṭie darshan kare chhe tene hu jāṇu chhu ane jenā draṣhṭi ne man niyammā hoy evā je Moṭā Sant te paṇ jāṇe je, ‘Ā to laukik darshan kare chhe,’ pachhī te laukik darshanno karanāro ā samāgammāthī divase divase ūtarto jāy chhe. Ane jem koīk kāmī puruṣh hoy tenī rūpvantī strīmā ekmane karīne draṣhṭi provāṇī hoy, te same vachamā koīk pashu-pakṣhī āve-jāy ke bole paṇ tenī tene khabar rahe nahī; evī rīte ekāgra draṣhṭie karīne Parameshvarmā joḍāvu, paṇ laukik darshan na karavā.”

Tyāre Nirvikārānand Swāmīe āshankā karī je, “He Mahārāj! Amāre to desh-deshmā manuṣhya āgaḷ vārtā karavī paḍe, teṇe karīne mannu ekāgrapaṇu rahetu nathī.” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Manuṣhya āgaḷ vārtā karavī tenī to ame āgnā āpī chhe, paṇ ahī mūrtinā darshan melīne bījā darshan karavā evī kaye divase āgnā āpī chhe?” Em kahīne vaḷī vārtā karavā lāgyā je, “Pratham jyāre mūrtinā darshan thāy chhe tyāre tene kevu alaukikpaṇu rahe chhe! Tevu ne tevu alaukikpaṇu to to rahe, jo mane sahit draṣhṭi Parameshvarmā rākhe. Evī rīte manne guṇe karīne varte[14] tyāre te bhaktane upar nitya pratye Bhagwānne navīn ne navīn het rahe chhe ane te bhaktane paṇ Bhagwānne viṣhe nitya pratye navīn ne navīn het rahe chhe. Ane vaḷī netra ne shrotra e bene to visheṣhe karīne niyammā rākhavā. Te shā sāru je, jyā-tyā grāmyavārtā thatī hoy ne tene shrotranī vṛutti dvāre taṇāī jaīne sāmbhaḷīe, to te sarve grāmya shabda bhajanmā bese tyāre sāmbharī āve chhe; ane fāṭel netranī vṛuttie karīne je je rūp joyu hoy, te sarve bhajan karatā sāmbharī āve chhe; te sāru e be indriyone to atishay niyammā rākhavā. Ane netranī ne shrotranī vṛutti jyāre mūrtinā darshan karatā hoīe ne mūrtine melīne anyamā taṇāy to tene em updesh devo je, ‘He mūrkh! Tu Bhagwānnī mūrti vinā anya rūpne jue chhe ke Parameshvarnī vārtā vinā anya vārtāne sāmbhaḷe chhe temā tane shu prāpta thashe? Ane hajī tane siddhadashā to āvī nathī je, jevu chintavyu tevu tane tatkāḷ maḷe; shā sāru je, hajī to tu sādhak chhu. Māṭe je viṣhayne tu chintavīsh te viṣhay maḷashe nahī ane ṭhālā valakhā karīne Parameshvarne shā vāste melī de chhe? Ane kāīk jo tane alp viṣhay maḷashe to tenā pāpmā Yampurīno mār khātā khātā ant nahī āve.’ Evī rīte netrane ane shrotrane upadesh devo. Ane vaḷī em kahevu je, ‘Jyāre tu Bhagwānnī mūrtimā ekāgra thaīsh to temāthī tu siddhadashāne pāmīsh. Pachhī tu je je brahmānḍmā vārtā thāy chhe tene sahaje sāmbhaḷīsh; ane Brahmā, Viṣhṇu ane Shivnā jevā rūpne ichchhīsh to tevā rūpne pāmīsh; ane Lakṣhmī ke Rādhikā jevo bhakta thavā ichchhīsh to tevo thaīsh. Ane Bhagwānnu bhajan karatā karatā siddhadashāne deh chhate nahī pāmya, to deh paḍyā pachhī mukta thaīsh tyāre siddhadashā maḷashe. Paṇ siddhadashā āvyā vinā rūpne joī joīne marī jaīsh to paṇ tane rūp maḷashe nahī ane grāmyā shabdane paṇ sāmbhaḷī sāmbhaḷīne marī jaīsh to teṇe karīne buddhi to atishay bhraṣhṭ thaī jashe, paṇ temāthī kāī prāpti nahī thāy.’ Evī rīte netrane ane shrotrane updesh daīne ek Bhagwānnī mūrtimā ja rākhavā. Ane Evī rīte je varte[15] tene Bhagwānnī mūrtimā divase divase adhik sneh thāy chhe ane te bhakta upar Parameshvar ne Moṭā Sādhune sneh hoy tethī paṇ divase divase vadhato jāy chhe.”
૬. પ્રત્યક્ષ.
૭. પોતપોતાના હેતુની સિદ્ધિ ન થતાં.
૮. ભગવાનના સત્ય-શૌચાદિક જે ગુણ તેનાં દર્શન કરીને.
૯. વ્યવહારક્રિયામાં કુશળતા વગેરે લૌકિક.
૧૦. સ્વધર્મ, જ્ઞાન, વૈરાગ્યાદિક અલૌકિક.
૧૧. તેવા ગુણ તો વિમુખમાં પણ હોય છે, પણ ભગવાનમાં તેમને સ્નેહ હોતો જ નથી; માટે તે ગુણો ભગવત્સ્નેહમાં કારણ નથી.
૧૨. ભગવાન અને તેમના એકાંતિક સાધુઓએ નિષેધ કરેલાં હિંસા, ચોરી આદિક કર્મ ક્યારેય પણ દેહથી કરવાં નહિ અને.
૧૩. ભગવાનનાં દર્શન, શ્રવણ, ધ્યાન અને પૂજા આદિકમાં એકાગ્રપણું (બીજા સંકલ્પનો ત્યાગ કરવાથી અવ્યાકુળપણું) તે મનનો ગુણ કહ્યો છે તેમાં.
૧૪. એવી રીતે શ્રવણ, પૂજન અને ધ્યાનાદિકમાં પણ મનનું એકાગ્રપણું કરવું; કેમ કે મનની એકાગ્રતા વિના શ્રવણ, પૂજન, ધ્યાનાદિક વિધિથી કર્યું હોય પણ શાસ્ત્રોક્ત ફળ આપનારું થતું નથી.
૧૫. વચન, દેહ અને મનના ગુણે કરીને.
6. Pratyakṣh.
7. Pot-potānā hetunī siddhi na thatā.
8. Bhagwānnā satya-shauchādik je guṇ tenā darshan karīne.
9. Vyavahār-kriyāmā kushaḷtā vagere laukik.
10. Swadharma, gnān, vairāgyādik alaukik.
11. Tevā guṇ to vimukhmā paṇ hoy chhe, paṇ Bhagwānmā temane sneh hoto ja nathī; māṭe te guṇo bhagwat-snehmā kāraṇ nathī.
12. Bhagwān ane temanā ekāntik sādhuoe niṣhedh karelā hinsā, chorī ādik karma kyārey paṇ dehthī karavā nahi ane.
13. Bhagwānnā darshan, shravaṇ, dhyān ane pūjā ādikmā ekāgrapaṇu (bījā sankalpno tyāg karavāthī avyākuḷpaṇu) te manno guṇ kahyo chhe temā.
14. Evī rīte shravaṇ, pūjan ane dhyānādikmā paṇ mannu ekāgrapaṇu karavu; kem ke mannī ekāgratā vinā shravaṇ, pūjan, dhyānādik vidhithī karyu hoy paṇ shāstrokta faḷ āpanāru thatu nathī.
15. Vachan, deh ane mannā guṇe karīne.
81: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 7 Sātamne divas sānjne same[16] Shrījī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar virājmān hatā ane shvet pāgh mastake bāndhī hatī ne kāḷā chheḍāno khes oḍhyo hato ne dhoḷo khes paheryo hato ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Swayamprakāshānand Swāmīe Shrījī Mahārājne prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Ek bhakta to nānā prakārnī pūjā-sāmagrī laīne pratyakṣh Bhagwānnī pūjā kare chhe ane ek bhakta to nānā prakārnā mānasik upachāre karīne Bhagwānnī mānasī pūjā kare chhe, e be bhaktamā shreṣhṭh te koṇ chhe?” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā, “Jo Bhagwānne viṣhe preme karīne ati romānchit-gātra thaīne tathā gadgad-kanṭh thaīne jo Bhagwānnī pratyakṣh pūjā kare chhe athavā evī rīte ja Bhagwānnī mānasī pūjā kare chhe, to e bey shreṣhṭh chhe. Ane preme karīne romānchit-gātra ane gadgad-kanṭh thayā vinā kevaḷ shuṣhka mane karīne pratyakṣh Bhagwānnī pūjā kare chhe toy nyūn chhe ane mānasī pūjā kare chhe toya nyūn chhe.”

Tyāre Somale Khāchare pūchhyu je, “Evī rīte je prem-magna thaīne pratyakṣh Bhagwānnī pūjā karato hoy athavā mānasī pūjā karato hoy, te bhakta kaye lakṣhaṇe karīne oḷakhāy?” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene Bhagwānnī pūjā-sevāne viṣhe tathā kathā-vārtā, kīrtanne viṣhe atishay shraddhā hoy tathā Bhagwānnu atishay māhātmya samajato hoy ne e be vānā divase divase navā ne navā ja rahetā hoy, paṇ kyārey gauṇ na paḍe. Jem Muktānand Swāmīne ame pratham Lojpurmā dīṭhā hatā ane jevī shraddhā ane Bhagwānnu māhātmya hatu tevu ne tevu ja āj divas sudhī navu ne navu chhe, paṇ gauṇ paḍyu nathī; e be lakṣhaṇe karīne te bhaktane oḷakhavo. Ane evī rīte māhātmya ne shraddhā vinānā sarve Yādav[17] Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān bheḷā ja rahetā ane jem rājānī sevā-chākarī kare tem sevā-chākarī karatā, to paṇ tenu koī nām jāṇatu nathī ane te bhakta paṇ kahevāyā nathī. Ane Uddhavjī jo Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnī shraddhā-māhātmye sahit sevā-chākarī karatā to te param bhāgwat[18] kahevāyā ane tenī shāstramā tathā lokmā atishay prasiddhi chhe.”

Pachhī Nirvikārānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Shravaṇ, manan, nididhyās ane sākṣhātkār te kene kahevāy?” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Shrotre karīne vārtā sāmbhaḷavī tene shravaṇ kahīe. Ane je vārtā shravaṇ karī hoy te vārtāno mane karī vichār karīne, jeṭalī vārtā tyāg karyā yogya hoy teṭalīno tyāg kare ane jeṭalī vārtā grahaṇ karyā yogya hoy teṭalīnu grahaṇ kare, tene manan kahīe. Ane je vārtā nishchay karīne manane viṣhe grahaṇ karī hoy tene rāt-divas sambhārvāno je adhyās rākhavo, tene nididhyās kahīe. Ane te vārtā jevī hoy tevī ne tevī ja chintavan karyā vinā paṇ sarve mūrtimānnī peṭhe idam sāmbharī āve, tene sākṣhātkār kahīe. Ane jo evī rīte ātmānā swarūpnu shravaṇādik karyu hoy to ātmaswarūpno evī rīte sākṣhātkār thāy;[19] ane jo Bhagwānno evī rīte shravaṇ, manan, nididhyās karyo hoy to Bhagwānno evī rīte sākṣhātkār thāy chhe; paṇ manan ne nididhyās e be karyā vinā kevaḷ shravaṇe karīne sākṣhātkār thato nathī. Ane jo Bhagwānnā swarūpnu darshan karīne tenu manan ane nididhyās te na karyo hoy, to lākh varṣh sudhī darshan kare to paṇ te swarūpno sākṣhātkār na thāy ane te darshan to kevaḷ shravaṇmātra sarakhu kahevāy. Ane jeṇe Bhagwānnā ang-angnu darshan karīne pachhī te ang angnu manan ne nididhyās te karyo hashe to te ang āj sahaje sāmbharī āvatu hashe ane je angnu darshanmātra ja thayu hashe to te angne sambhārto hashe to paṇ nahī sāmbhartu hoy. Ane keṭalāk haribhakta kahe chhe je, ‘Ame to Mahārājnī mūrtine dhyānmā besīne ghaṇāy sambhārīe chhīe to paṇ eke ang dhāryāmā nathī āvatu, to samagra mūrti to kyāthī āve?’ Tenu paṇ e ja kāraṇ chhe je, Bhagwānnī mūrtinā darshanmātra kare chhe paṇ manan ne nididhyās nathī karato, māṭe kem dhāryāmā āve? Kā je, je māyik padārth chhe te paṇ kevaḷ draṣhṭimātre dekhyu hoy ne kevaḷ shravaṇmātre sāmbhaḷyu hoy ane tene jo manmā sambhārī na rākhyu hoy to te vīsarī jāy chhe; to je amāyik ne divya evu je Bhagwānnu swarūp te to manan ne nididhyās karyā vinā kyāthī sāmbhare? Māṭe Bhagwānnu darshan karīne tathā vārtā sāmbhaḷīne jo tenu manan ne nididhyās nirantar karyā kare to teno sākṣhātkār thāy, nahī to ākhī ummar darshan-shravaṇ kare to paṇ sākṣhātkār thāy nahī.”
૧૬. છ ઘડી દિવસ બાકી હતો ત્યારે.
૧૭. આ અર્થ ભાગવત (૩/૨/૮)માં “દુર્ભગો બત લોકોઽયં યદવો નિતરામપિ। યે સંવસન્તો ન વિદુર્હરિં મીના ઇવોડુપમ્॥” આ શ્લોકથી કહ્યો છે.
૧૯. આ અર્થ “આત્મા વા અરે દૃષ્ટવ્યઃ શ્રોતવ્યો મન્તવ્યો નિદિધ્યાસિતવ્યઃ।” (બૃહદારણ્યકોપનિષદ: ૨/૪/૫ તથા ૪/૫/૬) આ શ્રુતિમાં કહ્યો છે. દર્શન શબ્દથી સાક્ષાત્કાર કહ્યો છે.
16. Chha ghaḍī divas bākī hato tyāre.
17. Ā arth Bhāgwat (3/2/8)mā “Durbhago bat loko’yam yadavo nitarāmapi | Ye sanvasanto na vidurharim mīnā ivoḍupam ||” ā shlokthī kahyo chhe.
19. Ā arth “Ātmā vā are draṣhṭavyah shrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyah |” (Bṛuhadāraṇyakopaniṣhad: 2/4/5 tathā 4/5/6) ā Shrutimā kahyo chhe. Darshan shabdathī sākṣhātkār kahyo chhe.
82: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 8 Aṣhṭamīne divas Shrījī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar uttarāde mukhārvinde virājmān hatā ne mastake shvet pāgh bāndhī hatī ne shvet pachheḍī oḍhī hatī ne shvet khes paheryo hato ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Swayamprakāshānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Ātmā-anātmānī chokhī je vikti te kem samajavī je samajave karīne ātmā-anātmā ek samajāy ja nahī?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ek shloke karīne athavā be shloke karīne athavā pāch shloke karīne athavā so shloke karīne athavā hajār shloke karīne je chokhu samajāy te ṭhīk chhe; je samajāṇā keḍe ātmā-anātmānā ekpaṇāno locho ja rahe nahī. Ane chokhu samajāī jāy te ja samajaṇ sukhdāyī thāy chhe ane gobarī samajaṇ sukhdāyī thatī nathī. Māṭe em chokhu samaje je, ‘Hu ātmā te mārā jevo guṇ dehne viṣhe ekeya āvato nathī ane jaḍ, dukh ane mithyārūp je deh tenā je guṇ, te hu chaitanya te māre viṣhe ekeya āvato nathī.’ Evī vikti samajīne ne atyant nirvāsanik thaīne chaitanyarūp thako Puruṣhottam Bhagwānnu chintavan kare, evo je jaḍ-chaitanyano vivek tene draḍh vivek jāṇavo. Ane ghaḍīk potāne ātmārūp māne ane ghaḍīk dehrūp mānīne strīnu chintavan kare ene gobaro jāṇavo, māṭe enā antarmā sukh na āve. Jem sundar amṛut sarakhu anna hoy ne temā thoḍuk zer nākhyu hoy, to te anna sukhdāyī na thāy, sāmu dukhdāyī thāy chhe; tem āṭhe pahor ātmāno vichār karīne ek ghaḍī potāne dehrūp mānīne strīnu chintavan kare eṭale eno sarve vichār dhūḷmā maḷī jāy chhe. Māṭe atyant nirvāsanik thavāy evo chokho ātmavichār karavo.

“Ane koīkne[20] evo sanshay thāy je, ‘Atyant nirvāsanik nahī thaīe ne kāchā ne kāchā marī jaīshu to shā havāl thashe?’ To evo vichār Bhagwānnā bhaktane karavo nahī.[21] Ane em samajavu je, ‘Marashe to deh marashe, paṇ hu to ātmā chhu ane ajar-amar chhu, māṭe hu maru nahī.’ Evu samajīne haiyāmā himmat rākhavī ane Parameshvar vinā sarve vāsanā tyāg karīne achaḷ mati karavī. Ane em vāsanā ṭāḷatā ṭāḷatā jo kāīk thoḍī-ghaṇī vāsanā rahī gaī, to jevā Mokṣhadharmamā narak kahyā chhe[22] tevā naraknī prāpti thashe. Te naraknī vigati je, Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene kāī jagatnī vāsanā rahe, tene Indrādik devatānā je lok tenī prāpti thāy ne te lokne viṣhe jaīne, Apchchharāo tathā vimān tathā maṇimay mahol e ādik je vaibhav te sarve Parameshvarnā dhāmnī āgaḷ narak jevā chhe, tene bhogave chhe; paṇ vimukh jīvnī peṭhe Yampurīmā jāy nahī ane chorāshīmā paṇ jāy nahī. Māṭe jo savāsanik Bhagwānnā bhakta hasho to paṇ ghaṇu thashe to devatā thavu paḍashe ne devatāmāthī paḍasho to manuṣhya thasho ne manuṣhya thaīne vaḷī pāchhī Bhagwānnī bhakti karīne nirvāsanik thaīne antye Bhagwānnā dhāmne pāmasho; paṇ vimukh jīvnī peṭhe narak-chorāshīne nahī bhogavo. Evu jāṇīne Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene vāsanānu baḷ dekhīne himmat hāravī nahī ne ānandmā Bhagwānnu bhajan karyā karavu ane vāsanā ṭāḷyānā upāymā rahevu ane Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā Santnā vachanmā draḍh vishvās rākhavo.”
૨૧. તેની તો ભગવાન રક્ષા કરે છે.
૨૨. જુઓ સંદર્ભ: વચનામૃત સા. ૧, ટીપણી-૪: [“એતે વૈ નિરયાસ્તાત સ્થાનસ્ય પરમાત્મનઃ” (મહાભારત, શાંતિપર્વ: ૧૯૧/૬) આ શ્લોકથી કહ્યું છે.]
21. Tenī to Bhagwān rakṣhā kare chhe.
22. Juo sandarbh: Vachanāmṛut Sā. 1, ṭīpaṇī-4: [“Ete vai nirayāstāt sthānasya paramātmanah” (Mahābhārat, Shāntiparva: 191/6) ā shlokthī kahyu chhe.]
83: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 9 Navmīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīye ḍholiyā upar virājmān hatā ane sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Vāsanānī nivṛutti thayāno evo sho jabaro upāya chhe je ek upāyne viṣhe sarve sādhan āvī jāy?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene shraddhā tathā Hari ane harijannā vachanne viṣhe vishvās tathā Bhagwānne viṣhe prīti tathā Bhagwānnā swarūpnu māhātmya e chār vānā jenā hṛudaymā hoy tenī vāsanā nivṛutta thaī jāy chhe. Temā paṇ jo ek māhātmya atishay draḍh hoy, to shraddhā tathā vishvās tathā prīti e traṇ dūbaḷā hoy to paṇ mahābaḷavān thāy chhe; ane māhātmya vinānī bhakti jo zāzī jaṇātī hoy to paṇ ante nāsh thaī jāy chhe. Jem das-bār varṣhnī kanyā hoy ne tene kṣhay-rog thāy, pachhī te kanyā yuvān thayā mor ja marī jāy paṇ yuvān thāy nahī; tem jene māhātmya vinānī bhakti hoy te paṇ paripakva thatī thatī nāsh thaī jāy chhe. Ane jenā hṛudaymā māhātmye sahit Bhagwānnī bhakti hoy to bījā kalyāṇkārī guṇ na hoy to paṇ tenā hṛudaymā sarve āve chhe. Ane jo māhātmye sahit bhakti jenā hṛudaymā nathī, to sham-damādik je kalyāṇkārī rūḍā guṇ te tenā hṛudaymā chhe toy paṇ nahī jevā ja chhe; kem je, ante nāsh pāmī jashe. Māṭe ek māhātmye sahit bhakti hoy to tenī vāsanā paṇ nivṛutta thaī jāy ane kalyāṇkārī je guṇ te sarve āvīne hṛudayne viṣhe nivās karīne rahe. Te māṭe māhātmye sahit Bhagwānnī bhakti e ja vāsanā ṭāḷyānu mahāmoṭu achaḷ sādhan chhe.”

Pachhī Swayamprakāshānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Jīv anvaypaṇe kem chhe ne vyatirekpaṇe kem chhe? Ane īshvar anvaypaṇe kem chhe ne vyatirekpaṇe kem chhe? Akṣharbrahma anvaypaṇe kem chhe ne vyatirekpaṇe kem chhe? Ane Puruṣhottam Bhagwānne anvaypaṇe kem jāṇavā ne vyatirekpaṇe kem jāṇavā?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Janma-maraṇnu bhoktā evu je jīvnu swarūp te anvay jāṇavu; ane achhedya, abhedya, avināshī evu je jīvnu swarūp te vyatirek jāṇavu. Ane virāṭ, sūtrātmā ane avyākṛut e traṇ sharīrmā ekraspaṇe varte e īshvarnu anvay swarūp jāṇavu; ane pinḍ-brahmānḍthī par Sachchidānandpaṇe karīne je nirūpaṇ karyu chhe te īshvarnu vyatirek swarūp jāṇavu. Ane Prakṛuti-Puruṣh tathā Sūrya-Chandrādik sarve devatā tenu je prerak te Akṣharnu anvay swarūp jāṇavu; ane je swarūpne viṣhe Puruṣh-Prakṛuti ādye kāī upādhi rahetī nathī, ek Puruṣhottam Bhagwān ja rahe chhe, e Akṣharnu vyatirek swarūp chhe. Ane baddha jīv tathā mukta jīv e benā hṛudaymā sākṣhīrūp thakā rahyā chhe ane baddhapaṇu ne muktapaṇu jene aḍatu nathī, tem ja īshvarnā ne Akṣharnā hṛudaymā sākṣhīrūpe rahyā chhe ane te te upādhi[23] thakī rahit chhe, e Puruṣhottamnu anvay swarūp chhe; ane jīv, īshvar ne Akṣhar te thakī par je Akṣharātīt swarūp e Puruṣhottamnu vyatirek swarūp jāṇavu. Evī rīte anvay-vyatirekpaṇu chhe.”

Pachhī vaḷī Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Bhagwānnā darshanno je mahimā tathā Bhagwānnā nām-smaraṇno je mahimā tathā Bhagwānnā sparshano je mahimā te Bhagwānnā bhaktane arthe chhe ke sarve jīvne sāru chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Darshanādikno to bhed judo ja chhe. Te kahīe te sāmbhaḷo je, jyāre e darshanno karanāro Bhagwānnā darshan kare chhe tyāre enu man chhe te draṣhṭi dvāre āvīne te sahit draṣhṭi jo darshan kare to te darshan evu thāy chhe je, visāre toy paṇ vīsare nahī. Evī rīte mane sahvartamān tvachā sparsh kare to te sparsh paṇ vīsare nahī. Jem Gopānganāonā Bhagwān pratye Bhāgwatmā vachan chhe je, ‘He Bhagwan! Je divasthī tamārā charaṇno sparsh thayo chhe te divas thakī tam vinā je je sansārnā sukh chhe te amane viṣh jevā lāge chhe.’[24] Evī rīte sarve gnān-indriye karīne mane sahvartamān je darshan-sparsh-shravaṇādik thāy chhe te koī kāḷe vīsarī jatā nathī. Jem agnānī jīv hoy teṇe mane sahvartamān je panch gnān-indriyo teṇe karīne je je viṣhay bhogavyā hoy, te visāre to paṇ vīsare nahī; evī rīte Bhagwānnu paṇ mane sahvartamān je darshanādik kare chhe tene ja darshanādik jāṇavu. Ane bījāne to darshan thayu chhe toy paṇ na thayā jevu chhe; kā je, je same eṇe darshan karyā te same tenu man to kyāī ye faratu hatu. Māṭe e darshan ene kā to ek divasmā vīsarī jashe athavā pāch divasmā athavā pachās divasmā athavā chha mahināmā athavā varṣhmā athavā pāch varṣhmā jarūr vīsarī jashe, paṇ ante raheshe nahī. Māṭe je māhātmya jāṇīne, atishay prītie karīne, mane sahit draṣhṭi ādik gnān-indriye karīne darshan-sparshādik kare chhe, tene ja temanu faḷ chhe. Ane bījāne to je Parameshvarnā darshanādik thāy chhe tenu bījbaḷ thāy chhe ane yathārth mahimā to je mane sahvartamān darshanādik kare chhe tene arthe chhe.”
૨૩. બંધન; જીવ તથા ઈશ્વરમાં રહેલ અજ્ઞાનજન્ય મલિનતા.
૨૪. ભાગવત: ૧૦/૨૯/૩૬. થોડાક શબ્દભેદ સાથે આ ભાવનાં ગોપીઓનાં વચનો આ સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંકમાં પ્રાપ્ત થાય છે.
23. Bandhan; jīv tathā īshvarmā rahel agnānjanya malinatā.
24. Bhāgwat: 10/29/36. Thoḍāk shabdabhed sāthe ā bhāvnā Gopīonā vachano ā sandarbh kramānkmā prāpt thāy chhe.
84: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 10 Dashmīne divas Shrījī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīye ḍholiyā upar virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Nityānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Ek ek avasthā viṣhe bījī be be avasthāo kem rahī chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā, “Ā jīvātmā je te jene viṣhe rahīne viṣhaybhogne bhogave chhe tene avasthā kahīe; te avasthā jāgrat, swapna ane suṣhupti e traṇ prakārnī chhe. Temā je jāgrat avasthā[25] chhe te Vairāj-Puruṣhnī je sthiti avasthā tenu kārya chhe ne sattvaguṇātmak[26] chhe ne netra sthānakne viṣhe rahī chhe. Evī je jāgrat avasthā tene viṣhe Vishvābhimānī[27] nāme je ā jīvātmā te je te sthūḷ dehnā abhimāne sahit thako das indriyo ne chār antahkaraṇe karīne viveke sahit yathārthpaṇe potānā pūrvakarmane anusāre bāhya shabdādik panch-viṣhaynā bhogne bhogave chhe, tene sattvaguṇ-pradhān evī jāgrat avasthā kahīe. Ane e jāgratne viṣhe jo e jīvātmā bhrāntie karīne ayathārthpaṇe bāhya viṣhaybhogne bhogave chhe, to tene jāgratne viṣhe swapna[28] kahīe. Ane e jīvātmā je te jāgratne viṣhe shok tathā shramādike karīne viveke rahit thako jo bāhya viṣhaybhogne bhogave chhe, to tene jāgratne viṣhe suṣhupti[29] kahīe. Ane je swapna avasthā chhe te Hiraṇyagarbhanī je utpatti avasthā tenu kārya chhe ne rajoguṇātmak[30] chhe ne kanṭh sthānakne viṣhe rahī chhe. Evī je swapna avasthā tene viṣhe taijasābhimānī nāme je jīvātmā te sūkṣhma dehnā abhimāne sahit rahyo thako indriyo-antahkaraṇe karīne pūrvakarmane anusāre sukh-dukhrūp vāsanāmay[31] bhogne bhogave chhe, tene rajoguṇ-pradhān swapna avasthā kahīe. Ane e swapnane viṣhe e jīvātmā je te jyāre jāgratnī peṭhe ja viveke karīne jāṇato thako vāsanāmay bhogne bhogave chhe, tyāre tene swapnane viṣhe jāgrat avasthā[32] kahīe. Ane e swapnane viṣhe jaṇāṇā je vāsanāmay bhog temane e jīvātmā je te bhogavato thako paṇ jo jaḍpaṇe[33] karīne na jāṇe to tene swapnane viṣhe suṣhupti[34] kahīe. Ane je suṣhupti avasthā chhe te īshvarnī je pralay avasthā tenu kārya chhe ne tamoguṇātmak[35] chhe ne hṛuday sthānakne viṣhe rahī chhe. Evī je suṣhupti avasthā te jyāre e jīvne āve chhe tyāre indriyo-antahkaraṇnī je vṛuttio tathā viṣhaybhognī vāsanā tathā gnātāpaṇu[36] ne kartāpaṇu[37] e sarve kāraṇ dehne viṣhe līn thaī jāy chhe ane te kāraṇ dehno abhimānī je prāgna nāme jīvātmā tenu Pradhān-Puruṣhrūp saguṇbrahmanā[38] sukhleshne viṣhe atishay līnpaṇu thaī jāy chhe, tene tamoguṇ-pradhān suṣhupti avasthā kahīe. Ane e suṣhuptine viṣhe karmasanskāre karīne kartāvṛuttinu[39] je utpanna thavu tene suṣhuptine viṣhe swapna[40] kahīe ane jāgrat ne swapnane viṣhe je pīḍā tenā tāp thakī vaḷī te suṣhuptinā sukhne[41] viṣhe pravesh karatī je kartāvṛutti tenā pratilompaṇānu je gnān tene suṣhuptine viṣhe jāgrat[42] kahīe. Evī rīte ek ek avasthāne viṣhe bījī be be avasthāo rahī chhe. Ane e ja avasthānā bhed tenu je gnān[43] te jīvātmāne je vate thāy chhe ane vaḷī te te avasthāne viṣhe e jīvne karmānusāre je faḷnā pamāḍnārā chhe tene Turyapad[44] kahe chhe, antaryāmī[45] kahe chhe, draṣhṭā[46] kahe chhe, brahma[47] kahe chhe, Parabrahma[48] kahe chhe.”[49]

Pachhī vaḷī Nityānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Parā, Pashyantī, Madhyamā ane Vaikharī e je chār vāṇī[50] tene kem samajavī?” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “E vārtā to bahu moṭī chhe ne atishay sūkṣhma chhe ane Shrīmad Bhāgwatnā Ekādash Skandhne[51] viṣhe Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwāne Uddhavajī pratye kahī chhe. Tene sankṣhepe karīne kahīe te sāmbhaḷo je, pratham utpattikāḷne viṣhe Puruṣhottam Bhagwān je te Vairāj-Puruṣhnā mastakne viṣhe rahyu chhe je Sahasradaḷnu Kamaḷ tene viṣhe[52] pravesh karīne Akṣharbrahmātmak[53] evo je nād[54] tene karatā havā. Pachhī te nād je te suṣhumṇā mārge karīne te Virāṭ-Puruṣhnā nābhikand pratye vyāpīne mahāprāṇe sahit thako tyā ūncho vṛuddhine pāmato havo. Teṇe karīne te Virāṭ-Puruṣhnu je nābhipadma te adhomukh hatu te ūrdhvamukh[55] thatu havu. Evī rīte te Virāṭ-Puruṣhnā je nābhikandne viṣhe je nād thayo tene Parā vāṇī kahīe. Ane te Parā vāṇī je te Vednī utpattine arthe pote Bhagwāne bījrūpe karīne prakāshī chhe, ne tejnā pravāhrūp chhe, ne ardhamātrārūp[56] chhe. Pachhī te Parā vāṇī je te tyā thakī te Virāṭnā hṛudayākāshne pāmīne Pashyantī nāme thatī havī ne tyā thakī kanṭh deshne pāmīne Madhyamā nāme thatī havī ne tyā te Virāṭnā mukhne pāmīne Vaikharī sangnāne pāmatī havī; ane akār, ukār ne makār[57] e traṇ varṇarūpe thaīne praṇavrūpe thatī havī ne pachhī bāvan[58] akṣharrūpe thaīne chār Vedrūpe thatī havī; evī rīte Virāṭ-Puruṣhne viṣhe Parā, Pashyantī, Madhyamā ane Vaikharī e chār vāṇī samajavī.

“Have ā jīvnā dehne viṣhe paṇ chār vāṇī kahīe[59] te sāmbhaḷo je, enā e Puruṣhottam Bhagwān te jīvne viṣhe antaryāmīrūpe karīne rahyā chhe ne e jīvnī je traṇ avasthā tene viṣhe swatantra thakā anusyūt chhe, evā je Bhagwān te ja jīvnā kalyāṇne arthe pṛuthvīne viṣhe avatār dhāre chhe tyāre e jīv je te, te Bhagwānnā swarūpnu je pratipādan kare tathā te Bhagwānnā je dhām, guṇ ane aishvarya tenu pratipādan kare tathā tenā charitranu varṇan kare tathā ātmā-anātmāno vivek karī dekhāḍe tathā jīv, īshvar, māyā, Brahma, Parabrahma tenā bhedne pṛuthak pṛuthak kahī dekhāḍe, evī je vāṇī tene Parā vāṇī kahīe. Ane je māyik padārth tathā viṣhay temane viveke sahit yathārthpaṇe kahī dekhāḍe, tene Vaikharī vāṇī kahīe. Ane padārthne ne viṣhayne bhrāntie sahit ayathārthpaṇe kahī dekhāḍe, tene Madhyamā vāṇī kahīe. Ane e padārthne ne viṣhayne andha-dhandha sarakhu kahī dekhāḍe ne kāī samajyāmā na āve, tene pashyantī vāṇī kahīe. Evī rīte jīvnī jāgrat avasthāne viṣhe e chār vāṇīnu rūp samajyāmā āve chhe ane swapna ne suṣhuptine viṣhe to koīk samādhivāḷāne e chār vāṇīnā rūp samajyāmā āve, paṇ bījāne samajyāmā āvatā nathī.”
1. The term ‘Brahma’ is also used in scriptures to mean God.
2. One of the six syllables in the root sound ‘AUM’.

૨૫. અહીં જણાવેલ જાગ્રત, સ્વપ્ન, સુષુપ્તિ ત્રણ અવસ્થાઓ ક્રમશઃ સત્ત્વગુણ, રજોગુણ તથા તમોગુણના કાર્યરૂપ છે. જ્યારે તે ત્રણેય ગુણો એક એક અવસ્થામાં વર્તતા હોય, ત્યારે જીવમાં તે એક જ અવસ્થા વર્તતી હોય છે. પરંતુ જ્યારે ગુણોનું પરસ્પર મિશ્રણ થતાં, અવસ્થાઓ પણ એકબીજાની અંદર મિશ્રણ પામે છે; તેવું કહેવાનો અહીં આશય છે. તેનો પ્રારંભ જાગ્રત અવસ્થાના વર્ણનથી કરે છે.
૨૭. સ્થૂળ, સૂક્ષ્મ અને કારણ આ ત્રણ દેહના અભિમાનથી જીવનાં વિશ્વ, તૈજસ અને પ્રાજ્ઞ આ ત્રણ નામ પડ્યાં છે; તે વાસ્તવિક નથી, ઉપાધિથી છે; તે જણાવવા અહીં વિશ્વાભિમાની શબ્દ વાપરે છે.
૩૧. વિનાશી અને અસ્થિર એવા શબ્દાદિ વિષયોનો મનમાં ભોગ.
૩૭. જીવનું અહંવૃત્તિથી વિષયો માટે કર્મનું કરવાપણું.
૩૯. કર્મનો કર્તા જે જીવ તેવી વૃત્તિનું.
૪૧. પ્રથમ સુષુપ્તિ અવસ્થામાં અનુભવેલા સગુણબ્રહ્મ સંબંધી આનંદમાં.

૪૯. અહીં અંતર્યામી, બ્રહ્મ, પરબ્રહ્મ વગેરે શબ્દોથી ત્રણ અવસ્થાથી પર ચતુર્થ તત્ત્વનું નિરૂપણ કર્યું છે. તેમાં ચતુર્થ અર્થાત્ તુર્યાવસ્થાના અધિષ્ઠાતા તરીકે અલગ અલગ ઉપનિષદોમાં જે સ્વરૂપનું જે નામથી વર્ણન કર્યું છે તે શ્રીજીમહારાજ જણાવે છે પરંતુ બ્રહ્મ તથા પરબ્રહ્મને એક તત્ત્વ તરીકે જણાવતા નથી.
૫૦. તે જીવના અને વૈરાજના દેહમાં રહી છે.
૫૨. “સહસ્રદળ કમળના નિવાસરૂપ વૈરાજપુરુષના મસ્તકમાં આવેલ બ્રહ્મરંધ્રમાં” - એવો વાક્યાર્થ સમજવો.
૫૭. નાભિ આદિક ચાર સ્થાનમાં પરા આદિક ચાર વાણીમાંથી અનુક્રમે અર્ધમાત્રા, મકાર, ઉકાર અને અકાર આટલા વર્ણ ઉત્પન્ન થાય છે.

૫૯. જીવનાં પણ નાભિ, હૃદય, કંઠ અને મુખમાં ભગવાનની ઇચ્છાથી જ ચાર પ્રકારની વાણી ઉદ્‎ભવે છે. તેમાં શરીરની અંદરના ત્રણ પ્રકારના વાણીના ભેદ તો જ્ઞાનીઓને પણ દુર્બોધ છે. મનુષ્ય તો કેવળ વૈખરી નામના ચોથા ભેદને જ જાણે છે. જીવની વૈખરી વાણીમાં જ વાણીના ચાર ભેદ મેં નિશ્ચય કરેલા છે તે સ્પષ્ટપણે કહું છું.

25. Ahī jaṇāvel jāgrat, swapna, suṣhupti traṇ avasthāo kramashah sattvaguṇ, rajoguṇ tathā tamoguṇnā kāryarūp chhe. Jyāre te traṇey guṇo ek ek avasthāmā vartatā hoy, tyāre jīvmā te ek ja avasthā vartatī hoy chhe. Parantu jyāre guṇonu paraspar mishraṇ thatā, avasthāo paṇ ek-bījānī andar mishraṇ pāme chhe; tevu kahevāno ahī āshay chhe. Teno prārambh jāgrat avasthānā varṇanthī kare chhe.
27. Sthūḷ, sūkṣhma ane kāraṇ ā traṇ dehnā abhimānthī jīvnā vishva, taijas ane prāgna ā traṇ nām paḍyā chhe; te vāstavik nathī, upādhithī chhe; te jaṇāvavā ahī vishvābhimānī shabda vāpare chhe.
31. Vināshī ane asthir evā shabdādi viṣhayono manmā bhog.
37. Jīvnu ahamvṛuttithī viṣhayo māṭe karmanu karavāpaṇu.
39. Karmano kartā je jīv tevī vṛuttinu.
41. Pratham suṣhupti avasthāmā anubhavelā saguṇ-brahma sambandhī ānandmā.

49. Ahī antaryāmī, Brahma, Parabrahma vagere shabdothī traṇ avasthāthī par chaturth tattvanu nirūpaṇ karyu chhe. Temā chaturth arthāt turyāvasthānā adhiṣhṭhātā tarīke alag alag Upaniṣhadomā je swarūpnu je nāmthī varṇan karyu chhe te Shrījī Mahārāj jaṇāve chhe parantu Brahma tathā Parabrahmane ek tattva tarīke jaṇāvatā nathī.
50. Te jīvnā ane Vairājnā dehmā rahī chhe.
52. “Sahasradaḷ kamaḷnā nivāsrūp Vairāj-Puruṣhnā mastakmā āvel brahma-randhramā” - evo vākyārth samajavo.
57. Nābhi ādik chār sthānmā parā ādik chār vāṇīmāthī anukrame ardhamātrā, makār, ukār ane akār āṭalā varṇa utpanna thāy chhe.

59. Jīvnā paṇ nābhi, hṛuday, kanṭh ane mukhmā Bhagwānnī ichchhāthī ja chār prakārnī vāṇī udbhave chhe. Temā sharīrnī andarnā traṇ prakārnā vāṇīnā bhed to gnānīone paṇ durbodh chhe. Manuṣhya to kevaḷ vaikharī nāmnā chothā bhedne ja jāṇe chhe. Jīvnī vaikharī vāṇīmā ja vāṇīnā chār bhed me nishchay karelā chhe te spaṣhṭpaṇe kahu chhu.
85: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 11 Ekādashīne divas rātrine same[60] Shrījī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Ane Shrījī Mahārāje Shrīmad Bhāgwat Purāṇnā Pratham Skandhnī kathā vanchāvavāno ārambh karāvyo hato. Tyāre temā em vārtā[61] āvī je, “Jyā manomay chakranī dhārā kunṭhit thāy tyā Naimiṣhāraṇya Kṣhetra jāṇavu.” E vārtāne sāmbhaḷīne Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “He Mahārāj! E manomay chakra te shu chhe ne enī dhārā te shī samajavī?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Manomay chakra te manne jāṇavu ane enī dhārā te dash indriyo chhe em jāṇavu. Ane te indriyorūp je mannī dhārā te je ṭhekāṇe ghasāīne būṭhī thaī jāy[62] tene Naimiṣhāraṇya Kṣhetra jāṇavu. Te ṭhekāṇe jap, tap, vrat, dhyān, pūjā e ādik je sukṛut teno je ārambh kare te din-din pratye vṛuddhi pāme. Evu je Naimiṣhāraṇya Kṣhetra te je ṭhekāṇe Bhagwānnā Ekāntik Sādhu rahetā hoy te ṭhekāṇe jāṇavu. Ane jyāre manomay chakranī indriyorūp je dhārā te būṭhī thaī jāy tyāre shabda, sparsh, rūp, ras ane gandh e panch-viṣhayne viṣhe kyāī prīti rahe nahī ane jyāre koī rūpvān strī dekhāy athavā vastra-alankārādik ati sundar padārth dekhāy tyāre mūḷago tenā manmā atishay abhāv āve, paṇ temā indriyonī vṛutti jaīne chonṭe nahī. Jem ati tīkhī aṇīvāḷu bāṇ hoy, te je padārthmā chonṭāḍe te padārthne vīndhīne māhī pravesh karī jāy chhe ane pāchhu kāḍhyu paṇ nīsare nahī; ane tenā te bāṇmāthī faḷ kāḍhī līdhu hoy ne pachhī thothu rahyu hoy teno bhītmā ghā kare to tyāthī uthaḍkīne pāchhu paḍe chhe, paṇ jem faḷ sotu bhītne viṣhe chonṭī jāy chhe tem chonṭe nahī. Tem jyāre manomay chakranī dhārā je indriyo te būṭhiyo thaī jāy tyāre game tevo shreṣhṭh viṣhay hoy temā paṇ indriyonī vṛutti chonṭe nahī ane thothānī peṭhe indriyonī vṛuttio pāchhī haṭhe; evu vartāy tyāre jāṇīe je, manomay chakranī dhārā kunṭhit thaī gaī. Evu Santnā samāgamrūpī Naimiṣhāraṇya Kṣhetra[63] jyā dekhāy tyā kalyāṇne ichchhavu ane tyā ati draḍh man karīne rahevu.”
૬૧. “નૈમિશેઽનિમિષક્ષેત્રે।” (ભાગવત: ૧/૧/૪). આ શ્લોકની શ્રીધરી ટીકામાં ‘નૈમિષારણ્ય’ શબ્દનો અર્થ કરવામાં વાયુપુરાણ (૨/૭)ની આખ્યાયિકા લખી છે તેમાં.
૬૨. શબ્દ વગેરે વિષયોમાં ઇન્દ્રિયોની પ્રવૃત્તિ વિરામ પામી જાય.

૬૩. જેમ ચક્રની ધારા કુંઠિત થાય ત્યારે તે ચક્ર ભ્રમણ કરી શકે નહિ, તેમ જ્યારે વિષયોમાંથી ઇન્દ્રિયો પાછી વળે ત્યારે મન વિષયોમાં ભ્રમણ કરે નહિ. જેમ બાણ ફળાએ રહિત થાય તો લક્ષને વીંધવા માટે સમર્થ થાય નહિ, તેમ જ મન પણ જ્યારે ઇન્દ્રિયોની સહાયતાએ રહિત થાય ત્યારે વિષય ગ્રહણ કરવા સમર્થ થાય નહિ; આવી સ્થિતિ બ્રહ્મસ્વરૂપ સંતના યોગે કરીને પ્રાપ્ત થાય છે, આટલો તાત્પર્યાર્થ છે.
61. “Naimishe’nimiṣhakṣhetre |” (Bhāgwat: 1/1/4). Ā shloknī Shrīdharī ṭīkāmā ‘Naimiṣhāraṇya’ shabdano arth karavāmā Vāyu-Purāṇ (2/7)nī ākhyāyikā lakhī chhe temā.
62. Shabda vagere viṣhayomā indriyonī pravṛutti virām pāmī jāy.

63. Jem chakranī dhārā kunṭhit thāy tyāre te chakra bhramaṇ karī shake nahi, tem jyāre viṣhayomāthī indriyo pāchhī vaḷe tyāre man viṣhayomā bhramaṇ kare nahi. Jem bāṇ faḷāe rahit thāy to lakṣhne vīndhavā māṭe samarth thāy nahi, tem ja man paṇ jyāre indriyonī sahāyatāe rahit thāy tyāre viṣhay grahaṇ karavā samarth thāy nahi; āvī sthiti brahmaswarūp santnā yoge karīne prāpt thāy chhe, āṭalo tātparyārth chhe.
86: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 12 Dvādashīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Chaitanyānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “He Mahārāj! Īrṣhyānu shu rūp chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jenā hṛudaymā mān hoy te mānmāthī īrṣhyā pravarte chhe ane krodh, matsar ne asūyā te paṇ mānmāthī pravarte chhe. Ane īrṣhyānu e rūp chhe je, potāthī je moṭā hoy to paṇ tenu jyāre sanmān thāy tyāre tene dekhī shake nahī, evo jeno swabhāv hoy tene em jāṇavu je, ānā haiyāmā īrṣhyā chhe. Ane yathārth īrṣhyāvāḷo je hoy te to koīnī moṭāīne dekhī shake nahī.”
87: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 13 Terasne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj potānā bhaktajanne sukh devāne arthe Sārangpurthī chālyā te gām Shrī Kunḍaḷ padhāryā ane te Kunḍaḷ madhye Amarā Paṭgarnā āthamṇā oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar uttar mukhārvinde virājmān hatā ane mastak upar dhoḷī pāgh bāndhī hatī tathā dhoḷī pachheḍī oḍhī hatī tathā dhoḷo suravāḷ paheryo hato tathā dhoḷo angarkho paheryo hato ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Jīvnā hṛudaymā yugnā dharma pravarte chhe[64] tenu shu kāraṇ chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Yugnā dharma pravarte chhe tenu kāraṇ to guṇ[65] chhe. Te jyāre shuddha sattvaguṇ vartato hoy tyāre tenā haiyāmā Satya Yugnī pravṛutti hoy ane jyāre sattva ane raj bheḷā vartatā hoy tyāre tenā haiyāmā Tretā Yugnī pravṛutti hoy ane jyāre raj ne tamoguṇ bheḷā vartatā hoy tyāre tenā haiyāmā Dvāpar Yugnī pravṛutti hoy ane jyāre ekalo tamoguṇ vartato hoy tyāre tenā haiyāmā Kaḷi Yugnī pravṛutti hoy; em guṇe karīne yugnī pravṛutti chhe.”[66]

Pachhī vaḷī Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Guṇnī pravṛutti thayāno sho hetu chhe?”[67] Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Guṇnī pravṛuttinu kāraṇ to karma chhe, te jevā pūrva-karma hoy tevā guṇnī pravṛutti thāy chhe. Māṭe jene rajoguṇ ne tamoguṇ vartatā hoy ne te jo ekāgra thaīne Bhagwānnu dhyān karavā jāy to thāy nahī. Māṭe evāne to ātmaniṣhṭhānu baḷ rākhavu ane Bhagwānnā mahimānu baḷ rākhavu ne em samajavu je, ‘Hun to ātmā chhu, te māre viṣhe māyākṛut upādhi hoy nahī ne hu to Guṇātīt chhu.’ Ane Bhagwānno mahimā em vichārvo je, ‘Ajāmeḷ mahāpāpī hato ne dīkarāne yoge Nārāyaṇ evu nām līdhu, te sarva pāpthī chhūṭīne param padne pāmyo;[68] to mane to te Bhagwān pratyakṣh maḷyā chhe ane rāt-divas te Bhagwānnu hu nām lau chhu, māṭe hu to kṛutārth thayo chhu.’ Evī rīte vichārīne ānandmā rahevu, paṇ jene tamoguṇ ne rajoguṇ vartatā hoy tene dhyān-dhāraṇāne arthe āgrah karavo nahī ane jevu banī āve tevu bhajan-smaraṇ karavu ne dehe karīne Bhagwānnī tathā santnī paricharyā shraddhāe sahit karavī ne pot-potānā dharmamā rahevu ne potāne pūraṇkām mānavu.”

Pachhī vaḷī Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Jene tāmasī karma ghaṇā hoy tenā haiyāmā Kaḷi Yug varte, te koī upāye ṭaḷe ke na ṭaḷe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jo ene Sant tathā Parameshvarnā vachanne viṣhe atishay shraddhā hoy ane ati draḍh vishvās hoy, to game tevā tāmasī karma hoy paṇ teno nāsh thaī jāy ane Kaḷi Yugnā dharma maṭīne Satya Yugnā dharma hoy te varte. Māṭe ati sāche bhāve karīne satsang kare to tene koī jātno doṣh haiyāmā rahe nahī ane deh chhatā ja brahmarūp thaī jāy.”

Pachhī Swayamprakāshānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Sthān te kene kahīe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Chār varṇa ane chār āshram tene je pot-potāno dharma tene sthān jāṇavu.[69] Ane tame tyāgī chho te tamārāthī jo tyāgno pakṣh mūkīne gṛuhasthne mārge chalāy to te sthānak thakī bhraṣhṭ thavāṇu em jāṇavu. Māṭe game tevo āpatkāḷ paḍe athavā ame āgnā karīe to paṇ tamāre potānā dharmamāthī chaḷavu nahī. Ane jem gṛuhasth vastra tathā alankāre karīne amārī pūjā karavāne ichchhe tem tamāre ichchhavu nahī; tamāre to patra, puṣhp, faḷ ane jaḷe karīne pūjā karavī ne evī pūjāe karīne ja ānand mānavo, paṇ potānā dharmathī chalāyamān thaīne Parameshvarnī pūjā karavī e ṭhīk nahī. Māṭe sarvane potānā dharmamā rahyā thakā jeṭalī pūjā thāy teṭalī karavī, e amārī āgnā chhe, tene draḍh karīne sarve rākhajyo.”
૬૪. જેમ બહાર યુગ પ્રવર્તે છે તેમ.

૬૬. જ્યારે સત્ત્વગુણના કાર્યરૂપ જ્ઞાન-તપ વગેરેમાં રુચિ ઉત્પન્ન થાય ત્યારે મારા હૃદયમાં સત્યયુગ પ્રવર્ત્યો છે તેમ જાણવું. રજોગુણના કાર્યરૂપ ધર્મ તથા ઇચ્છાપૂર્તિ થાય તેવાં કાર્યોમાં જ્યારે રુચિ ઉત્પન્ન થાય ત્યારે મારા હૃદયમાં ત્રેતાયુગ પ્રવર્ત્યો છે એમ જાણવું. જ્યારે રજોગુણ અને તમોગુણના કાર્યરૂપ ધર્મ તથા ઇચ્છાપૂર્તિ થાય તેવાં કાર્યોમાં અને લોભાદિકમાં રુચિ ઉત્પન્ન થાય ત્યારે મારા હૃદયમાં દ્વાપરયુગ પ્રવર્ત્યો છે એમ જાણવું. તમોગુણના કાર્યરૂપ અસત્ય, હિંસા, નિદ્રા આદિકમાં જ્યારે રુચિ ઉત્પન્ન થાય, ત્યારે મારા હૃદયમાં કળિયુગ પ્રવર્ત્યો છે એમ જાણવું. તે ભાગવત (૧૨/૩/૨૬-૩૦)માં “સત્ત્વં રજસ્તમ ઇતિ” આ શ્લોકને આરંભીને “યદા માયાનૃતં તન્દ્રા” ઇત્યાદિક પાંચ શ્લોકથી નિરૂપણ કર્યું છે. આટલો તાત્પર્ય છે.
૬૭. અને કેવા ગુણવાળાએ કેવી ભક્તિ કરવાની હોય તે પણ કહો?
૬૯. પરંતુ મંદિર, મઠ અથવા સંપ્રદાય વગેરેને ‘સ્થાન’ શબ્દથી ન જાણવા, એટલું મહારાજનું તાત્પર્ય છે.
64. Jem bahār yug pravarte chhe tem.

66. Jyāre sattvaguṇnā kāryarūp gnān-tap vageremā ruchi utpanna thāy tyāre mārā hṛudaymā Satya-Yug pravartyo chhe tem jāṇavu. Rajoguṇnā kāryarūp dharma tathā ichchhāpūrti thāy tevā kāryomā jyāre ruchi utpanna thāy tyāre mārā hṛudaymā Tretā-Yug pravartyo chhe em jāṇavu. Jyāre rajoguṇ ane tamoguṇnā kāryarūp dharma tathā ichchhāpūrti thāya tevā kāryomā ane lobhādikmā ruchi utpanna thāy tyāre mārā hṛudaymā Dvāpar-Yug pravartyo chhe em jāṇavu. Tamoguṇnā kāryarūp asatya, hinsā, nidrā ādikmā jyāre ruchi utpanna thāy, tyāre mārā hṛudaymā Kaḷi-Yug pravartyo chhe em jāṇavu. Te Bhāgwat (12/3/26-30)mā “Sattvam rajastam iti” ā shlokne ārambhīne “Yadā māyānṛutam tandrā” ityādik pāch shlokthī nirupaṇ karyu chhe. Āṭalo tātparya chhe.
67. Ane kevā guṇvāḷāe kevī bhakti karavānī hoy te paṇ kaho?
69. Parantu mandir, maṭh athavā sampradāy vagerene ‘sthān’ shabdathī na jāṇavā, eṭalu Mahārājnu tātparya chhe.
88: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 14 Chaudashne divas Shrījī Mahārāj sarve santnu manḍaḷ laīne Gām Kunḍaḷthī chālyā, te vāṭmā Gām Khāmbhaḍe āvyā ne tyā pīparnā vṛukṣh heṭhe ūtaryā. Pachhī te gāmnā māṇase ḍholiyo lāvīne te upar padharāvyā. Ane te same Shrījī Mahārāje sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potāne chāre kore sādhu tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā beṭhī hatī.

Ane sādhu kīrtan gātā hatā. Te kīrtan rakhāvīne Shrījī Mahārāje te gāmnā māṇas āgaḷ vāt karī je, “Ā sansārne viṣhe dharmavāḷā ne adharmī e be prakārnā māṇas chhe. Temā dharmavāḷā je māṇas hoy te chorī tathā parstrīno sang tathā chāḍīchugalī e ādik sarve pāpno tyāg karīne ne Parameshvarthī ḍarīne dharma-maryādāmā chāle chhe, teno sansārmā je potānā kuṭumbī hoy athavā koī bījā hoy paṇ te sarve vishvās kare ne te je bole te vachan saune satya ja bhāse. Ane evā je dharmavāḷā hoy tene ja sāchā santno samāgam game. Ane je adharmī māṇas hoy te to chorī, parstrīno sang, madya-mānsnu bhakṣhaṇ, vaṭalvu, vaṭalāvavu e ādik je sarve kukarma tene viṣhe ja bharpūr hoy, ne teno sansārmā koī vishvās kare ja nahī ne enā sagā hoy te paṇ koī eno vishvās na kare. Ane evā je adharmī hoy tene sāchā santno samāgam to game ja nahī ane jo koī bījo te santno samāgam kare to teno paṇ droh kare. Māṭe jene kalyāṇne ichchhavu tene adharmīne mārge chālavu ja nahī ane dharmavāḷāne mārge chālīne sāchā santno samāgam karavo, to nishchay ja e jīvnu kalyāṇ thāy, emā kāī sanshay nathī.” Eṭalī vārtā karī, tene sāmbhaḷīne te gāmnā keṭalāk māṇase Shrījī Mahārājno āshray karyo.

Pachhī tyāthī Shrījī Mahārāj pāchhā Sārangpur padhāryā. Pachhī Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar virājmān thayā ne te same pote sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Golok, Vaikunṭh, Shvetdvīp, Brahmapur e sarve je Bhagwānnā dhām tene bāhyadraṣhṭie karīne joīe to ghaṇā chheṭe chhe ane ātmadraṣhṭie karīne joīe to ek aṇu jeṭalu paṇ chheṭu nathī. Māṭe bāhyadraṣhṭivāḷānī samajaṇ chhe te mithyā[70] chhe ane ātmadraṣhṭivāḷānī samajaṇ chhe te satya[71] chhe. Ane je sādhu em samajato hoy je,[72] ‘Mārā chaitanyane viṣhe Bhagwān sadāya virājmān chhe; te jem dehmā jīv hoy tem mārā jīvne viṣhe Bhagwān rahyā chhe, ane māro jīv chhe te to sharīr chhe ane Bhagwān to mārā jīvanā sharīrī chhe.’ Ane potānā jīvātmāne sthūḷ, sūkṣhma ane kāraṇ e traṇ sharīr thakī pṛuthak māne ane tene viṣhe akhanḍ Bhagwān virājmān chhe[73] em je samaje, to te sant thakī Bhagwān athavā Bhagwānnā dhām te aṇumātra chheṭe nathī. Ane evī rītno je sant hoy te to jevo Shvetdvīpmā mukta chhe te sarakho chhe. Ane evā santnu darshan thayu tyāre em jāṇavu je, ‘Mane sākṣhātkār Bhagwānnu darshan thayu.’ Ne evī samajaṇvāḷo je sant te to kṛutārth chhe. Ane jene āvī samajaṇ to āvī shake nahī, ne jo te santnā samāgammā paḍyo rahe ne te sant nitya pāch khāsaḍā māre to paṇ te apamānnu sahan kare ne santno samāgam mūkī shake nahī; jem afīṇno bandhāṇī hoy te tene mūkī shakato nathī, tem e paṇ koī rīte santno samāgam tajī shake nahī; to jevā pratham sant kahyā te sarakho ene paṇ jāṇavo ane jevī prāpti te santne thāy chhe tevī ja je sant-samāgammā paḍyo rahe chhe tene paṇ thāy chhe.”
૭૦. અંતર્દૃષ્ટિવાળાની અપેક્ષાએ બાહ્યદૃષ્ટિ ઓછી લાભદાયક છે તેવો ‘મિથ્યા’ શબ્દનો અર્થ જાણવો.
૭૨. અંતર્દૃષ્ટિથી પોતાની સમીપે ભગવાનનાં ધામ જોવાનો પ્રકાર કહે છે.
૭૩. જ્યાં પ્રગટ ભગવાન વિરાજમાન છે ત્યાં જ તેમનું અક્ષરધામ અને મુક્તો છે.
70. Antardraṣhṭivāḷānī apekṣhāe bāhyadraṣhṭi ochhī lābhdāyak chhe tevo ‘mithyā’ shabdano arth jāṇavo.
72. Antardraṣhṭithī potānī samīpe Bhagwānnā dhām jovāno prakār kahe chhe.
73. Jyā pragaṭ Bhagwān virājmān chhe tyā ja temanu Akṣhardhām ane mukto chhe.
89: Samvat 1877nā Shrāvaṇ vadi 30 Amāsne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Puruṣh-prayatna shāstramā kahyu chhe, te puruṣh-prayatne karīne keṭalu kām thāy chhe ane Parameshvarnī kṛupāe karīne keṭalu kām thāy chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Sadguru ne satshāstrane vachane karīne draḍh vairāgyane pāmyo hoy ane draḍh shraddhāvān hoy ane aṣhṭ prakārnu je brahmacharya tene ati draḍh pāḷato hoy ane ahinsādharmane viṣhe prītivān hoy ane ātmaniṣhṭhā paṇ ati paripakva hoy, to tene māthethī janma-maraṇnī nivṛutti thaī jāy chhe. Jem shāḷne[74] māthethī fotaru ūtaryu te shāḷ pāchhī ūge nahī, tem kahyā eve guṇe karīne je yukta hoy te anādi agnānrūp je māyā tethī chhūṭe chhe ne janma-maraṇ thakī rahit thāy chhe ne ātmasattāne pāme chhe. Āṭalu to puruṣh-prayatne karīne thāy chhe. Ane Parameshvarnī kṛupā paṇ je eve lakṣhaṇe yukta hoy te upar ja thāy chhe. Ane jyāre Parameshvarnī kṛupā thāy tyāre e Bhagwānno ekāntik bhakta thāy chhe. Ane Shrutie kahyu chhe je, ‘Niranjanah paramam sāmyamupaiti.’[75] E Shrutino e arth chhe je, anjan je māyā te thakī je rahit thayo te Bhagwānnā tulyapaṇāne pāme chhe; kahetān jem Bhagwān shubh-ashubh karme karīne bandhātā nathī, tem te mukta paṇ shubh-ashubh karme karīne bandhāy nahī. Ane jem Lakṣhmījī chhe te hete karīne kyārek to Bhagwānnā swarūpmā līn thaī jāy chhe ne kyārek to nokhā rahyā thakā Bhagwānnī sevāmā rahe chhe, tem te bhakta paṇ atishay hete karīne Bhagwānne viṣhe kyārek to līn thaī jāy chhe ane kyārek to mūrtimān thako Bhagwānnī sevāmā rahe chhe. Ane jem Bhagwān swatantra chhe tem e Bhagwānno bhakta paṇ swatantra thāy chhe. Āvī rītnī je sāmarthī te to Bhagwānnī kṛupā thakī āve chhe.”

Pachhī Nityānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Jemā e sarve ang sampūrṇa hoy tenī upar to Bhagwānnī kṛupā thāy chhe, ane jo e angmāthī kāīk nyūntā hoy to tenī shī gati thāy chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Vairāgya, brahmacharya, shraddhā, ahinsā-dharma ane ātmaniṣhṭhā emāthī koī angmā nyūntā hoy to ātyantik mokṣh je Bhagwānnu Akṣhardhām tene to na pāme, ane e vinā bījā je Bhagwānnā dhām chhe tene pāme. Athavā vadhu savāsanik hoy to devlokne pāme, je devlokne Bhagwānnā dhām āgaḷ Mokṣhadharmane viṣhe narak tulya kahyā chhe,[76] ane devtāmāthī manuṣhya thāy ne manuṣhyamāthī vaḷī devtā thāy. Ane ‘Anek-janma-sansiddhastato yāti parām gatim.’[77] E shlokno paṇ e ja arth chhe je, je Bhagwānno bhakta savāsanik hoy te narak-chorāsīmā to na jāy ane devtāmā ne manuṣhyamā to anant janma dhare. Pachhī jyāre pūrve kahyā evā vairāgyādik lakṣhaṇe yukta thāy tyāre ja Bhagwānnī kṛupānu pātra thāy ane pachhī Bhagwānno ekāntik bhakta thaīne Guṇātīt evu je Bhagwānnu Akṣhardhām tene pāme chhe. Māṭe ek janme athavā anant janme paṇ je divas pratham kahyā eve lakṣhaṇe yukta thaīne atishay nirvāsanik thashe tyāre ja Bhagwānnī kṛupānu pātra thashe ne ātyantik mokṣhane pāmashe, paṇ te vinā to nahī ja pāme.”

Pachhī Nṛusinhānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Ā dehe karīne ja sarve kasarmātra maṭī jāy evo koī upāy chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jo khabaḍdār thaīne manḍe to ā ne ā dehe ja sarve kasar maṭī jāy. Athavā deh paryant kasar na maṭī hoy ane ant same ja nirvāsanik thāy ne Bhagwānne viṣhe atishay prīti thāy to antkāḷe paṇ Bhagwānnī kṛupā thāy ne Bhagwānnā dhāmne pāme. Māṭe ek dehe athavā anant dehe athavā ant same ek ghaḍī mṛutyu āḍī rahī hoy tyāre paṇ jo atishay Bhagwānne viṣhe vṛutti joḍāī jāy to te bhaktane koī jātnī kasar rahetī nathī.”

1. ‘Chaff’ in the original publication has been changed to ‘husk’ (ફોતરું), since ‘chaff’ refers to the loose, papery debris, stems, and husk fragments separated during winnowing. Husk is the actual protective outer shell tightly enclosing an individual paddy/rice grain. In agricultural practice, de-husking paddy (શાળ) destroys seed viability, illustrating why the liberated soul cannot take rebirth.

2. निरञ्जनः परमं साम्यमुपैति॥
He who is free from [the] blemishes [of māyā] attains qualities similar to those of the Supreme Being, [i.e., God]. - Mundaka Upanishad: III-3.1

3. अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
[A yogi who...] has become realised after many lives attains the highest state of enlightenment. - Bhagwad Gitā: 6.45
૭૬. જુઓ વચનામૃત સા. ૧, ટીપણી-૪: [“એતે વૈ નિરયાસ્તાત સ્થાનસ્ય પરમાત્મનઃ” (મહાભારત, શાંતિપર્વ: ૧૯૧/૬) આ શ્લોકથી કહ્યું છે.]
76. Juo Vachanāmṛut Sā. 1, ṭīpaṇī-4: [“Ete vai nirayāstāt sthānasya paramātmanah” (Mahābhārat, Shāntiparva: 191/6) ā shlokthī kahyu chhe.]
90: Samvat 1877nā Bhādarvā sudi 1 Paḍavāne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Nirvikārānand Swāmīe prashna pūchhyo je, “Sādhune viṣhe kayā guṇ akhanḍ rahe chhe ne kayā guṇ āve-jāy evā chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ek to ātmaniṣhṭhā ane bījo swadharma ane trījo Bhagwānnā swarūpno nishchay e traṇ guṇ[78] to akhanḍ rahe chhe ane bījā guṇ to āve kharā ne pāchhā jāy paṇ kharā. Māṭe bījā guṇ to āvyā-gayā rahe chhe ane e traṇ guṇ to akhanḍ rahe chhe.”

Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Dehnī ne ātmānī nokhī vikti samajāṇī hoy toy paṇ te viktine bhūlīne pāchho dehābhimānī kem thāy chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Deh-ātmānī vikti ek vār chokhī samajāṇī hoy to pachhī pāchhī bhulāy nahī; ane em māne je, ‘Hu deh chhu,’ to paṇ deh potānu rūp manāy ja nahī. Ane Bhagwānno nishchay paṇ jo ek vār draḍh thayo hoy to pāchho ṭāḷe to paṇ ṭaḷe nahī. Ane em jaṇāy chhe je, ātmabuddhi maṭīne dehbuddhi āvī jāy chhe; e to khoṭo khoṭo manmā bhram paḍe chhe, paṇ dehābhimān to āvatu ja nathī. Ane evo je paripakva gnānī tene to ātmānu ja abhimān draḍh rahe chhe ne te potānā ātmāne brahmarūp māne chhe ane te brahmane viṣhe Parabrahma je Puruṣhottam Bhagwān te akhanḍ virājmān chhe ane te Bhagwānnā swarūpno nishchay paṇ ene akhanḍ ne akhanḍ rahe chhe.”

Pachhī Swayamprakāshānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Potānā ātmāno vichār kem karavo?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jyāre antahkaraṇ sāmu draṣhṭā evo je jīvātmā te joī rahe tyāre bāher je sthūḷ sharīr ane te sambandhī je viṣhay te sarve vīsarī jāy chhe, ane antahkaraṇ ne draṣhṭā e benā vachchamā je vichār ṭhare chhe te vichāre karīne man, buddhi, chitta, ahankār e sarvanā rūpne jāṇavā. Pachhī vichārnī draṣhṭie antahkaraṇnā ghāṭ sāmu jotā jotā jyāre ghāṭ bandh thaī jāy tyāre Bhagwānnī mūrtinu dhyān karavu ane jyā sudhī ghāṭ-sankalpnu baḷ hoy tyā sudhī to sankalp sāmu joī rahevu, paṇ dhyān na karavu. Ane je bāher sthūḷ dehne viṣhe panch gnān-indriyo chhe, te jyāre pot-potānā viṣhay sāmā jāy chhe tyāre vichārne be prakāre karavo: ek to je viṣhayne ākāre indriyo thayā hoy te viṣhayne ākāre vichār karavo,[79] ane bījo te indriyonā golakne viṣhe je jonāro draṣhṭā chhe te draṣhṭāne ākāre vichār karavo.[80] Pachhī viṣhayne ākāre ne draṣhṭāne ākāre e be prakāre je vichār chhe te ek thaī jāy chhe; pachhī te viṣhaymāthī vṛutti atishay tūṭī jāy chhe. Ane em vichāryā vinā jo balātkāre karīne viṣhaymāthī vṛuttine toḍe to te vṛuttine viṣhaymāthī prīti maṭe nahī ane jyāre vichārīne vṛuttine pāchhī vāḷe tyāre te vṛutti pāchhī viṣhaymā joḍāy ja nahī. Māṭe jyā sudhī indriyonī vṛuttine viṣhay sanmukh prīti hoy tyā sudhī Bhagwānnu dhyān karavu nahī ne jyāre indriyonī vṛutti sthir thāy tyāre Bhagwānnu dhyān karavu. Ane jyāre bāher sthūḷ dehmā draṣhṭā vartato hoy tyāre chokho vibhāg karī rākhavo je, jyāre sthūḷ dehmā vartavu tyāre sūkṣhma dehnā ghāṭ sāmu to jovu ja nahī ane jyāre antahkaraṇ sanmukh jovu tyāre sthūḷ dehne visārī devu. Ane draṣhṭāne ne drashyane madhye je vichār chhe te vichāre karīne em samajavu je, ‘draṣhṭā ne drashya te atishay judā ja chhe,’ em samajīne dehnā bhāv te dehne viṣhe homavā ane draṣhṭā je chaitanya tenā bhāv te chaitanyane viṣhe homavā. Ane bāḷ, yauvan, vṛuddha, sthūḷ, kṛush, jīvavu, maravu e sarve dehnā bhāv chhe, te ātmāne viṣhe mānavā ja nahī; ane achhedya, abhedya, ajar, amar, gnānrūp, sukhrūp, sattārūp e je ātmānā bhāv chhe, te koī kāḷe dehne viṣhe samajavā ja nahī, e guṇ to ātmāne viṣhe samajavā. Evo je vichār te jyā sudhī ghāṭ-sankalpnu baḷ hoy tyā sudhī mūkavo nahī. Jem rājā hoy te jyā sudhī shatrunu baḷ hoy tyā sudhī rāj-gādīe besīne sukh bhogave nahī ane jyāre shatrumātrano nāsh thaī jāy tyāre potānā rājyanā je vaibhav chhe tene bhogave chhe; tem je Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene jyā sudhī man ne indriyorūpī shatru pīḍatā hoy tyā sudhī pūrve kahyo evo je vichār te draḍhpaṇe rākhavo ane jyāre man-indriyonā ghāṭ sarve shamī jāy tyāre Parameshvarnā swarūpnu dhyān karavu.”

1. Vairāgya should be included in ātmā-realization and bhakti should be included in faith in God (nishchay). Hence, the purport is that the four aspects of ekāntik dharma - dharma, gnān, vairāgya, and bhakti - all remain constantly in a Sant.
2. That the body and the vishays are a form of misery, cause of bondage, perishable, etc.
3. That the ātmā is eternally blissful, free from all faults, imperishable, etc.

૭૮. અહીં તે ત્રણે ગુણ અંતર્ગત આત્મનિષ્ઠાથી વૈરાગ્ય (વચનામૃત ગઢડા પ્રથમ ૭૩) અને નિશ્ચયથી ભક્તિ (વચનામૃત ગઢડા મધ્ય ૧૦) એ બે પણ જાણી લેવા. અને તેથી જ એકાંતિક ધર્મ સંબંધી ગુણો અખંડ રહે છે એવું તાત્પર્ય છે. (વચનામૃત ગઢડા અંત્ય ૧૩)
૭૯. દેહ અને વિષયો દુઃખરૂપ છે, બંધનકર્તા છે, નાશવંત છે, એવો.
૮૦. આત્મા સદા સુખરૂપ છે, સર્વદોષે રહિત છે, અવિનાશી છે, એવો.

78. Ahī te traṇe guṇ antargat ātmaniṣhṭhāthī vairāgya (Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Pratham 73) ane nishchayathī bhakti (Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 10) e be paṇ jāṇī levā. Ane tethī ja ekāntik dharma sambandhī guṇo akhanḍ rahe chhe evu tātparya chhe. (Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Antya 13)
79. Deh ane viṣhayo dukhrūp chhe, bandhan-kartā chhe, nāshvant chhe, evo.
80. Ātmā sadā sukhrūp chhe, sarva-doṣhe rahit chhe, avināshī chhe, evo.
91: Samvat 1877nā Bhādarvā sudi 2 Bījne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Sārangpur madhye Jīvā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.
