42. Temā sarva yogkaḷāo hoy tathā tyāg ne aṣhṭāng-yog hoy ane ras to ek shānt nāmno ja hoy ane.
69. Nav ras: shṛungār, hāsya, karuṇ, raudra, vīr, bhayānak, bībhatsa, ad‌bhut, shānt.
211: Samvat 1882nā Poṣh sudi 15 Pūnamne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā darabārmā līmbaḍānā vṛukṣh heṭhe pāṭ upar gādītakiyā nankhāvīne virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe shvet puṣhpanā hār paheryā hatā ne karṇanī upar puṣhpanā guchchha khosyā hatā ne pāghne viṣhe puṣhpanā torā laṭakatā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni-manḍaḷ samasta tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Amāro to evo swabhāv chhe je, ek to Bhagwān ne bījā Bhagwānnā bhakta ne trījā brāhmaṇ ne chotho koīk garīb manuṣhya e chārthī to ame atishay bīe chhīe je, ‘Rakhe emano droh thaī jāy nahī!’ Ane evā to bījā koīthī ame bītā nathī. Kem je, e chār vinā bījāno koīk droh kare to tenā dehno nāsh thāy paṇ jīv nāsh pāme nahī, ane e chārmāthī ekno jo droh kare to teno jīv paṇ nāsh pāmī jāy chhe.”

E vātne sāmbhaḷīne Muktānand Swāmīne prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Jīv to avināshī kahyo chhe, teno nāsh te kem jāṇavo?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Parvatnu ke bīju evu ja je koīk jaḍ deh āve temā koī kāḷe jīvnu kalyāṇ thāy nahī; eṭale enā jīvno nāsh thaī gayo em jāṇavu. Māṭe jene potānu kalyāṇ ichchhavu tene e chārmāthī koīno droh na karavo. Ane vaḷī Bhagwān ke Bhagwānnā bhakta te āgaḷ koī prakāre mān rākhavu nahī; kem je, mān chhe te to krodh, matsar, īrṣhyā ne droh eno ādhār chhe ane mānī hoy tenī bhakti paṇ āsurī kahevāy. Ane Bhagwānnā bhaktane jo bivarāvato hoy ne te Prabhuno bhakta hoy to paṇ tene asur jāṇavo. Ane amāro to e swabhāv chhe je, brāhmaṇno ne garībno ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano koīk droh kare, te to amane dīṭho ja game nahī ane ā lokmā ne parlokmā tene ne amāre sobat rahevānī nathī.” Eṭalī vārtā karīne pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje be pad gavarāvyā je, ‘Mārā Harajīshu Het Na Dīse Re Tene Gher Shīd Jaīe,’[44] ek to e ane bīju je, ‘Mārā Vahālājīshu Vahālap Dīse Re Teno Sang Kem Tajīe.’[44] Ane pachhī e be pad shīkhyānī satsangīmātrane āgnā karīne em kahyu je, “E be padmā vārtā chhe tene nitya gāīne sambhārī rākhavī.”

Em kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā Mandir āgaḷ ek manch hato te upar āvīne virājmān thayā. Pachhī Gopāḷānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Ā sansārne viṣhe je panḍit chhe te Shāstra, Purāṇ sarve vāche chhe paṇ tene Bhagwānno ne santno jem chhe tem mahimā kem samajāto nathī?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Shāstra, Purāṇ vāche chhe to kharā; paṇ ene Bhagwānno āsharo nathī. Māṭe kām, krodh, lobh, īrṣhyā, matsar teṇe enā jīvne haravī nākhyo chhe ane kāmādik je shatru te ene koī kāḷe māthu upāḍavā detā nathī. Pachhī te panḍit potānī peṭhe ja Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā santne samaje je, ‘Jem amārā kāmādik shatru koī kāḷe nivṛutti pāmatā nathī tem enā paṇ kāmādik shatru nivṛutti nahī pāmatā hoy.’ Em Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā santne viṣhe doṣh samaje. Māṭe Shāstra, Purāṇ vāche paṇ ene Bhagwān ke Bhagwānnā santnu jem chhe tem yathārth māhātmya samajātu nathī.”

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje Dīnānāth Bhaṭṭa tathā Muni-manḍaḷ samasta pratye prashna pūchhyo je, “Brahmaswarūp evā je satpuruṣh te to traṇ sharīr ne traṇ avasthā te thakī par vartatā hoy ane chaude indriyonī kriyā te potāne viṣhe eke mānatā na hoy, tene agnānī jīv chhe te oḷakhī shake nahī. Ane jyāre ene Moṭā-Puruṣhnā sarakhī sthiti thāy tyāre e Moṭā-Puruṣh jem varte chhe te satya manāy. Ane jyā sudhī e satpuruṣhno mahimā ene na jaṇāya tyā sudhī brahmaswarūpne viṣhe sthiti paṇ na thāy ne ātmāne viṣhe sthiti thayā vinā satpuruṣhno mahimā paṇ na jaṇāy. Māṭe paraspar virodh āvyo, te virodh ṭaḷe te upāya kaho.” Pachhī jenī jevī najar pūgī teṇe tevo uttar karyo paṇ e prashnanu samādhān thayu nahī. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Lyo, ame uttar karīe. Eno uttar to e chhe je, pṛuthvīne viṣhe je Bhagwānno avatār tene maḷelā je sant te sangāthe jyāre ene atishay prīti thāy, tyāre e satpuruṣhne viṣhe ene koī prakāre doṣh bhāse nahī. Ane jene je sangāthe draḍh het hoy tene teno avaguṇ koī prakāre āve ja nahī ane tenā vachan paṇ satya manāy. Evī rīte laukik mārgmā paṇ rīti chhe ane kalyāṇnā mārgmā paṇ rīti chhe. Māṭe satpuruṣhne viṣhe draḍh prīti e ja ātmadarshannu sādhan chhe ane satpuruṣhno mahimā jāṇyānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe ane Parameshvarnu sākṣhāt darshan thavānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe.”

1. મારા હરજી શું હેત ન દીસે રે, તેને ઘેર શીદ જઈએ...
Why should one even visit the home of a person who has no love for my Lord?

2. મારા વહાલાજી શું વહાલપ દીસે રે, તેનો સંગ શીદ તજીએ...
Why should one forsake the company of a person who harbours love for my Lord?
212: Samvat 1882nā Poṣh vadi 2 Bījne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā darabārmā līmbaḍānā vṛukṣh taḷe pāṭ upar gādītakiye yukta ḍholiyo hato te upar virājmān hatā ane shvet khes paheryo hato ne māhelī kore shvet pachheḍīe yukta gulābī rangnī shāl oḍhī hatī ane mastak upar shvet pāgh bāndhī hatī ane kanṭhne viṣhe gulābnā puṣhpano hār paheryo hato ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni-manḍaḷ tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Ane te same Shrījī Mahārāj antardraṣhṭi karīne bahu vār sudhī virājmān thayā hatā. Pachhī netrakamaḷne ughāḍīne sarve haribhaktanī sabhā sāmu karuṇā-kaṭākṣhe karī joīne Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Āj to sarvene nishchaynī vāt karavī chhe, te sarve sāvadhān thaīne sāmbhaḷo je, anant koṭi sūrya, chandramā ne agni te sarakhu prakāshmān evu je Akṣhardhām tene viṣhe Shrī Puruṣhottam Bhagwān sadā divyamūrti thakā virājmān chhe. Ane te ja Bhagwān jīvonā kalyāṇane arthe pṛuthvīne viṣhe Rām-Kṛuṣhṇādik avatārnu dhāraṇ kare chhe. Tyāre te Bhagwānnā swarūpno jene satsamāgame karīne draḍh nishchay thāy chhe, teno jīv bījnā chandramānī peṭhe divase divase vṛuddhine pāmato jāy chhe. Ane jem chandramāne viṣhe jem jem sūryanī kaḷā āvatī jāy tem tem te chandramā vṛuddhine pāmato jāy chhe, te jyāre pūrṇamāsī āve tyāre chandramā sanpūrṇa thāy chhe. Tem Bhagwānno paripūrṇa nishchay thayā mor to e jīv amāvāsyānā chandranī peṭhe kaḷāe rahit khadyot jevo hoy; pachhī jem jem Parameshvarnā mahimāe sahit nishchayne pāme chhe tem tem vṛuddhine pāmīne pūrṇamāsīnā chandra jevo e jīvātmā thāy chhe. Pachhī ene indriyo, antahkaraṇ nishchaymāthī ḍagāvavāne samarth nathī thatā. Ane Parameshvar game tevā charitra kare to paṇ tene koī rīte Bhagwānne viṣhe doṣh bhāsato ja nathī. Evo jene mahimāe sahit Bhagwānno nishchay hoy te bhakta nirbhay thaī chūkyo. Ane te ja bhaktane jo kyārek asat desh, asat kāḷ, asat sang ane asat shāstrādikne yoge karīne athavā dehābhimāne karīne Bhagwānnā charitrane viṣhe sandeh thāy ne Bhagwānno abhāv āve to e jīv pūrṇamāsīnā chandramā jevo hato paṇ pāchho amāvāsyānā chandra jevo thaī jāy chhe. Māṭe potāmā je kāīk thoḍī-ghaṇī khoṭya hoy te e jīvne zāzī naḍatī nathī, paṇ Parameshvarnā charitramā koī rīte sandeh thāy athavā Parameshvarno koī rīte abhāv āve tyāre e jīv kalyāṇnā mārgmāthī tatkāḷ paḍī jāy chhe. Jem vṛukṣhnā mūḷ kapāṇā tyāre te vṛukṣh enī meḷe ja sukāī jāy, tem jene Bhagwānne viṣhe koī rīte doṣh-buddhi thaī e jīv koī rīte vimukh thayā vinā rahe nahī. Ane jene nishchaynu ang durbaḷ hoy ne te satsangmā hoy to paṇ tene evā ghāṭ thāy je, ‘Shu jāṇīe māru te kalyāṇ thashe ke nahī thāy? Ane hu jyāre marīsh tyāre devatā thaīsh ke rājā thaīsh ke bhūt thaīsh?’ Jene Bhagwānnā swarūpno paripūrṇa nishchay na hoy tene evā ghāṭ thāy. Ane jene paripūrṇa nishchay hoy te to em samaje je, ‘Mane to Bhagwān maḷyā te divasthī ja māru kalyāṇ thaī chūkyu chhe. Ane je māru darshan karashe ke mārī vārtā sāmbhaḷashe te jīv paṇ sarva pāp thakī mukāīne param padne pāmashe.’ Māṭe evī rīte Bhagwānno mahimā sahit nishchay rākhīne potāne viṣhe kṛutārthpaṇu mānavu, e vāt sarve khabaḍdār thaīne rākhajyo.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje kahyu je, “‘Dhanya Vṛundāvanvāsī Vaṭnī Chhāyā Re Jyā Hari Besatā’,[45] e māhātmyanu kīrtan gāvo.” Pachhī te kīrtan gāyu. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Evī rīte Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwāne paṇ Bhāgwatmā kahyu chhe je,

‘Aho amī devavarāmarārchitam pādāmbujam te sumanahfalārhaṇam;
Namantyupādāya shikhābhirātmanastamopahatyai tarujanma yatkṛutam.’[46]

“Em Parameshvarnā yogne pāmīne vṛukṣhno janma hoy te paṇ kṛutārth thāy chhe; māṭe je vṛukṣh taḷe Bhagwān beṭhā hoy te vṛukṣhne paṇ param padnu adhikārī jāṇavu. Ane jenā hṛudaymā evo Bhagwānno mahimā sahit draḍh nishchay na hoy tene to napunsak jevo jāṇavo, te ene vachane karīne koī jīvno uddhār thavāno nahī. Jem rājā hoy te napunsak hoy ne tenu rājya jatu hoy ne vansh jato hoy, paṇ e thakī tenī strīne putra thāy nahī; ane sarva mulakmāthī potā jevā napunsakne teḍāvīne te strīne sange rākhe to paṇ strīne putra thāy nahī. Tem jene Bhagwānno mahimā sahit nishchay nathī to tene mukhe Gītā, Bhāgwat jevā sadgranth sāmbhaḷe paṇ teṇe karīne koīnu kalyāṇ nathī thatu. Ane vaḷī jem dūdh ne sākar hoy ne temā sarpnī lāḷ paḍī, pachhī ene je koī pīe tenā prāṇ jāy. Tem māhātmya sahit je Bhagwānno nishchay teṇe rahit evo je jīv tenā mukh thakī Gītā, Bhāgwatne sāmbhaḷe teṇe karīne koīnu kalyāṇ thatu nathī, emāthī to mūḷagu bhūnḍu thāy chhe.”

1. ધન્ય વૃંદાવનવાસી વટની છાયા રે, જ્યાં હરિ બેસતા...
Glorious are the shades of the banyan trees of Vrundāvan, where the Lord often sat.

2. अहो अमी देववरामरार्चितं पादाम्बुजं ते सुमनःफलार्हणम्।
नमन्त्युपादाय शिखाभिरात्मनस्तमोऽपहत्यै तरु जन्म यत्कृतम्॥
O these [trees] offer at your holy feet - which are worshiped by the chief deity [Indra] and the immortals [i.e. other deities such as Brahmā, etc.] - fruits and flowers, and bow before you with their heads [i.e. their branches and leaves] to eradicate their darkness [of ignorance] which caused their birth as trees! - Shrimad Bhāgwat: 10.15.5
૪૬. અહો! આશ્ચર્યની વાત છે કે આ વૃક્ષો, જેને તમોગુણી કર્મથી આવો જન્મ મળ્યો છે તે, દેવતાએ પૂજેલાં તમારાં ચરણારવિંદને, પોતાનાં તામસી કર્મના નાશ માટે પુષ્પ-ફળાદિ સામગ્રી વડે પૂજે છે! (ભાગવત: ૧૦/૧૫/૫).

46. Aho! Āshcharyanī vāt chhe ke ā vṛukṣho, jene tamoguṇī karmathī āvo janma maḷyo chhe te, devatāe pūjelā tamārā charaṇārvindne, potānā tāmasī karmanā nāsh māṭe puṣhpa-faḷādi sāmagrī vaḍe pūje chhe! (Bhāgwat: 10/15/5).
213: Samvat 1882nā Poṣh vadi 7 Saptamīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā darabārmā līmbaḍānā vṛukṣhnī taḷe pāṭ upar gādītakiyā nankhāvīne virājmān hatā ane angne viṣhe sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe shvet puṣhpanā hār paheryā hatā ane hasta-kamaḷe karīne ek dāḍamnu faḷ uchhāḷatā hatā. Ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī ane Shrījī Mahārājne upar sonāne īnḍāe sahit chhatra virājmān hatu. Evī shobhāne dharatā thakā Shrījī Mahārāj virājmān hatā.

Te samaymā Gām Bhādaraṇnā Pāṭīdār Bhagubhāī Shrījī Mahārāj pāse āvyā hatā. Teṇe pūchhyu je, “He Mahārāj! Ā samādhi te kem thatī hashe?”[47] Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jīvonā kalyāṇne arthe ā Bharat Khanḍmā Bhagwān avatār dhare chhe. Te Bhagwān jyāre rājārūpe hoy tyāre to ogaṇchāḷīsh lakṣhaṇe yukta hoy ane Datta, Kapil jevā sādhurūpe hoy tyāre to trīs lakṣhaṇe yukta hoy.[48] Te Bhagwānnī mūrti dekhavāmā to manuṣhya sarakhī ja āvatī hoy, paṇ e atishay alaukik mūrti chhe. Jem pṛuthvīne viṣhe sarve patharā chhe tem chamakpāṇ paṇ patharo chhe, paṇ chamakpāṇmā sahaje evo chamatkār rahyo chhe je, chamaknā parvatne samīpe vahāṇ jāy tyāre tenā khīlā chamaknā pāṇā pāse taṇāī jāy chhe. Tem Bhagwānnī je mūrti rājārūpe chhe ne sādhurūpe chhe, te mūrtinu jyāre je jīv shraddhāe karīne darshan kare chhe tenā indriyo Bhagwān sāmā taṇāī jāy chhe, tyāre samādhi thāy chhe. Jem Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnu darshan karīne Gokuḷvāsī sarvene samādhi thaī hatī ane Bhagwāne te samādhimā potānu dhām dekhāḍyu hatu.[49] Tevī rīte je je samaymā Bhagwānnā avatār hoy te te samaymā Bhagwānnī mūrtine viṣhe evo chamatkār jarūr hoy. Te je shraddhāe yukta Bhagwānnā darshan kare tenā indriyo sarve Bhagwān sāmā taṇāī jāy ane tatkāḷ samādhi thāy. Ane koīk samaymā Bhagwānne ghaṇāk jīvne potāne sanmukh karavā hoy tyāre to abhakta jīv hoy athavā pashu hoy tene paṇ Bhagwānne joīne samādhi thaī jāy chhe, to Bhagwānnā bhaktane thāy emā shu āshcharya chhe?”

Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Brahma chhe te to sarvatra vyāpak chhe em sarve kahe chhe; te je vyāpak hoy tene mūrtimān kem kahevāy ane je mūrtimān hoy tene vyāpak kem kahevāy? E prashna chhe.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Brahma to ekdeshī chhe paṇ sarvadeshī nathī ne te Brahma te Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān chhe te ekdeshī thakā sarvadeshī chhe. Jem koīk puruṣhe sūryanī upāsanā karī hoy pachhī sūrya tene potānā sarakhī draṣhṭi āpe, tyāre te puruṣh jyā sudhī sūryanī draṣhṭi pahochatī hoy tyā sudhī dekhe. Ane vaḷī jem siddha-dashāvāḷo puruṣh hoy te hajāro ne lākho gāu upar koīk vāt karato hoy tene jem pāse vārtā kare ne sāmbhaḷe tem sāmbhaḷe, tem ja lākho gāu upar kāīk vastu paḍī hoy tene manuṣhyanā jevaḍā hāth hoy teṇe karīne paṇ upāḍe; tem Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān paṇ ek ṭhekāṇe rahyā thakā potānī ichchhāe karīne jyā darshan devā hoy tyā darshan āpe chhe ane ekrūp thakā anantrūpe bhāse chhe. Ane siddha hoy temā paṇ dūrshravaṇ, dūrdarshanrūp chamatkār hoy, to Parameshvarmā hoy temā shu āshcharya chhe? Ane Bhagwānne granthmā vyāpak kahyā chhe, te to mūrtimān chhe te ja potānī sāmarthīe karīne ek ṭhekāṇe rahyā thakā sarvane darshan āpe chhe, em vyāpak kahyā chhe; paṇ ākāshnī peṭhe arūp thakā vyāpak nathī, Bhagwān to sadā mūrtimān ja chhe. Te mūrtimān Bhagwān Akṣhardhāmmā rahyā thakā ja anant koṭi brahmānḍmā bhāse chhe.”
૪૭. અષ્ટાંગયોગ સિદ્ધ થયા પછી સમાધિ થવાનો નિયમ છે. તે વિના પણ તમારાં દર્શનમાત્રથી જ કેટલાકને સમાધિ થાય છે, તે થવામાં શો હેતુ છે? એવો પ્રશ્નાર્થ સમજવો.
૪૮. ભગવાનનાં ઓગણચાલીસ તથા ત્રીસ લક્ષણો, તેના અર્થો તથા સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંક અનુક્રમે વચનામૃત ગ. પ્ર. ૬૨ની ટીપણી-૨૩૫ તથા ગ. પ્ર. ૭૭ની ટીપણી-૩૧૨માં નિરૂપ્યાં છે.
47. Aṣhṭāng-yog siddha thayā pachhī samādhi thavāno niyam chhe. Te vinā paṇ tamārā darshan-mātrathī ja keṭalākne samādhi thāy chhe, te thavāmā sho hetu chhe? Evo prashnārth samajavo.
48. Bhagwānnā ogaṇchālīs tathā trīs lakṣhaṇo, tenā artho tathā sandarbh kramānk anukrame Vachanāmṛut G. Pra. 62nī ṭīpaṇī-235 tathā G. Pra. 77nī ṭīpaṇī-312mā nirūpyā chhe.
214: Samvat 1882nā Poṣh vadi 9 Navmīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā Mandir āgaḷ virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Vaḍodarānā Vāghmoḍiyā Rāmchandre Shrījī Mahārājne prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Je kupātra jīv jaṇāto hoy ne tene paṇ samādhi thaī jāy chhe tenu shu kāraṇ hashe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Dharmashāstrane viṣhe je varṇāshramnā dharma kahyā chhe te thakī je bāhya vartato hoy tene sarve lok em jāṇe je, ‘Ā kupātra māṇas chhe.’ Ane te kupātrane Bhagwān ke Bhagwānnā santno jo haiyāmā guṇ āve to ene e moṭu puṇya thāy chhe ane varṇāshramnā dharma lopyā hatā tenu je pāp lāgyu hatu te sarve nāsh thaī jāy chhe ane te jīv atishay pavitra thaī jāy chhe. Māṭe ene Bhagwānnā swarūpmā chitta choṭe chhe tyāre samādhi thaī jāy chhe. Ane je puruṣh Dharmashāstre kahyā evā je varṇāshramnā dharma tene pāḷato hoy tyāre tene sarve lok dharmavāḷo jāṇe; paṇ Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā sādhu teno jo te droh karato hoy, to te satpuruṣhnā drohnu evu pāp lāge chhe je, varṇāshramnā dharma pāḷyānu je puṇya tene bāḷīne bhasma karī nākhe chhe. Māṭe satpuruṣhnā drohno karanāro te to panch mahāpāpno karanāro tethī paṇ vadhu pāpī chhe. Shā māṭe je, panch mahāpāp karyā hoy te to satpuruṣhne āshare jaīne chhuṭāya chhe, paṇ satpuruṣhno droh kare teno to koī ṭhekāṇe chhūṭyāno upāy nathī. Kem je, anya ṭhekāṇe pāp karyu hoy te to tīrthmā jaīne chhuṭāy chhe ane tīrthmā jaīne pāp kare te to vajralep thāy chhe. Māṭe satpuruṣhno āsharo kare tyāre game tevo pāpī hoy to paṇ ati pavitra thaī jāy chhe ne tene samādhi thaī jāy chhe. Ane satpuruṣhno drohī hoy ne te game tevo dharmavāḷo jaṇāto hoy to paṇ mahāpāpī chhe ne tene koī kāḷe Bhagwānnā darshan hṛudayne viṣhe thāy ja nahī. Māṭe jene vimukh jīv pāpī jāṇe chhe te pāpī nathī ane jene vimukh dharmī jāṇe chhe te dharmī nathī.”
215: Samvat 1882nā Poṣh vadi 11 Ekādashīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā Mandir āgaḷ līmbaḍānā vṛukṣh heṭhe manch upar gādītakiyā bichhavāvīne virājmān hatā ane kinkhābno survāḷ ne ḍaglī paheryā hatā ane mastak upar moṭā sonerī chheḍānu bhāre kasumbal shelu bāndhyu hatu ane moṭā sonerī chheḍānu kasumbal shelu khabhā upar virājmān hatu ane mastak upar sonerī īnḍānu chhatra virājmān hatu ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni-manḍaḷ samasta tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Te samāmā Shobhārām Shāstrīe prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Daivī ne āsurī e be prakārnā jīv chhe. Te anādi kāḷnā chhe ke koīk yoge karīne thayā chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Daivī ne āsurī e be prakārnā jīv chhe, te pratham to pralaykāḷe māyāne viṣhe līn thayā hatā; pachhī jyāre jagatno sarg thāy chhe tyāre e be prakārnā jīv pot-potānā bhāve yukta thakā ūpaje chhe. Ane keṭalāk sādhāraṇ jīv chhe te to daivī ne āsurīne sange karīne daivī ne āsurī thāy chhe ane keṭalāk daivī ne āsurī jīv chhe te to jevā jevā karma karatā jāy chhe tevā tevā bhāvne pāmatā jāy chhe. Temā āsurbhāvne viṣhe ne daivībhāvne viṣhe mukhya hetu to satpuruṣhno kop ne anugrah chhe. Jem Jay-Vijay Bhagwānnā pārṣhad hatā teṇe satpuruṣh evā je Sanakādik teno droh karyo tyāre asurbhāvne pāmī gayā[50] ane Prahlādjī daitya hatā teṇe Nāradjīno updesh grahaṇ karyo to param bhāgwat sant kahevāyā.[51] Māṭe Moṭā-Puruṣhno je upar kop thāy te jīv āsurī thaī jāy chhe ane je upar Moṭā-Puruṣh rājī thāy te jīv daivī thaī jāy chhe; paṇ bīju daivī-āsurī thayānu kāraṇ nathī. Māṭe jene potānu kalyāṇ ichchhavu hoy tene Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhakta teno koī rīte droh karavo nahī ane je rīte Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhakta rājī thāy tem karavu.”
216: Samvat 1882nā Poṣh vadi 13 Terasne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā darabārmā līmbaḍānā vṛukṣh heṭhe manch upar gādītakiyā bichhavāvīne virājmān hatā ne shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni-manḍaḷ samasta tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Te samāmā Vaḍodarānā Shāstrī beṭhā hatā. Teṇe em kahyu je, “He Mahārāj! Tame jo koīk moṭā māṇasne chamatkār jaṇāvo to temāthī ghaṇo samās thāy.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Moṭā māṇas sāthe amāre zāzu bane nahī. Shā māṭe je, ene rājyano ne dhanno mad hoy ane amāre tyāgno ane bhaktino mad hoy; māṭe koī kene namī de evu kām nathī. Ane koī moṭā māṇasne jo samādhi karāvīe to kāīk gām-garās āpe, tenī amārā hṛudaymā lālach nathī. Kem je, gām-garās to sukhne arthe ichchhīe; te amāre to netra mīchīne Bhagwānnī mūrtinu chintavan karīe, temā jevu sukh chhe tevu chaud loknā rājyane viṣhe paṇ nathī. Ane jo Bhagwānnā bhajan jevu rājyane viṣhe sukh hoy to Svāyambhuv Manu ādik je moṭā moṭā rājā te sarve rājya mūkīne vanmā tap karavā shā sāru jāy?[52] Ane Bhagwānnā bhajan jevu strīne viṣhe sukh hoy to Chitraketu Rājā karoḍ strīone shā sāru mūke?[53] Ane Bhagwānnā bhajannā sukh āgaḷ to chaud loknu je sukh te narak jevu kahyu chhe. Māṭe je Bhagwānne sukhe sukhiyo thayo hoy tene to brahmānḍne viṣhe je viṣhaynu sukh chhe te narak tulya bhāse chhe. Ane amāre paṇ Bhagwānnā bhajannu sukh te ja sukh jaṇāy chhe; bīju sarve dukhrūp jaṇāy chhe. Māṭe Parameshvarnu bhajan-smaraṇ karatā thakā jene sahaje satsang thāy tene karāvīe chhīe, paṇ koī vātno antarmā āgrah nathī. Āgrah to kevaḷ Bhagwānnā bhajanno ane Bhagwānnā bhaktano satsang rākhyāno chhe. E amārā antarno rahasya-abhiprāy hato te ame tamārī āgaḷ kahyo.”
217: Samvat 1882nā Poṣh vadi Amāsne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇne sanmukh havelī upar gādītakiyā nankhāvīne virājmān hatā ane sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ sarve sādhu tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje prashna pūchhyo je, “Panch gnān-indriyo ne panch karma-indriyo chhe te pot-potānā viṣhayne yathārth jāṇe chhe. Te gnānī tathā agnānīne indriyo dvāre ek-sarakho vyavahār chhe, paṇ gnānī hoy tenā indriyo agnānī thakī bījī rīte nathī vartatā. Māṭe gnānīne jitendriya kahyā chhe te kevī rīte jāṇavā? E prashna chhe.” Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe kahyu je, “Nirvikalp samādhi thāy tyāre jitendriya thāy em jaṇāy chhe.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Nirvikalp samādhivāḷāne paṇ panch-viṣhay grahaṇ karavā te to saunī peṭhe indriyo dvārā ja grahaṇ thāy chhe; māṭe jitendriyapaṇu kem chhe?” Pachhī bahu rīte karīne Muktānand Swāmīe uttar karyo paṇ samādhān thayu nahī. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje kahyu je, “Eno uttar to em chhe je, shabdādik je panch-viṣhay chhe temā je doṣh rahyā chhe tene jāṇe ane Bhagwānnī je mūrti chhe temā je kalyāṇkārī guṇ chhe tene paṇ jāṇe. Ane māyik je panch-viṣhay tene bhogavave karīne jīvne naraknā kunḍnī prāpti thāy chhe ne mahādukh bhogavavā paḍe chhe tene paṇ jāṇe. Ane em jāṇe tyāre ene panch-viṣhayno atishay abhāv āve chhe ne ene viṣhe vairbuddhi thāy chhe. Pachhī je sāthe jene vair thayu tene, tene viṣhe koī rīte prīti thāy ja nahī. Em samajīne jyāre panch-viṣhayno manmāthī jene atishay abhāv thaī jāy te jitendriya puruṣh kahevāy. Pachhī Bhagwānnī shravaṇ-kīrtanādik bhaktie karīne potānu jīvitavya pūru kare paṇ vimukh jīvnī peṭhe panch-viṣhaymā āsakta thāy nahī. Evo hoy te jitendriya kahevāy.”

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje bījo prashna pūchhyo je, “Ek tyāgī sant chhe te to kevaḷ nivṛutti-mārgvāḷā chhe ane te em jāṇe chhe je, ‘Ame ātmā chhīe,’ paṇ dehne potānu rūp mānatā nathī ne tenā dehnī rīti to jaḍ ne unmattanā jevī hoy; ane te puruṣhne jāti, varṇa, āshram tenu abhimān hoy nahī; ne khāvu, pīvu, ūṭhavu, besavu te sarve ghelānā jevu hoy, paṇ lokmā bhaḷatu āve tevu na hoy. Ne evo je tyāgī hoy tene koīno sang paṇ rahe nahī; jem vannu mṛugalu hoy tenī peṭhe unmatta thako ekalo farato rahe ne ene koī rītnu bandhan paṇ thāy nahī. Ane bījā tyāgī sant chhe te to nivṛutti-mārgvāḷā chhe to paṇ pravṛutti-mārgmā varte chhe ane je pravṛuttine yoge karīne kām, krodh, lobh, moh, mad, matsar, āshā, tṛuṣhṇā ityādik doṣh hṛudayne viṣhe pravarte tevī kriyāne viṣhe pravarte chhe, tyāre koīk jātno antarmā vikār paṇ thaī āve chhe. Māṭe e tyāgīne e pravṛutti-mārgmā rahevu ghaṭe ke na ghaṭe? Ane vaḷī e pravṛutti-mārgmā rahetā thakā kevī rīte nirvikār rahevāy? Ane tame kahesho je, ‘Jo Parameshvarnī āgnāe karīne e pravṛutti-mārgmā rahe to bandhan na thāy.’ E upar e āshankā chhe je, ‘Parameshvarnī āgnāe karīne bhāngya pīe to shu gānḍo na thāy? Jarūr gānḍo thāy.’ Māṭe e tyāgī kevī rīte pravṛutti-mārgmā rahe to bandhan na thāy? E prashna chhe.” Pachhī Nityānand Swāmīe ne Shukmunie enu samādhān karavā mānḍyu paṇ yathārth uttar thayo nahī. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Je kevaḷ nivṛutti-dharmavāḷā tyāgī chhe ne unmattanī peṭhe varte chhe te to kevaḷ ātmaniṣhṭhāvāḷā jāṇavā. Ane vaḷī je nivṛutti-dharmavāḷā tyāgī Bhagwānnī bhaktie yukta chhe, tene to Parameshvare kahyā evā je niyam tene viṣhe rahīne Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhakta sambandhī je pravṛutti-mārg tene viṣhe sāvadhān thaīne joḍāvu. Ane e je Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktane arthe pravṛutti-mārgmā joḍāvu enu nām ja bhakti chhe. Ane evī pravṛuttivāḷā je tyāgī chhe tenī barobar nivṛutti-mārgvāḷo je kevaḷ ātmaniṣhṭh tyāgī te thaī shakato nathī. Shā māṭe je, ā to tyāgī chhe ne nivṛutti-mārgvāḷā chhe to paṇ Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktanī sevāne arthe pravṛuttimā pravarte chhe. Ane e je Bhagwānnā bhakta tyāgī tene to Parameshvarnā niyammā rahīne pravṛutti-mārgne viṣhe rahevu, paṇ Parameshvarnā niyamthī adhik paṇ vartavu nahī ne nyūn paṇ rahevu nahī; ane kām, krodh, lobh, moh, āshā, tṛuṣhṇā, svād e ādik je vikār teno tyāg karīne[54] Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktanī sevāne arthe pravṛutti-mārgne viṣhe vartavu, to ene koī jātnu bandhan thāy nahī. Ane kevaḷ ātmaniṣhṭhāvāḷo je tyāgī te karatā to ā tyāgī atishay shreṣhṭh chhe ne Bhagwānnī kṛupānu pātra chhe.”
૫૪. કામ-ક્રોધાદિ વિકારની પ્રવૃત્તિ દેહે કરીને ન થવા દેવી, એ દોષોને વિષે શત્રુભાવ રાખી તેને ટાળવા પ્રયત્ન કરવો અને દેહ-અંતઃકરણથી જુદા આત્મારૂપે માનવું.
54. Kām-krodhādi vikārnī pravṛutti dehe karīne na thavā devī, e doṣhone viṣhe shatrubhāv rākhī tene ṭāḷavā prayatna karavo ane deh-antahkaraṇthī judā ātmārūpe mānavu.
218: Samvat 1882nā Mahā sudi 1 Paḍavāne divas Shrījī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye sandhyā āratī thayā keḍe Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā manḍapmā gādītakiyā nankhāvīne virājmān thayā hatā ne sarva shvet vastranu dhāraṇ karyu hatu ne potānī chāre kore manḍapne upar tathā heṭhe Paramhansa sarve tathā desh-deshnā haribhakta sarve beṭhā hatā.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ā tame sarve moṭā moṭā Paramhansa chho te tamane ame prashna pūchhīe chhīe je, satsangī hoy tene avashyapaṇe shī shī vārtā jāṇī joīe? Kem je, tene koīk pūchhe athavā potānā manmā koīk tark thaī āve, tyāre jo te vārtā jāṇī na hoy to tenu samādhān kem thāy?” Em prashna pūchhīne pachhī pote ja bolyā je, “Lyo, eno uttar ame ja karīe chhīe je, ek to āpaṇo Uddhav Sampradāy chhe, tenī rīt jāṇī joīe tathā bījī guru-paramparā jāṇī joīe. Te kevī rīte? To Uddhav te Rāmānand Swāmīrūpe hatā ne te Rāmānand Swāmī Shrī Rangkṣhetrane viṣhe swapnamā sākṣhāt Rāmānujāchārya thakī Vaiṣhṇavī dīkṣhāne pāmyā. Māṭe Rāmānand Swāmīnā guru te Rāmānujāchārya chhe ne te Rāmānand Swāmīnā shiṣhya ame chhīe. Evī rīte guru-paramparā jāṇavī.[55] Ane ame amārā Dharmakuḷnu sthāpan karyu chhe tenī rīt jāṇavī. Ane trījā amārā sampradāymā ati pramāṇrūp je shāstra chhe tene jāṇavā. Te shāstranā nām: Ved 1, Vyāssūtra 2, Shrīmad Bhāgwat Purāṇ 3, Mahābhāratne viṣhe Viṣhṇusahasranām 4, Bhagwad Gītā 5, Vidurnīti 6, Skand-Purāṇnā Viṣhṇukhanḍ māhelu Vāsudev-Māhātmya 7, ane Yāgnavalkya-Smṛuti 8; e je āṭh shāstra tene jāṇavā. Ane chothā sarve satsangīnā je je niyam chhe tene jāṇavā. Ane pāchmā āpaṇā iṣhṭadev je Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān tene jāṇavā,[56] ane sthānak, sevak ne kārya tene bhede karīne te Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnī mūrtionu bahupaṇu chhe tene jāṇavu; ane te Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnā je parokṣhrūp ne pratyakṣhrūp tene jāṇavā. Temā parokṣhrūp te kevī rīte? To māyānā tam thakī par evo je Golok tene madhye je Akṣhardhām[57] tene viṣhe Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān rahyā chhe te dvibhuj chhe ne koṭi koṭi sūrya sarakhā prakāshmān chhe ne shyām-sundar chhe, ne Rādhikājī ne Lakṣhmījīe sahit chhe ne Nand, Sunand ne Shrīdāmādik je pārṣhad temaṇe sevyā chhe, ne anant koṭi brahmānḍnī je utpatti, sthiti ne pralay tenā kartā chhe ne mahārājādhirājpaṇe virājmān chhe. Ane evā je e Bhagwān te chaturbhujrūpne dhāre chhe, aṣhṭabhujrūpne dhāre chhe ne sahasrabhujrūpne paṇ dhāre chhe; ne Vāsudev, Sankarṣhaṇ, Aniruddha ne Pradyumna e je chaturvyūh ne Keshavādik je chovīs vyūh e sarve rūpne dhāre chhe; tathā Varāh, Nṛusinha, Vāman, Kapil, Hayagrīv e ādik je anek avatār tene dhāre chhe; ne pote to sadā dvibhuj chhe. Ane Upaniṣhad tathā Sānkhya-Shāstra ne Yog-Shāstra tathā Pancharātra emane viṣhe e ja swarūpnu varṇan karyu chhe. Evī rīte parokṣhpaṇe Bhagwānnu swarūp kahyu.

“Ane sarve je āchārya thayā chhe temā Vyāsjī moṭā āchārya chhe ne te Vyāsjī jevā to Shankarāchārya na kahevāy, Rāmānujāchārya na kahevāy, Madhvāchārya na kahevāy, Nimbārka na kahevāy, Viṣhṇu Swāmī na kahevāy, Vallabhāchārya na kahevāy; kem je, e āchārya jo Vyāsjīnā vachanne anusare to e āchāryanā vachannu lokmā pramāṇ thāy, nahī to na thāy. Ane Vyāsjīne to bījā koīnī apekṣhā nathī; kem je, Vyāsjī to Vednā āchārya chhe ne pote Bhagwān chhe. Māṭe āpaṇe to Vyāsjīnā vachanne ja anusarvu. Ane te je Vyāsjī teṇe jīvnā kalyāṇne arthe Vedno[58] vibhāg karyo ne sattar Purāṇ karyā ne Mahābhārat karyu, to paṇ te Vyāsjīnā manmā em thayu je, ‘Jīvnā kalyāṇno upāy jem chhe tem yathārth na kahevāyo.’ Ne teṇe karīne potānā manmā santoṣh na thayo. Te pachhī samagra Ved, Purāṇ, Itihās, Pancharātra, Yog-Shāstra, Sānkhya-Shāstra tenu sār evu je Shrīmad Bhāgwat Purāṇ tene Vyāsjī karatā havā. Te Bhāgwatne viṣhe sarva avatār karatā Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānne ja adhikpaṇe kahyā chhe ne sarva avatārnā dharanārā je chhe te ja swayam Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān chhe. Ane e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwāne Uddhav pratye Guṇvibhāgnā Adhyāymā[59] kahyu chhe je, ‘Hu nirguṇ chhu ne mārā sambandhne je pāme chhe te paṇ nirguṇ thāy chhe.’ Māṭe kāmbhāv, dveṣhbhāv, bhaybhāv, sambandhbhāv, snehbhāv - emāthī je je bhāve karīne e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānne je jīv āsharyā te nirguṇ thaī gayā. Māṭe e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān te nirguṇ chhe. Evī rīte Vyāsjīe Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānne kahyā chhe. Ane te Vyāsjīe em siddhānt karyo chhe je, ‘Sarva avatārnā dharatal je Parameshvar te ja swayam Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān chhe ne bījā je avatār te enā chhe.’[60] Ane jo e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānne nirguṇ nahī kahe ne shuddha sattvātmak kaheshe, to tene Bhāgwatnā pūrvāpar sambandhnī khabar ja nathī ne tene viṣhe moṭo bādh āvashe. Kem je, Gopīoe Shrī Kṛuṣhṇane Bhagwān na jāṇyā ne kāmbhāve karīne e ja Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānne bhajyā, teṇe karīne te Gopīo nirguṇ thaī gaī; tyāre te Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānne shuddha sattvātmak kem kahevāy? Māṭe Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān to nirguṇ ja chhe. Tathā Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwāne pote Arjun pratye kahyu chhe je,

‘Janma karma cha me divyamevam yo vetti tattvatah;
Tyaktvā deham punarjanma naiti māmeti so’rjun!’.[61]

“Ane e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwāne potānā janma-samaymā Vasudev-Devkīne Parameshvarpaṇānī pratītine arthe je Chaturbhujrūp dekhāḍyu tathā Brahmāne je anek Chaturbhujrūp dekhāḍyā tathā Akrūrne je Sheṣh-shāyīrūp dekhāḍyu tathā Ajurnne Vishvarūp dekhāḍyu,[62] ityādik rūpne bhede karīne je Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnī upāsanānā bhed kahevā te to yogya chhe. Paṇ e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān Vrajne viṣhe Bāḷmukund kahevāyā, Muralīmanohar kahevāyā, Rādhā-Kṛuṣhṇa kahevāyā tathā vāchhaḍā chāryā, gāyo chārī, Govardhan Parvat dhāryo, Gopīo sāthe rās-krīḍā karī tathā Mathurāpurīmā āvīne Kansne māryo, Yādavne sukhiyā karyā tathā Sāndīpani brāhmaṇne gher vidyā bhaṇyā tathā Kubjā sangāthe vihār karyo tathā Dvārkāpurīmā vasyā ne Rukmiṇī ādik aṣhṭ paṭarāṇīone paraṇyā tathā soḷ hajār strīone paraṇyā tathā Hastināpurmā rahyā ne Pānḍavnī sarva kaṣhṭ thakī rakṣhā karī ne Draupadīnī lāj rākhī ne Arjunnā sārathi thayā ityādik sthānakne bhede karīne je Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnī anek līlā chhe; teṇe karīne e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnā dvibhuj swarūpne viṣhe upāsanānā bhed na karavā, ane je karashe te vachan-drohī, guru-drohī chhe. Ane e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnā ācharaṇ je, Govāḷiyānu uchchhiṣhṭa khādhu tathā rās-ramaṇ karyu ityādik anek prakārnā chhe, te ācharaṇ pramāṇe te Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnā bhaktane ācharaṇ na karavu. Ane e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwāne Ekādash Skandhmā tathā Bhagwad Gītāmā tathā Vāsudev-Māhātmyamā jem sādhunā lakṣhaṇ[63] kahyā chhe tathā varṇāshramnā dharma kahyā chhe tathā potānī bhakti karyānu kahyu chhe te pramāṇe vartavu, paṇ e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnā ācharaṇ pramāṇe ācharaṇ na karavu. Ane je karashe te vimukh chhe, amāro satsangī nathī. Ane āpaṇā iṣhṭadev evā je e Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān tenā ācharaṇ pramāṇe jem na karavu, tem ja tamāro sarveno āchārya ne guru ne upadeṣhṭā evo je hu, te mārā dehnā je ācharaṇ te pramāṇe paṇ tamāre na karavu. Ane amārā sampradāyne viṣhe jem jenā dharma kahyā chhe, te je amārā vachan te pramāṇe tamāre sarvene rahevu paṇ amārā ācharaṇ pramāṇe na rahevu. Ā je ame vārtā karī tene sarva Paramhansa tathā sarva satsangī shīkhī lejyo ne e pramāṇe samajīne em ja vartajo ne bījā āgaḷ paṇ em ja vārtā karajo.” Em kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj bhojan karavā padhāryā. Evī rītnī vārtāne sāmbhaḷīne sarve sādhu ne satsangī te em samajatā havā je, ‘E parokṣh je Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān kahyā te ja ā Bhakti-Dharmanā putra Shrījī Mahārāj chhe paṇ e thakī par koī nathī ane e ja āpaṇā iṣhṭadev chhe ne guru paṇ e ja chhe.’

1. The phrase ‘Akshardhām in the midst of Golok’ has become famous in the Swaminarayan Sampraday because of how it can be interpreted. The correct interpretation is that there are infinite Goloks and other abodes (not just one of each abode), and in the midst of those infinite abodes is Akshardham. Gunatitanand Swami has given an example to understand the correct interpretation in Swamini Vat 3/23.

2. जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन॥
O Arjun! He who thoroughly realises my birth and actions to be divine will not take another birth when he leaves his body; rather, he will attain me. - Bhagwad Gitā: 4.9
૫૫. ગુરુપરંપરાને જ સંપ્રદાય કહે છે. “આમ્નાયઃ સમ્પ્રદાયઃ સ્યાત્, પારમ્પર્યં ગુરુક્રમઃ” એમ હલાયુધ કોષ (૪૦૨)માં પણ કહ્યું છે.

૫૬. શ્રીજીમહારાજ સ્વયં રામકૃષ્ણાદિક અવતારોના કારણ છે, તેવું તેમણે જ વચનામૃત ગ. મ. ૧૩માં જણાવ્યું છે; પરંતુ તેમણે મનુષ્યશરીર ધારણ કર્યું હોવાથી અન્ય મુમુક્ષુઓના હિતને અર્થે ઉપાસક તરીકે પોતાને ઓળખાવી શ્રીકૃષ્ણ ભગવાનને ઇષ્ટદેવ તરીકે જણાવે છે.

૫૭. ‘ગોલોક તેને મધ્યે જે અક્ષરધામ’ આ વાક્ય સ્વામિનારાયણ સંપ્રદાયમાં વિશેષ પ્રસિદ્ધિ પામ્યું છે. જેનો મુખ્ય અર્થ એ છે કે ગોલોકાદિક અનંત ધામોની વચ્ચે પૂર્ણ પુરુષોત્તમ નારાયણનું સર્વોપરી અક્ષરધામ રહેલું છે. જેનું વર્ણન વિવિધ દૃષ્ટાંતો દ્વારા વચનામૃત ગ. પ્ર. ૬૩માં તથા સ્વામીની વાત (૩/૨૩)માં વિસ્તારપૂર્વક કરવામાં આવ્યું છે.
આ વાક્યનો બીજો અર્થ એ છે કે ગોલોકધામને વિષે સોળ દ્વાર ઓળંગીને બરાબર વચ્ચે તેજોમય મહાચોક છે જેને અક્ષરધામ કહે છે, જેનું વર્ણન વાસુદેવમાહાત્મ્યમાં ૧૭મા અધ્યાયમાં ૧-૨ શ્લોકમાં કર્યું છે. સ્વામીની વાત (૫/૨૮૮)માં પણ ગોલોક મધ્યે રહેલા આ અક્ષરધામનો ઉલ્લેખ કર્યો છે. અહીં આ વચનામૃતમાં પણ તે અક્ષરધામનું વર્ણન કર્યું છે, પરંતુ પ્રથમ અર્થમાં દર્શાવેલ પુરુષોત્તમ નારાયણના સર્વોપરી અક્ષરધામનું વર્ણન અહીં નથી તેમ જાણવું.
૫૮. ઋગ્વેદ, સામવેદ, યજુર્વેદ અને અથર્વવેદ.
૬૧. અર્થ: હે અર્જુન! પૂર્વોક્ત પ્રકારે જે પુરુષ મારાં જન્મ, કર્મ યથાર્થપણે દિવ્ય જાણે છે તે પુરુષ દેહનો ત્યાગ કરીને ફરીથી જન્મને પામતો નથી પરંતુ મને જ પામે છે. (ગીતા: ૪/૯).

૬૨. શ્રીકૃષ્ણ ભગવાને બ્રહ્માજીને ચતુર્ભુજરૂપ દેખાડ્યું તેનો સંદર્ભ ભાગવત: ૧૦/૧૩/૪૬-૫૫ છે. તે સિવાયનાં શ્રીકૃષ્ણ ભગવાનનાં ચતુર્ભુજરૂપ તથા વિશ્વરૂપના પ્રસંગોના સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંકો વચનામૃત લો. ૧૮ની ટીપની(૧૦૩, ૧૦૪, ૧૦૬)માં છે.
55. Guru-paramparāne ja sampradāy kahe chhe. “Āmnāyah sampradāyah syāt, pāramparyam gurukramah” em Halāyudh Koṣh (402)mā paṇ kahyu chhe.

56. Shrījī Mahārāj swayam Rām-Kṛuṣhṇādik avatāronā kāraṇ chhe, tevu temaṇe ja Vachanāmṛut G. M. 13mā jaṇāvyu chhe; parantu temaṇe manuṣhya-sharīr dhāraṇ karyu hovāthī anya mumukṣhuonā hitne arthe upāsak tarīke potāne oḷakhāvī Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānne iṣhṭadev tarīke jaṇāve chhe.

57. ‘Golok tene madhye je Akṣhardhām’ ā vākya Swāminārāyaṇ Sampradāymā visheṣh prasiddhi pāmyu chhe. Jeno mukhya arth e chhe ke Golokādik anant dhāmonī vachche Pūrṇa Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇnu sarvoparī Akṣhardhām rahelu chhe. Jenu varṇan vividh draṣhṭānto dvārā Vachanāmṛut G. Pra. 63mā tathā Swāmīnī Vāt (3/23)mā vistār-pūrvak karavāmā āvyu chhe.
Ā vākyano bījo arth e chhe ke Golok-dhāmne viṣhe soḷ dvār oḷangīne barābar vachche tejomay mahāchok chhe jene Akṣhardhām kahe chhe, jenu varṇan Vāsudev-Māhātmyamā 17mā Adhyāymā 1-2 shlokmā karyu chhe. Swāmīnī Vāt (5/288)mā paṇ Golok madhye rahelā ā Akṣhardhāmno ullekh karyo chhe. Ahī ā Vachanāmṛutmā paṇ te Akṣhardhāmnu varṇan karyu chhe, parantu pratham arthmā darshāvel Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇnā sarvoparī Akṣhardhāmnu varṇan ahī nathī tem jāṇavu.

61. Arth: He Arjun! Pūrvokta prakāre je puruṣh mārā janma, karma yathārthpaṇe divya jāṇe chhe te puruṣh dehno tyāg karīne farīthī janmane pāmato nathī parantu mane ja pāme chhe. (Gītā: 4/9).

219: Samvat 1882nā Mahā sudi 2 Bījne divas Shrījī Mahārāj sānjne same Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā Mandirmā ugamṇī kornī rūpchokī upar gādītakiyā nankhāvīne virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Ṭhākorjīnī sandhyā ārtī thaī rahī tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Sāmbhaḷo, Bhagwānnī vārtā karīe chhīe je, ā jīvne jyāre Bharat Khanḍne viṣhe manuṣhya deh āve chhe tyāre Bhagwānnā avatār kā Bhagwānnā sādhu[65] e jarūr pṛuthvī upar vicharatā hoy; tenī jo e jīvne oḷakhāṇ thāy to e jīv Bhagwānno bhakta thāy chhe. Pachhī e Bhagwānno bhakta thayo tene Bhagwān vinā bījā koī padārthne viṣhe prīti rākhavī ghaṭe nahī. Shā māṭe je, Bhagwānnā dhāmnu je sukh chhe tenī āgaḷ māyik panch-viṣhaynu sukh chhe te to narak jevu chhe. Ane je naraknā kīḍā chhe te to narakne viṣhe param sukh māne chhe, paṇ je manuṣhya hoy te to te narakne param dukhdāyī jāṇe chhe. Tem jene Bhagwānnī oḷakhāṇ thaī te to Bhagwānno pārṣhad thayo ne tene Bhagwānnā pārṣhad maṭīne viṣhṭānā kīḍānī peṭhe māyik panch-viṣhaynā sukhne ichchhavu nahī. Ane je Bhagwānno bhakta hoy te to je je manorathne kare te sarve satya thāy chhe. Māṭe Bhagwān vinā bījā padārthne aṇasamajaṇe karīne je ichchhe chhe e ja ene moṭo avivek chhe. Te sāru je Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene to chaud loknā je bhogsukh chhe tene kāk-viṣhṭā tulya jāṇyā joīe ane man-karma-vachane karīne Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktane viṣhe ja draḍh prīti karī joīe. Ane em samajyu joīe je, ‘Je Bhagwānno bhakta hoy ne tene jo kadāchit Bhagwān vinā bījī vāsanā rahī gaī hoy, to te paṇ Indra-padavīne pāme kā Brahma-Lokne pāme, paṇ prākṛut jīvnī peṭhe narak-chorāsīmā to jāy ja nahī; tyāre je yathārth Bhagwānno bhakta hoy teno je mahimā ne tenu je sukh te to varṇavyāmā ja kem āve?’ Māṭe Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene to Bhagwānmā ja draḍh prīti rākhavī.”
1. Here, ‘Brahmalok’ refers to the realm of the ishwar Brahmā.
૬૫. અક્ષરબ્રહ્મ. ભગવાન સ્વામિનારાયણે અહીં પોતાનું પ્રાગટ્ય અક્ષરબ્રહ્મરૂપ પરમ એકાંતિક ભગવાનના અખંડ સંબંધવાળા સાધુ - સત્પુરુષરૂપે કહ્યું છે.
65. Akṣharbrahma. Bhagwān Swāminārāyaṇe ahī potānu prāgaṭya Akṣharbrahmarūp Param Ekāntik Bhagwānnā akhanḍ sambandhavāḷā sādhu - satpuruṣhrūpe kahyu chhe.
220: Samvat 1882nā Mahā sudi 3 Trījne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Vartāl madhye Shrī Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇnā darabārmā līmbaḍānā vṛukṣhnī heṭhe vedi upar gādītakiyā nankhāvīne virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe chamelīnā puṣhpano hār virājmān hato ane mastak upar rātā atalasnu chhatra virājmān hatu ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje Paramhansane prashna pūchhyo je, “Rajoguṇmāthī kāmnī utpatti thāy chhe ane tamoguṇmāthī krodh ne lobhnī utpatti thāy chhe; māṭe e kāmādiknu bīj na rahe evu ek sādhan kayu chhe?” Pachhī Shukmunie kahyu je, “Jyāre nirvikalp samādhi thāy ne jyāre ātmadarshan thāy tyāre ja enā hṛudaymāthī kāmādiknu bīj baḷī jāy.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje āshankā karī je, “Shiv, Brahmā, Shṛungi Ṛuṣhi, Parāshar, Nārad[66] emane shu nirvikalp samādhi nahotī je, kāme karīne e sarve vikṣhepne pāmyā? Māṭe e sarve nirvikalp samādhivāḷā ja hatā, to paṇ indriyonī vṛutti anulom thaī tyāre kāmādike karīne vikṣhepne pāmyā. Māṭe tame kahyu evī rīte e prashnano uttar na thayo. Ane jem gnānī nirvikalp samādhine viṣhe jāy tyāre nirvikār rahe chhe, tem ja agnānī suṣhuptine viṣhe nirvikār rahe chhe. Ane jyāre indriyonī vṛutti anulom thāy chhe tyāre to gnānī ne agnānī bey kāmādike karīne vikṣhepne pāme chhe; emā to gnānī-agnānīno kāī visheṣh jaṇāto nathī. Māṭe have bījā Paramhansa uttar karo.” Pachhī to Gopāḷānand Swāmī, Devānand Swāmī, Nityānand Swāmī, Muktānand Swāmī e sarve maḷīne jevo jene bhāsyo tevo teṇe uttar karyo, paṇ Shrījī Mahārājnā prashnanu koīthī samādhān thayu nahī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jem Janak videhī hatā te pravṛutti-mārgmā hatā to paṇ nirvikār hatā. Ane jyāre Janaknī sabhāmā Sulabhā nāme sanyāsinī āvī, tyāre Janak Rājā Sulabhā pratye bolyā je, ‘Tu mārā chittane moh pamāḍyānu kare chhe paṇ mārā guru je Panchashikh Ṛuṣhi tenī kṛupā thakī hu Sānkhya ne Yog e be matne anusaryo chhu. Māṭe mārā ardhā sharīrne chandan charche ane ardhu sharīr talavāre karīne kāpe e bey māre barobar chhe ane ā mārī Mithilāpurī baḷī jāy to paṇ māru kāī baḷatu nathī. Em hu pravṛuttimā rahyo thako asangī ne nirvikār chhu.’ Evī rīte Rājā Janake Sulabhā pratye kahyu.[67] Ane Shukdevjīnā paṇ Rājā Janak guru kahevāyā.[68] Māṭe e prashnano e ja uttar chhe je, ‘Indriyonī vṛutti anulompaṇe vartatī hoy ane pravṛutti-mārgmā rahyo hoy to paṇ jo Rājā Janaknī peṭhe jenā hṛudaymā samajaṇnī draḍhatā thaī hoy, to te koī rīte vikārne pāme nahī.’ Ane jene jevu jāṇyu joīe tevu yathārth jāṇyu hoy je, ā te sār chhe ne ā te asār chhe. Pachhī ek Bhagwānnī mūrti vinā jeṭalā māyik ākār chhe te sarve atishay dukhdāyak chhe ne nāshvant chhe em jāṇe ane potāne deh, indriyo ne antahkaraṇ te thakī nokho ātmārūpe jāṇe. Pachhī ene evu koī padārth nathī je, moh pamāḍavāne arthe samarth thāy ; kem je, e to sarve māyik ākārne tuchchha karī jāṇe chhe. Ane evī rīte jenā antarmā samajaṇnī gheḍya beṭhī hoy ne tenā indriyo pravṛutti-mārgne viṣhe sarve anulompaṇe vartatā hoy to paṇ te kāmādike karīne kṣhobhne na pāme. Evo je haribhakta hoy te tyāgī hoy athavā gṛuhasth hoy paṇ tenā hṛudaymāthī kāmādiknu bīj nāsh pāmī jāy chhe ane evo je hoy te ja sarve haribhaktamā shreṣhṭh Vaiṣhṇav chhe. Māṭe gṛuhī-tyāgīno kāī meḷ nathī, jenī samajaṇ moṭī tene ja sauthī moṭo haribhakta jāṇavo. Ane Shiv, Brahmādikne viṣhe je khoṭya kahevāy chhe tenu to em chhe je, keṭalākne viṣhe āvī rītnī samajaṇnī kasar chhe ne keṭalākne viṣhe to āvī samajaṇ hoy to paṇ bhūnḍā desh, kāḷ, sang, kriyādikne yoge karīne temane kāmādik vikārrūp khoṭya kahevāṇī chhe. Māṭe āvī samajaṇ hoy to paṇ koī prakāre kusang to karavo ja nahī, e siddhānt-vārtā chhe.”

૬૬. બ્રહ્મા, શિવ, પરાશરના પ્રસંગોનો સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંક અનુક્રમે વચનામૃત ગ. મ. ૨૧ની ટીપણી (૭૯, ૮૦, ૮૨)માં તથા નારદના પ્રસંગનો સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંક વચનામૃત ગ. પ્ર. ૨૩ની ટીપણી-૧૦૭માં આપ્યો છે. શૃંગિ ઋષિનો સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંક વાલ્મીકિ રામાયણ: બાલકાંડ-૯.

66. Brahmā, Shiv, Parāsharnā prasangono sandarbh kramānk anukrame Vachanāmṛut G. M. 21nī ṭīpaṇī (79, 80, 82)mā tathā Nāradnā prasangno sandarbh kramānk Vachanāmṛut G. Pra. 23nī ṭīpaṇī-107mā āpyo chhe. Shṛungi Ruṣhino sandarbh kramānk Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇ: Bālkānḍ-9.
221: Samvat 1882nā Mahā vadi 11 Ekādashīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amdāvād madhye Shrī Naranārāyaṇnā Mandirmā āthamṇī kore mukhārvind karīne virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe gulābnā puṣhpanā hār virājmān hatā ne kānnī upar gulābnā puṣhpanā guchchha virājmān hatā ne pāghne viṣhe gulābnā puṣhpanā torā virājmān hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Te sabhāmā Shrījī Mahārāj antar sāmī draṣhṭi karīne virājmān hatā. Pachhī netrakamaḷne ughāḍīne sarve sāmu joyu, pachhī em bolyā je, “Amāre ek dhyānnā angnī vārtā karavī chhe. Te vārtā Mokṣh-Dharmane viṣhe kahī chhe. Ane je moṭā moṭā e dhyāne karīne siddha-dashāne pāmyā chhe te paṇ ame ghaṇāk dīṭhā chhe ne amārā paṇ anubhavmā em varte chhe je, anant prakārnā dhyān chhe, paṇ je ā vāt kahevī chhe tenī barobar bīju koī dhyān thāy nahī. Jem koī chamatkārī mantra hoy athavā chamatkārī oṣhadhi hoy temā svābhāvik ja chamatkār rahyo chhe, tem je ā dhyān amāre kahevu chhe te dhyānmā paṇ evo svābhāvik chamatkār chhe je, tatkāḷ siddha-dashāne pāmī jāy. Have te vārtā karīe chhīe; e je dhyānno karanāro chhe tene jamaṇā netramā sūryanu dhyān karavu ne ḍābā netramā chandranu dhyān karavu. Evī rīte dhyān karatā karatā sūrya ne chandramā jevā ākāshmā chhe tevā ne tevā ja netramā dekhāvā mānḍe tyāre jamaṇu netra chhe te tapavā mānḍe ne ḍābu netra chhe te ṭharavā mānḍe, tyāre sūryanī dhāraṇā ḍābā netramā karavī ne chandranī dhāraṇā jamaṇā netramā karavī. Evī rīte dhāraṇā karīne pachhī sūryane ne chandrane antardraṣhṭi karīne hṛudākāshamā joyā karavā ane jonāro je potāno jīv tenā rūpne paṇ dekhavu ane dekhnāro je jīvātmā tene viṣhe Paramātmānu dhyān karavu.[1] Pachhī tenu je vāsanāling deh chhe, te jem renṭno fāḷako fare tem ākāshne viṣhe faratu jaṇāy. Pachhī evī rīte dhyān karatā thakā Bhagwānnu je Vishvarūp chhe tenu darshan tene thāy chhe ne te rūpne viṣhe chaude loknī rachanā chhe te dekhāī āve chhe. Ane te swarūp atishay moṭu paṇ nathī dekhātu. Jem Vaṭpatrashāyī Bhagwān ek vaḍnā patramā nānā bāḷak thaīne poḍhyā hatā ane te ja Bhagwānnā udarne viṣhe Mārkanḍeya Ṛuṣhie samagra brahmānḍ dīṭhu. Evī rīte Bhagwānnu dhyān karatā thakā jeṭalā kāī shāstramā padārth kahyā chhe, te sarve enī draṣhṭimā āve chhe; tyāre enā jīvātmāne viṣhe je kāīk nāstik bhāg rahyo hoy te maṭī jāy chhe ane teno jīv ati baḷiyo thāy chhe ane, je je shāstramā kahyu chhe te sarve satya chhe, evī ene draḍh pratīti āve chhe; ane aṇimādik aṣhṭa siddhao te paṇ e dhyānnā karanārāne āvīne hājar thāy chhe. Ane jyā lagaṇ sūryanī ne chandranī kiraṇ pahochatī hoy tyā lagī tenī draṣhṭi pahonche evī anant siddhio prakaṭe chhe, paṇ Parameshvarno bhakta chhe māṭe koī siddhione grahaṇ karato nathī, kevaḷ Parameshvarnu ja dhyān kare chhe; tyāre e dhyānno karanāro Nārad-Sanakādik-Shukjīnā sarakhī siddha-dashāne pāme chhe. Māṭe anant prakārnā dhyān chhe, paṇ tatkāḷ siddha-dashāne pamāḍe evu to e ja dhyān chhe.”

Eṭalī vārtā karī rahyā tyāre Muktānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Evu dhyān te Aṣhṭāng-Yogne mārge karīne prāṇāyām karato hoy tene ja siddha thāy chhe ke bījāne paṇ thāy chhe?” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Prāṇāyāmvāḷāno kāī meḷ nathī, e to jo evā dhyānno abhyās kare ne te Parameshvarno ekāntik bhakta hoy to tene ja dhyān siddha thāy chhe, paṇ bījā jīv thakī to e mārgne viṣhe chalātu ja nathī. Māṭe e dhyānnā je adhikārī chhe tene to kahyu evu je e dhyān te thakī bījo tatkāḷ siddha thayāno upāy nathī.”
૧. મહાભારત, શાંતિપર્વ: ૧૮૮. આ અધ્યાયમાં ધ્યાનના ચાર પ્રકારો નિરૂપ્યા છે, પંડિત કૃષ્ણવલ્લભાચાર્યે, આ વચનામૃત ‘બ્રહ્મરસાયણભાષ્ય’માં પણ આ અધ્યાયને જ નોંધ્યો છે.
1. Mahābhārat, Shāntiparva: 188. Ā adhyāymā dhyānnā chār prakāro nirūpyā chhe, Panḍit Kṛuṣhṇavallabhāchārye, ā Vachanāmṛut ‘Brahmarasāyaṇ-bhāṣhya’mā paṇ ā adhyāyne ja nondhyo chhe.
222: Samvat 1882nā Fāgaṇ sudi 11 Ekādashīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amdāvād madhye Shrī Naranārāyaṇnā Mandir āgaḷ vedine viṣhe pāṭ upar gādītakiyā nankhāvīne virājmān hatā ane dhoḷo khes paheryo hato ne dhoḷī chādar oḍhī hatī ne mastakne viṣhe gulābī rangno fenṭo bāndhyo hato ne te pāghne viṣhe gulābnā puṣhpanā torā zūkī rahyā hatā ne kānne upar gulābnā be guchchha khosyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe gulābnā puṣhpanā hār paheryā hatā ne be bhujne viṣhe gulābnā bājubandh bāndhyā hatā ne be hāthne viṣhe gulābnā puṣhpanā gajarā paheryā hatā. Evī rīte sarve angmā gulābnā puṣhpe garakāv thayā hatā. Ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj sarve Paramhansa pratye bolyā je, “Ek prashna pūchhu chhu je, ek Parameshvarno bhakta chhe te to jāgrat, swapna ne suṣhupti te thakī par varte chhe ne malin raj, tam ne malin sattva teno tyāg karīne shuddha sattvamay[2] varte chhe ne evo thako Parameshvarne bhaje chhe. Ane bījo je bhakta chhe te to triguṇātmak varte chhe ne Parameshvarne viṣhe to atishay prītie yukta varte chhe. E be bhaktamā kayo bhakta shreṣhṭh chhe?” Pachhī sant-manḍaḷe to em kahyu je, “Bhagwānne viṣhe prītivāḷo shreṣhṭh chhe.”

Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ek to nāhī-dhoīne pavitra thaīne Bhagwānnī pūjā kare chhe ane ek to maḷ-mūtrano bharyo thako Bhagwānnī pūjā kare chhe, e bemā kayo shreṣhṭh chhe?” Tyāre muni-manḍaḷe kahyu je, “Pavitra thaīne Bhagwānnī pūjā kare te shreṣhṭh chhe.”

Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Je māyik upādhine tajīne Bhagwānne bhaje chhe tene to tame nyūn kaho chho ne je māyik upādhie sahit thako Parameshvarne viṣhe prītivān chhe tene shreṣhṭh kaho chho; te e kevī rīte shreṣhṭh chhe?” Pachhī e prashnanu koīthī samādhān na thayu. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Gītāmā chār prakārnā bhakta kahyā chhe,[3] temā gnānīne ja Bhagwāne potāno ātmā kahyo chhe. Māṭe je māyik upādhine tajīne brahmarūp thaīne Bhagwānne bhaje te ja bhakta shreṣhṭh chhe. Shā māṭe je, nitya pralay je suṣhupti ne nimitta pralay je Brahmānī suṣhupti ne prākṛut pralay je Prakṛutinu kārya sarve Prakṛutine viṣhe līn thaī jāy ane ātyantik pralay je gnān-pralay temā to Prakṛuti paryant sarve Brahmanā prakāshne viṣhe līn thaī jāy chhe. Ane nitya pralaymā jīvnī upādhi līn thaī jāy chhe ne nimitta pralaymā īshvarnī upādhi līn thaī jāy chhe ne prākṛut pralaymā Puruṣhnī upādhi sarve līn thaī jāy chhe, paṇ jyāre sṛuṣhṭi sṛujāy chhe tyāre e traṇene pot-potānī upādhi vaḷage chhe. Ane ātyantik pralay je gnān-pralay teṇe karīne jeṇe māyik upādhino tyāg karyo tene to pāchhī koī kāḷe māyik upādhi vaḷagatī nathī. Ane jo koīk kāḷe deh dhare to jem Bhagwān swatantra thakā deh dhare chhe tem te paṇ swatantra thako deh dhare chhe paṇ kāḷ, karma ne māyā tene ādhīn thako dehne nathī dharato. Māṭe brahmarūp thaīne je Parameshvarne bhaje te ja shreṣhṭh chhe. Ane ā vārtā chhe te je Parameshvarno ananya bhakta chhe ane ekāntik bhaktanā lakṣhaṇe yukta chhe tene ja samajāy chhe.”

1. The four types of devotees described in the Gitā (7.16 & 7.17) are: (1) ārta - one who is distressed from having fallen from the path of attaining yogic powers, and thus still wishes to attain them; (2) jignāsu - one who seeks knowledge of the ātmā, i.e. ātmā-realization; (3) arthārthi - one who desires material objects, i.e. material pleasures and powers; and (4) gnāni - one who has gnān.
૨. અહીં ‘શુદ્ધ સત્ત્વમય’ શબ્દ પૂર્વાપર સંદર્ભ જોતા ગુણાતીતના અર્થમાં વપરાયો છે.

૩. ગીતામાં જણાવેલ આ ચાર પ્રકારના ભક્તનાં વર્ણન વચનામૃત ગ. પ્ર. ૫૬ની ટીપણી-૨૧૯માં કર્યું છે: [આર્તો જિજ્ઞાસુરર્થાર્થી જ્ઞાની ચ ભરતર્ષભ। તેષાં જ્ઞાની નિત્યયુક્ત એકભક્તિર્વિશિષ્યતે॥ અર્થ: અધિકારથી પડી ગયેલો અને ફરી પામવાને ઇચ્છે તે આર્ત, આત્મસ્વરૂપને જાણવાને ઇચ્છે તે જિજ્ઞાસુ, ઐશ્વર્ય પામવાને ઇચ્છે તે અર્થાર્થી, પોતાના આત્માને ત્રિગુણાત્મક માયાથી જુદો બ્રહ્મરૂપ માનીને ભગવાનને પામવાની ઇચ્છા કરનાર જ્ઞાની. આ ચારેયમાં જ્ઞાની પોતાના આત્માને બ્રહ્મસ્વરૂપ માની નિરંતર પરમાત્મામાં જોડાયેલ છે અને એકમાત્ર પરમાત્માની ભક્તિની જ ઇચ્છા રાખે છે, તેથી અધિક છે. (ગીતા: ૭/૧૬-૧૭).]
2. Ahī ‘shuddha sattvamay’ shabda pūrvāpar sandarbh jotā guṇātītnā arthmā vaparāyo chhe.

3. Gītāmā jaṇāvel ā chār prakārnā bhaktanā varṇan Vachanāmṛut G. Pra. 56nī ṭīpaṇī-219mā karyu chhe: [Ārto jignāsurarthārthī gnānī cha bharatarṣhabh | Teṣhām gnānī nityayukta ek-bhaktir-vishiṣhyate || Arth: Adhikārthī paḍī gayelo ane farī pāmavāne ichchhe te ārt, ātmaswarūpne jāṇavāne ichchhe te jignāsu, aishvarya pāmavāne ichchhe te arthārthī, potānā ātmāne triguṇātmak māyāthī judo brahmarūp mānīne Bhagwānne pāmavānī ichchhā karanār gnānī. Ā chāreyamā gnānī potānā ātmāne brahmaswarūp mānī nirantar Paramātmāmā joḍāyel chhe ane ekmātra Paramātmānī bhaktinī ja ichchhā rākhe chhe, tethī adhik chhe. (Gītā: 7/16-17).]
223: Samvat 1882nā Fāgaṇ vadi 2 Dvitīyāne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amdāvād madhye Shrī Naranārāyaṇnā Mandirne sanmukh oṭā upar ḍholiyo ḍhaḷāvīne te upar virājmān hatā ne mastak upar gulābī rangnī pāgh virājmān hatī ne te pāghne viṣhe gulābnā ne chamelīnā hār virājmān hatā tathā potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje samagra muni-manḍaḷ pratye prashna pūchhyo je, “Jīvmātra chhe te panch-viṣhayne ādhāre jīve chhe. Te kā to bāhya panch-viṣhayne bhogavato hoy; ane jyāre bāhya panch-viṣhayno yog na hoy tyāre antahkaraṇmā panch-viṣhaynu chintavan karyā kare, paṇ e jīv viṣhaynā chintavan vinā ne viṣhayne bhogavyā vinā kṣhaṇmātra paṇ rahī shakato nathī. Ane jem vaḍnu vṛukṣh chhe tenā je mūḷ te ja vaḍne līlo rākhe chhe; ane bījā sarve mūḷ ūkhaḍī gayā hoy ne jo ek vaḍavāī pṛuthvīmā choṭī rahī hoy to paṇ e vaḍnu vṛukṣh līlu rahe chhe. Tem upar thakī kadāchit panch-viṣhayno tyāg karyo chhe paṇ antarmā viṣhaynu chintavan thāy chhe e ja ene janma-maraṇno hetu chhe. Evā je panch-viṣhay te Parameshvarnā bhaktane kevī rīte janma-maraṇnā hetu nathī? E prashna chhe.” Pachhī eno uttar jem samajāyo tem Muktānand Swāmīe karyo paṇ yathārth samādhān thayu nahī. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Lyo, e prashnano uttar ame karīe je, māyāmay evā je traṇ sharīr tenī bhāvanāe rahit kevaḷ ātmasattārūpe rahīne je bhakta Parameshvarnī mūrtinu chintavan karato hoy, tene Bhagwānnā chintavanne baḷe karīne jyāre upasham avasthā varte tyāre e bhaktane upashamne baḷe karīne panch-viṣhay janma-maraṇnā hetu na thāy. Jem Mahī jevī ke Sābarmatī jevī nadī be kānṭhāmā vahetī hoy tyāre hāthī, ghoḍā, vṛukṣh sarve taṇāī jāy paṇ koī ṭharī shake nahī; tem upashamvāḷāne paṇ game tevā ramaṇīya bhog indriyone gochar thayā hoy paṇ jyāre antar sanmukh draṣhṭi kare tyāre jevā pūrvajanmane viṣhe dekhyā hoy ne te ā janmamā vīsarī jāy chhe, tevī tenī vismṛuti thaī jāy chhe. Evī rīte je bhaktane vartatu hoy te upasham kahevāy. Te upashamno mahimā ati moṭo chhe. Ane je ā sansārne viṣhe agnānī strī-puruṣh hoy ne tene parṇāvyā mor atishay prīti vartatī hoy. Ne pachhī tene parṇāvīne traṇ rāt ne traṇ divas sudhī ujāgaro ne panth karāvyo hoy, ne pachhī e bene bheḷā karyā hoy to nidrāne mārye ek-bījānā rūpnu ke sparshnu sukh bhogavavāne samarth thāy nahī; ane ek-bījāne ālingan karī rahyā hoy to paṇ jem kāṣhṭhne sām-sāmā bāndhī mūkyā hoy tem sūtā hoy paṇ panch-viṣhaymā eke sukh āve nahī. E jo agnānkāḷe suṣhuptimā upashamne pāmyā chhe to paṇ koī jātnī viṣhaynī khabar rahetī nathī; to je gnānī chhe ne Parameshvarnā swarūpne dhyāne karīne upashamdashāne pāmyo chhe tene panch-viṣhay kem bādh kare? Na ja kare. Māṭe je upashamdashāne pāmyo tene panch-viṣhay janma-maraṇnā hetu thatā nathī.”

Pachhī Nityānand Swāmīe pūchhyu je, “Upashamdashā pāmyāno tame kahyo je ātmārūpe thaīne Bhagwānnā dhyān karavārūp upāy te to ati kaṭhaṇ chhe. Māṭe te vinā bījo eno sugam upāy hoy te kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ek to Bhagwānnu atishay māhātmya samajato hoy; ane bīju Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktanī sevā-chākarī, darshan karavu temā atishay vegvān shraddhā vartatī hoy; evo je Bhagwānno bhakta tene e upashamdashā āve chhe. Paṇ amane em bhāse chhe je, je sevak mānī hashe te to koīne nahī gamato hoy. Ane mānī sevak pāse je ṭel-chākarī karāvavī, te to jem kāḷ paḍe tyāre moṭā māṇas paṇ kodarā khāīne jīve, tem mānī sevaknī pāse sevā-chākarī karāvavī te paṇ evī chhe. Ane dhaṇīno rājīpo to jevo nirmānī sevak upar hoy evo mānī upar na hoy. Māṭe dhaṇīnu gamatu kare te ja sevak sācho.”

Pachhī Shukmunie pūchhyu je, “Jene vivek ne samajaṇ na hoy te dhaṇīne kem rājī kare?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Mūḷjī Brahmachārī ne Ratanjī e atishay kyā ḍāhyā chhe? Paṇ kalyāṇno khap atishay chhe; māṭe Bhagwān jem rājī thāy tem emane karatā āvaḍe chhe kharu. Ane vaḷī ā samaymā to Ayodhyāvāsī bāī-bhāī sarve jevā amārā gamatāmā varte chhe, tevā to Paramhansa tathā sānkhyayogī ne karmayogī satsangī te paṇ amārā gamatāmā nathī vartatā. Kem je, Ayodhyāvāsīe to atishay ja satsang-parāyaṇ potānu jīvitavya karyu chhe; māṭe Ayodhyāvāsīnī peṭhe Bhagwānne rājī karatā koīne āvaḍatu nathī. Ane e Ayodhyāvāsī to bahu vishvāsī chhe; māṭe koīk kapaṭī hashe to emane chhetarī jashe. Te sāru emane koīk kāryano ādar karavo hoy tyāre moṭerā Paramhansa tathā moṭerā satsangī gṛuhasth temane pūchhīne te kām karavā devu, paṇ koīk ek jaṇāne kahye karavā devu nahī. Evī rīte tyāgī tathā gṛuhasth satsangīne Ayodhyāvāsīnī khabar rākhavī em amārī āgnā chhe.”
224: Samvat 1882nā Vaishākh vadi 11 Ekādashīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Gaḍhaḍā madhye Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā Shrī Vāsudev Nārāyaṇnā faḷiyānī māhelī kore āthamṇe dvār oraḍānī ūchī osarīe gādītakiye yukta je sundar rangit ḍholiyo te upar virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane mastakne viṣhe je moṭī shvet pāgh temā sundar mogarānā puṣhpano toro virājmān hato ane kanṭhne viṣhe mogarānā puṣhpano hār virājmān hato ane be hāthne viṣhe te puṣhpanā gajarā virājmān hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje Paramhansane pūchhyu je, “Parameshvarnā bhaktane bhūnḍā desh-kāḷādikno yog thāy toy paṇ Bhagwānnī bhaktimā vighna thāy nahī evī shī samajaṇ chhe?” Pachhī Paramhansane jevu samajāyu tevu kahyu paṇ yathārth uttar thayo nahī. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Je Bhagwānne bhaje tene ek to draḍh vairāgya joīe ane bījī ātmaniṣhṭhā joīe. Temā jo vairāgya na hoy to jyāre mangamatu padārth maḷe tyāre jem Bhagwānmā prīti kare chhe tem bījā padārthmā paṇ Bhagwānnā jevī prīti thaī jāy. Ane jo ātmaniṣhṭhā na hoy to jyāre dehmā sukh-dukh āve tyāre e bhaktanī vṛuttio chūnthāī jāy; pachhī jene sukhdāyī jāṇe temā prīti kare ane jene dukhdāyī jāṇe te sāthe dveṣh kare, evī rīte enī buddhi bhraṣhṭ thaī jāy. Māṭe Bhagwānnā bhaktane ātmaniṣhṭhā ane vairāgya e bey atishay draḍh joīe. Shā sāru je, vairāgye karīne to Bhagwānnī mūrti vinā bījā māyik ākārmātra khoṭā thaī jāy chhe ane ātmaniṣhṭhāe karīne māyik je sukh ne dukh te khoṭā thaī jāy chhe. Ane jene vairāgya ne ātmaniṣhṭhā na hoy tene to nirvikalp samādhi thaī hoy to paṇ jyā sudhī samādhimā rahe tyā sudhī sukh-shānti rahe ane jyāre samādhimāthī bahār nīsare tyāre Nārāyaṇdāsnī peṭhe sārā padārthne joīne chāḷā chūnthavā mānḍe.[74]

“Ane vaḷī je Bhagwānnā bhakta hoy tene to Bhagwānne viṣhe gnānnu ang hoy ne kā to hetnu ang hoy. Temā jene gnānnu ang hoy te to Bhagwānnu atishay māhātmya samaje ane jene hetnu ang hoy tene to Bhagwān vinā ardha ghaḍī chāle nahī. Te gnānnā angvāḷā to Zīṇo Bhāī, Devrām ne Prabhāshankar chhe. Evī rīte je haribhakta Bhagwānnu māhātmya jāṇe tene gnānnā angvāḷā jāṇavā. Ane jevu Vrajnī Gopīone Bhagwānne viṣhe het hatu[1] tevī rītnā je haribhakta hoy tene hetnu ang jāṇavu.[2] Ane jene gnānnu ang hoy te Bhagwānne antaryāmī jāṇe ane em jāṇe je, ‘Bhagwān te koīnu kahyu sāmbhaḷe ja nahī. Bhagwān to je bhaktanu jevu ang hoy tene tevu jāṇīne tevī rīte kahe chhe paṇ koīnī shikhāmaṇe karīne chālatā nathī.’ Ane je em jāṇe je, ‘Bhagwān to koīknā shīkhavyā thakā mārāmā vāk nathī to paṇ mane kahe chhe,’ tene to Bhagwānnā swarūpnu gnān ja nathī. Ane ā sansārmā paṇ je manuṣhyane je sangāthe svārth hoy teno koī rīte avaguṇ le nahī; shā māṭe je, ene potānā svārthnu het chhe. To jeṇe Bhagwān sāthe janma-maraṇnā bhay thakī chhūṭavāno svārth jāṇyo hoy tene koī rīte Bhagwānno avaguṇ āve nahī. Ane je em jāṇe je, ‘Bhagwān to koīknā feravyā farī jāy chhe,’ em samajīne je Bhagwānno avaguṇ le, tene to gnānnu ang paṇ nathī ane hetnu ang paṇ nathī.” Evī rīte kahīne Shrījī Mahārāje moṭā moṭā Paramhansane kahyu je, “Tame tamāru e bemāthī je ang hoy te kaho.” Pachhī sarve Paramahanse kahyu je, “Amāre to gnānnu ang chhe.”

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene hetnu ang hoy tene to potānā je priyatam tene arthe je na karavānu hoy te paṇ thāy. Kem je, ā sansārne viṣhe je chor hoy tene pot-potānī strī ne chhokarā tene viṣhe het hoy chhe. Ane jyāre chorī karavā jāy tyāre bījā māṇasne mārīne potānā gharnā māṇasne dravya āpe chhe. Ane e chor ghaṇo nirday chhe paṇ potānā kuṭumbī upar het chhe to te sangāthe nirday nathī thato. Tem jene Bhagwān ke Bhagwānnā bhakta sangāthe het hoy tene Bhagwān ke Bhagwānnā bhakta upar krodh ke īrṣhyā āve ja nahī ane avaguṇ paṇ koī rīte āve ja nahī. Evu jene het hoy tene hetnu ang kahīe. Ane jene gnān ke het e bemāthī ekey ang nathī, tene chāḷāchūthaṇo kahīe.” Eṭalī vārtā[3] kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj potānā utārāmā padhāryā.

Pachhī te ja divas sānjne same Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā ugamṇe dvār oraḍānī osarīe gādītakiyā bichhāvel ḍholiyā upar virājmān thayā hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane kanṭhne viṣhe mogarānā puṣhpano hār paheryo hato ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Ane potānī āgaḷ sādhu dūkaḍ-sarodā vajāvīne kīrtan gātā hatā. Te kīrtan-bhakti jyāre karī rahyā tyāre Shrījī Mahārāje em āgnā karī je, “Amārī lakhelī je Shikṣhāpatrī teno pāṭh amārā āshrit je tyāgī sādhu tathā brahmachārī tathā gṛuhasth bāī-bhāī sarve temaṇe nitye karavo. Ane jene bhaṇatā na āvaḍatu hoy tene nitye shravaṇ karavu ane jene shravaṇ karavāno yog na āve tene nitye Shikṣhāpatrīnī pūjā karavī, evī rīte ame Shikṣhāpatrīmā ja lakhyu chhe. Māṭe e traṇmāthī jene fer paḍe tene ek upavās karavo, em amārī āgnā chhe.” Evī rītnī je Shrījī Mahārājnī āgnā tene pāḷavāno niyam e sarvee dhāryo je, “He Mahārāj! Jem tame kaho chho tem ame sarve pāḷashu.” Tene sāmbhaḷīne Shrījī Mahārāj atishay prasanna thaīne sarve sādhune ane sarve brahmachārīne maḷatā havā ane sarve satsangīnā hṛudayne viṣhe potānā charaṇārvind āpatā havā.

1. Once, Shriji Maharaj was distributing new daglis to the sadhus whose old one had torn. Narayandas had a good dagli, but to get a new one, he hid his old one in the gutter. Maharaj gave him a new dagli. When cleaning out the gutter, they found his dagli with his name written on it. Maharaj scolded him. Despite being able to experience samādhi, one may try to cheat God to acquire the best of clothes.
૨. તે હેતના અંગવાળા તો સચ્ચિદાનંદ મુનિ, કૃપાનંદ મુનિ, પૂંજો ભક્ત વગેરે છે.

૭૪. એક વખત શ્રીજીમહારાજ જેની ડગલી ફાટી ગઈ હોય તેવા સૌ સંતોને નવી ડગલી આપતા હતા. નારાયણદાસ પાસે ડગલી હતી પણ નવી લેવા માટે તેણે જૂની ડગલી ઉકરડામાં સંતાડી દીધી અને મહારાજ પાસે નવી ડગલી માંગી. મહારાજે તેને નવી ડગલી આપી, પરંતુ એક વખત ઉકરડો ઉથામતાં તેમાંથી ડગલી નીકળી. તેના પર નામ નારાયણદાસનું હતું, તેથી મહારાજે તેમને બોલાવીને ઠપકો આપ્યો. આમ સમાધિનિષ્ઠ હોય તોપણ નવા વસ્ત્ર માટે ભગવાનને પણ છેતરવાનો પ્રયત્ન કર્યો.
2. Te hetnā angvāḷā to Sachchidānand Muni, Kṛupānand Muni, Pūnjo Bhakta vagere chhe.

74. Ek vakhat Shrījī Mahārāj jenī ḍagalī fāṭī gaī hoy tevā sau santone navī ḍagalī āpatā hatā. Nārāyaṇdās pāse ḍagalī hatī paṇ navī levā māṭe teṇe jūnī ḍagalī ukarḍāmā santāḍī dīdhī ane Mahārāj pāse navī ḍagalī māngī. Mahārāje tene navī ḍagalī āpī, parantu ek vakhat ukarḍo uthāmatā temāthī ḍagalī nīkaḷī. Tenā par nām Nārāyaṇdāsnu hatu, tethī Mahārāje temane bolāvīne ṭhapako āpyo. Ām samādhi-niṣhṭh hoy topaṇ navā vastra māṭe Bhagwānne paṇ chhetarvāno prayatna karyo.
225: Samvat 1882nā Jyeṣhṭh sudi 6 Chhaṭhane divas sānjne same Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Gaḍhaḍā madhye Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā Shrī Vāsudev Nārāyaṇnā mandirnā faḷiyāne viṣhe bājoṭh upar virājmān hatā ane mastak upar shyām chheḍānī dhoḷī pāgh bāndhī hatī ane shvet chādar oḍhī hatī ane shvet khes paheryo hato ane pāghne viṣhe mogarānā puṣhpano toro khosyo hato ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje prashna pūchhyo je, “Jagatne nāshvant dekhe chhe ane dehne mūkīne chaitanya judo thaī jāy chhe tene paṇ dekhe chhe, to paṇ ā jīvne jagatnu pradhānpaṇu hṛudaymāthī maṭatu nathī. Ane Parameshvarne sarva prakāre sukhnā sindhu jāṇe chhe to paṇ Parameshvarmā jīvnu chitta choṭatu nathī, tem satsang paṇ enā hṛudaymā mukhya thato nathī ane dhan, strīādik je sānsārik padārth temāthī prīti maṭatī nathī. Tenu shu kāraṇ hashe?” Pachhī Muktānand Swāmīe kahyu je, “Jīvnā hṛudaymā vairāgya nathī teṇe karīne jagatnu pradhānpaṇu maṭatu nathī ne Bhagwānmā prīti thatī nathī.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Vairāgyanī nyūnatā chhe e to vāt sāchī; paṇ amane to em bhāse chhe je, jene satsang thatā thatā[4] jevu ang bandhāy jāy chhe tevu ne tevu ja sadāy rahe chhe paṇ te vinā bīju thatu nathī.[5] Ane satsange karīne te angnī puṣhṭi to thāy paṇ ang to tenu te ja rahe chhe. Ane jyāre jene je ang bandhāy chhe, tyāre ang bandhātā enu chitta vibhrānt jevu thaī jāy chhe. Jem kāmī hoy tenu chitta kāme karīne vibhrānt thāy ne jem krodhī hoy tenu chitta krodhe karīne vibhrānt thāy ne jem lobhī hoy tenu chitta lobhe karīne vibhrānt thāy, tem enu chitta ang bandhātā vibhrānt thaī jāy chhe.[86] Pachhī te vibhrāntmā jevu ang bandhāy tevu ang rahe chhe. Māṭe je samaju hoy tene potānu je ang hoy tene oḷakhī rākhyu joīe; te jyāre kām-krodhādike karīne potāne vikṣhep thato hoy, tyāre potānā angno vichār kare to te kāmādik kṣhīṇ paḍī jāy. Jem koīk gṛuhasth hoy tene potānī mātā, bon athavā dīkarī ati swarūpvān hoy, tene joīne jo bhūnḍo ghāṭ thaī jāy to pachhī tenī kevī dāz thāy! Tevī dāz jyāre satsang vinā bīju padārth pradhān thāy tyāre thaī joīe. Ane jyāre evī dāz ayogya pradārthnā sankalpne dekhīne na thāy tenā hṛudaymā to satsang paṇ pradhān na rahe. Ane sarve sādhannā faḷrūp to ā satsang chhe, te Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwāne Uddhav pratye Ekādash Skandhmā kahyu chhe je, ‘Aṣhṭāng-Yog tathā sānkhya-vichār tathā shāstra-paṭhan tathā tap, tyāg, yog, yagna ane vratādike karīne hu tevo vash thato nathī jevo satsange karīne vash thāu chhu.’[6] Māṭe amane to em bhāse chhe je, pūrva-janmano sanskār hashe te paṇ satpuruṣhne yoge karīne thayo hashe ane āj paṇ jene sanskār thāy chhe te satpuruṣhne yoge karīne ja thāy chhe. Māṭe evā satpuruṣhno sang prāpt thayo chhe to paṇ jene jem chhe tem samajātu nathī tene atishay mand-buddhivāḷo jāṇavo. Shā māṭe je, jevī Shvetdvīpmā sabhā chhe ne jevī Golok, Vaikunṭhlokne viṣhe sabhā chhe ne jevī Badarikāshramne viṣhe sabhā chhe, tethī paṇ hu ā satsangīnī sabhāne adhik jāṇu chhu ane sarve haribhaktane atishay prakāshe yukta dekhu chhu. Emā jo lagār paṇ mithyā kahetā hoīe to ā sant-sabhānā sam chhe. Te sam shā sāru khāvā paḍe chhe je, sarvane evu alaukikpaṇu samajātu nathī ane dekhavāmā paṇ āvatu nathī, te sāru sam khāvā paḍe chhe. Ane Brahmādikne paṇ durlabh evo je ā satsang temā āvīne Parameshvar vinā jene bījā padārthmā het rahe chhe tenu kāraṇ e chhe je, jevī e jīvne parokṣhne viṣhe pratīti chhe tevī pratyakṣhne viṣhe draḍhapaṇe pratīti thatī nathī. Te Shrutimā kahyu chhe je, ‘Jevī parokṣh devne viṣhe jīvne pratīti chhe tevī jo pratyakṣh gururūp Harine viṣhe āve, to jeṭalā arth prāpt thavānā kahyā chhe teṭalā sarve arth tene prāpt thāy chhe.’[7] Ane jyāre āvo sant-samāgam prāpt thayo tyāre deh mūkīne jene pāmavā hatā te to deh chhatā ja maḷyā chhe; māṭe jene param pad kahīe, mokṣh kahīe tene chhate dehe ja pāmyo chhe. Ane ā vārtā je kahī, te jaṇāy chhe to jāḍī jevī, paṇ e to atishay zīṇī chhe. Te je evī rīte vartato hoy tene em samajāya je, ‘E vārtā ati zīṇī chhe,’ ne bījāne to samajyāmā paṇ āve nahī; evī atishay zīṇī vārtā chhe.” Em vārtā karīne Shrījī Mahārāj ‘Jay Sachchidānand’ kahīne potānā utārāmā padhāryā.

1. In the English translation, words such as ‘disturbed’ or ‘disoriented’ are used for the original Gujarati word ‘vibhrant’. However, this word can be interpreted two ways: one negative and one positive.
(1) Vibhrant as Confused, Perplexed, or Lacking Discernment
In this context, vibhrant means being filled with excessive delusion, entanglement, or doubt; a state where one lacks the faculty to distinguish between right and wrong.
The Seeker’s Struggle: When a spiritual seeker (mumukshu) initially hears or reads about various spiritual paths (inclination or ang) to please God or attain the state of brahmarup, their mind becomes vibhrant. Just as a mind overwhelmed by lust, anger, or greed loses its sense of judgment and acts impulsively, a seeker becomes confused about which path to follow. They wonder: “What should I do? Which path is appropriate for me right now?” In such a state, they may fail to do what is necessary and do what is not.
The Solution: As they engage more in Satsang, they begin to understand their own specific spiritual inclination. Once the seeker identifies their ang (inclination), they can then pick up specific words from discourses or scriptures that strengthen that particular path.
(2) Vibhrant as Deeply Absorbed, Engrossed, or Beyond Delusion
In this context, vibhrant means to be completely immersed or enveloped in something; a state of focused absorption.
Natural Immersion: Just as a lustful person’s mind becomes completely enveloped in desire, or a greedy person’s mind is consumed by greed, a seeker’s mind can become vibhrant in spiritual practice.
Identifying One’s Path: While practicing various disciplines like atmanishtha, dasatva, pativratapanu, service, or listening to spiritual discourses, the specific method in which the mind becomes naturally ‘vibhrant’—meaning the path in which one connects effortlessly and finds genuine joy—becomes that seeker’s settled spiritual path (ang).
2. Here ‘arthas’ should be understood as ‘purushārths’ - dharma, arth, kām and moksha (liberation).

૬. મૂળ શ્લોક તથા ક્રમાંક વચનામૃત ગ. મ. ૫૪ની ટીપણી-૧૨૬માં છે: [ન રોધયતિ માં યોગો ન સાંખ્યં ધર્મ એવ ચ। ન સ્વાધ્યાયસ્તપસ્ત્યાગો નેષ્ટાપૂર્તં ન દક્ષિણા॥ વ્રતાનિ યજ્ઞશ્છન્દાંસિ તીર્થાનિ નિયમા યમાઃ। યથાવરુન્ધે સત્સંગઃ સર્વસંગાપહો હિ મામ્॥ આ શ્લોકનો અર્થ છે. (ભાગવત: ૧૧/૧૨/૧-૨).]

૮૬. ‘વિભ્રાંત’ શબ્દના બે પ્રકારે અર્થઘટનને આધારે આ કથનને બે રીતે સમજીએ.
(૧) અહીં વિભ્રાંત એટલે વિશેષ ભ્રમથી યુક્ત, ગૂંચવાયેલું; સંશયવાળું; યોગ્ય-અયોગ્યનો વિવેક રહિત.
મુમુક્ષુને જ્યારે શરૂઆતમાં ભગવાનને રાજી કરવા માટેનાં કે બ્રહ્મરૂપ થવા માટેનાં જુદાં જુદાં અંગો વિષે વાતો કથાવાર્તામાં સાંભળવામાં આવે અથવા ગ્રંથોમાં વાંચવામાં આવે, ત્યારે એનું ચિત્ત (મન) વિભ્રાંત થઈ જાય છે. જેમ કોઈનું મન કામ, ક્રોધ કે લોભથી વિભ્રાંત થાય છે, ત્યારે તેને યોગ્ય-અયોગ્યનો વિવેક રહેતો નથી અને જે નથી કરવાનું તે કરી બેસે છે; તેમ મુમુક્ષુનું મન જ્યારે વિભ્રાંત થાય છે ત્યારે એને મૂંઝવણ (દ્વિધા) એ થાય છે કે આમાંથી મારે શું કરવું? અત્યારે કયું અંગ મારા માટે યોગ્ય છે અને કયું અંગ મારા માટે યોગ્ય નથી? તેથી આવી વિભ્રાંત દશામાં કરવાનું ન થાય અને ન કરવાનું થાય. પરંતુ પછી જેમ જેમ વધુને વધુ સત્સંગ કરે તેમ તેમ એને પોતાના અંગનો ખ્યાલ આવે છે. મુમુક્ષુને પોતાના અંગનો ખ્યાલ આવ્યા પછી કથાવાર્તામાંથી કે ગ્રંથના વાંચનમાંથી પોતાના અંગને પુષ્ટ કરતા શબ્દો ગ્રહણ કરીને તે પોતાના અંગની પુષ્ટિ કરે છે.
(૨) અહીં વિભ્રાંત એટલે અતિશય તન્મય, આવૃત્ત; ભ્રાંતિરહિત
કામી વ્યક્તિને જ્યારે કામ વ્યાપે ત્યારે તેનું મન કામમાં આવૃત્ત થઈ જાય છે. તેને કામ સિવાય અન્ય કોઈ વિચાર રહેતો નથી. તે જ પ્રમાણે ક્રોધીને ક્રોધમાં અને લોભીને લોભમાં મન તન્મય બની જાય છે. આ જ પ્રકારે આત્મનિષ્ઠા, દાસત્વ, પતિવ્રતાપણું, સેવા, કથા વગેરે સમજણ કે ભક્તિ સંબંધી સાધના કરતાં કરતાં જે ઉપાયમાં પોતાનું મન વિભ્રાંત થાય એટલે કે જે ઉપાયમાં પોતે સહજ રીતે જોડાઈ જાય, જેમાં પોતાને આનંદ આવે તે ઉપાયરૂપી અંગ તેને બંધાય છે.

86. ‘Vibhrānt’ shabdanā be prakāre artha-ghaṭanne ādhāre ā kathanne be rīte samajīe.
(1) Ahī vibhrānt eṭale visheṣh bhramathī yukta, gūchavāyelu; sanshayavāḷu; yogya-ayogyano vivek rahit.
Mumukṣhune jyāre sharūātmā Bhagwānne rājī karavā māṭenā ke brahmarūp thavā māṭenā judā judā ango viṣhe vāto kathā-vārtāmā sāmbhaḷavāmā āve athavā granthomā vānchavāmā āve, tyāre enu chitta (man) vibhrānt thaī jāy chhe. Jem koīnu man kām, krodh ke lobhthī vibhrānt thāy chhe, tyāre tene yogya-ayogyano vivek raheto nathī ane je nathī karavānu te karī bese chhe; tem mumukṣhunu man jyāre vibhrānt thāy chhe tyāre ene mūnzavaṇ (dvidhā) e thāy chhe ke āmāthī māre shu karavu? Atyāre kayu ang mārā māṭe yogya chhe ane kayu ang mārā māṭe yogya nathī? Tethī āvī vibhrānt dashāmā karavānu na thāy ane na karavānu thāy. Parantu pachhī jem jem vadhune vadhu satsang kare tem tem ene potānā angno khyāl āve chhe. Mumukṣhune potānā angno khyāl āvyā pachhī kathā-vārtāmāthī ke granthanā vānchanmāthī potānā angne puṣhṭa karatā shabdo grahaṇ karīne te potānā angnī puṣhṭi kare chhe.
(2) Ahī vibhrānt eṭale atishay tanmay, āvṛutta; bhrānti-rahit
Kāmī vyaktine jyāre kām vyāpe tyāre tenu man kāmmā āvṛutta thaī jāy chhe. Tene kām sivāy anya koī vichār raheto nathī. Te ja pramāṇe krodhīne krodhamā ane lobhīne lobhamā man tanmay banī jāy chhe. Ā ja prakāre ātmaniṣhṭhā, dāsatva, pativratāpaṇu, sevā, kathā vagere samajaṇ ke bhakti sambandhī sādhanā karatā karatā je upāymā potānu man vibhrānt thāy eṭale ke je upāyamā pote sahaj rīte joḍāī jāy, jemā potāne ānand āve te upāyarūpī ang tene bandhāy chhe.
226: Samvat 1883nā Āṣhāḍh vadi 1 Paḍavāne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Gaḍhaḍā madhye Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā potānā utārāne viṣhe virājmān hatā. Ane te divas Ṭhakkar Harjīe[8] potāne gher Shrījī Mahārājnī padharāmaṇī karī tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj tyā padhāryā. Pachhī ugamṇe dvār oraḍānī osarīye ḍholiyā upar gādītakiyā bichhāvīne Shrījī Mahārājne virājmān karyā. Pachhī Harjī Ṭhakkare Shrījī Mahārājnī kesar-chandanādike karīne pūjā karī. Evī rīte Shrījī Mahārāj pūrva mukhārvinde virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane kanṭhne viṣhe mogarānā puṣhpanā hār tathā be bhujāne viṣhe te puṣhpanā gajarā tathā pāghne viṣhe te puṣhpanā torā te atishay virājmān hatā. Ane Shrījī Mahārājnā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni-manḍaḷ tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Te samaymā Shrījī Mahārāje sarva sant-manḍaḷne prashna pūchhyo je, “Je haribhaktanā hṛudayne viṣhe dayā ne sneh e be svābhāvik rahyā hoy tyāre snehnu swarūp to madh jevu chhe te jyā-tyā chonṭe ane dayāno swabhāv evo chhe je, jyā-tyā dayā kare. Tyāre Bharatjīe mṛugalā upar dayā karī to te mṛugalīne peṭe janma levo paḍyo.[9] Ane je dayāvān hoy tene je upar dayā āve te sangāthe sneh thayā vinā rahe nahī. Ane e dayā ne sneh tene ṭāḷyāno upāy to ātmagnān ne vairāgya e bey chhe. Te ātmagnān evu chhe je, jemā kāī bīju pese ja nahī. Ane vairāgyanu evu swarūp chhe je, sarve nāmrūpne nāshvant dekhāḍe. Māṭe ātmagnān ne vairāgya e be vate karīne dayā ne snehno nāsh thaī jāy chhe ane sthūḷ, sūkṣhma ne kāraṇ e ādik sarve upādhino paṇ nāsh thaī jāy chhe ane kevaḷ brahmasattāmātra rahe chhe. Pachhī ene Bhagwān tathā Bhagwānnā bhaktane viṣhe dayā ne sneh rahe chhe ke nathī raheto? E prashna chhe.” Pachhī Muktānand Swāmī tathā Shukmuni tathā Nityānand Swāmī e ādik Paramahanse jenī jevī draṣhṭi pūgī tevo teṇe uttar karyo paṇ Shrījī Mahārājnā prashnanu samādhān thayu nahī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Lyo, ame uttar karīe. Eno to uttar em chhe je, gnān ne vairāgya karīne traṇ sharīr, traṇ avasthā ne traṇ guṇ e sarva māyik upādhi thakī chaitanya judo thaī jāy chhe ne kevaḷ sattāmātra rahe chhe, paṇ māyik upādhino lesh paṇ raheto nathī. Tyāre jem dīpakno agni te koḍiyu, tel ne vāṭya traṇne yoge karīne draṣhṭimā āve tathā grahaṇ karyāmā āve, paṇ jyāre e traṇ prakārnī upādhino sang chhūṭī jāy chhe tyāre e agni koīnī draṣhṭimā paṇ na āve ne grahaṇ paṇ na thāy; ne upādhie yukta hoy tyāre ja draṣhṭie āve ne grahaṇ karyāmā āve. Tem gnān-vairāgye karīne sarve māyik upādhi nivṛutti pāme chhe tyāre e jīvātmā chhe te kevaḷ brahmasattāmātra rahe chhe ne te man-vāṇīne agochar chhe ne koī indriye karīne grahaṇ karyāmā āvato nathī. Pachhī te kāḷe to ene jo shuddha sampradāye karīne Bhagwānnu gnān prāpt thayu hoy ne Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktanu māhātmya yathārthpaṇe samajāyu hoy, tene to sarva māyik upādhino sang ṭaḷī jāy ne potāno jīvātmā brahmarūp thāy to paṇ Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktane viṣhe je dayā ne prīti te nirantar rahe chhe. Tyā draṣhṭānt chhe: jem dīpaknī jyot chhe tene jyāre upādhino sang ṭaḷī jāy chhe tyāre e agni koī indriye karīne grahaṇ na thāy evo ākāshne viṣhe rahe chhe to paṇ e agnine viṣhe sugandhī tathā durgandhīno je pāsh lāgyo hoy te ṭaḷato nathī. Jem vāyu chhe te to agni thakī paṇ vadhu asangī chhe to paṇ tene sugandhī tathā durgandhīno pāsh lāge chhe. Tem je jīvātmāne gnān-vairāgye karīne māyik upādhino sang ṭaḷī jāy chhe to paṇ satsangno pāsh lāgyo chhe te ṭaḷato nathī. Ane te brahmarūp thāy chhe to paṇ Nārad-Sanakādik ne Shukjīnī peṭhe Bhagwān tathā Bhagwānnā bhaktane viṣhe atishay dayā ne prītie yukta varte chhe. Tyā shlok -

‘Pariniṣhṭhito’pi nairguṇya uttamashlokalīlayā |
Gṛuhītachetā rājarṣhe ākhyānam yadadhītavān ||’[10]
“tathā

‘Harerguṇākṣhiptamatir-bhagwān bādarāyaṇihi |
Adhyagānmahadākhyānam nityam viṣhṇujanapriyah ||’[11]
“tathā ‘Ātmārāmāshcha munayo’[12] tathā ‘Prāyeṇ munayo rājan’[13] tathā Gītāmā kahyu chhe je,

‘Brahmabhūtah prasannātmā na shochati na kā'nkṣhati |
Samah sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu madbhaktim labhate parām ||’[14]

“ityādik ghaṇāk shloke karīne pratipādan karyu chhe je, Bhagwānnā bhakta hoy te gnān-vairāgye karīne māyik upādhine tyāg karīne brahmarūp thayā hoy to paṇ Bhagwān tathā Bhagwānnā bhaktane viṣhe dayā ne prīti teṇe yukta hoy chhe. Ane je Bhagwānno bhakta na hoy ne kevaḷ ātmagnān ne vairāgye karīne māyik upādhine ṭāḷīne sattāmātra vartato hoy, tene to sādhan-dashāne viṣhe Bhagwānnī upāsanāe rahit evā je kevaḷ ātmagnānī tenā sangrūp kusangno pāsh lāgyo chhe; māṭe Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktane viṣhe dayā ne sneh thatā nathī. Jem vāyune ne agnine durgandhno pāsh lāge chhe tem ja ene te kusangno pāsh lāgyo chhe, te koī prakāre ṭaḷato nathī. Jem Ashvatthāmā brahmarūp thayo hato,[15] paṇ ene kusangno pāsh lāgyo hato; māṭe Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān ne te Bhagwānnā bhakta je Pānḍav tene viṣhe dayā ne sneh thayā nahī. Tem kevaḷ je ātmagnānī chhe te brahmarūp thāy chhe to paṇ tene kusangno pāsh jato nathī ne Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktamā dayā ne sneh thatā nathī. Māṭe Bhagwānnā bhaktane to māyik upādhino sang maṭī jāy chhe to paṇ Bhagwān tathā Bhagwānnā bhakta tene viṣhe atishay dayā ne prīti vṛuddhine pāme chhe; paṇ koī rīte dayā tathā prīti ṭaḷatī nathī, akhanḍ rahe chhe.” Em vārtā karīne Shrījī Mahārāj ‘Jay Sachchidānand’ kahīne potāne utāre padhāryā.

1. परिनिष्ठितोऽपि नैर्गुण्य उत्तमश्लोकलीलया।
गृहीतचेता राजर्षे आख्यानं यदधीतवान्॥
O King [Parikshit]! Despite being perfectly poised in the nirgun state, I [Shukdevji] - having been attracted by the divine actions and incidents of God - studied the [Shrimad Bhāgwat] epic. - Shrimad Bhāgwat: 2.1.9

2. हरेर्गुणाक्षिप्तमतिर्भगवान् बादरायणिः।
अध्यगान्महदाख्यानं नित्यं विष्णुजनप्रियः॥
Honourable [Shukdevji] - son of Vyās, and to whom devotees of Vishnu are very dear - was attracted by the virtues of God, and thus constantly studied the great [Shrimad Bhāgwat] epic. - Shrimad Bhāgwat: 1.7.11

3. आत्मारामाश्च मुनयो...॥
Despite being engaged [only] in the ātmā [i.e. having attained ātmā-realization] and despite having overcome all base natures - the munis [still] offer selfless bhakti to God [because] God possesses such [divine] qualities. - Shrimad Bhāgwat: 1.7.10

4. प्रायेण मुनयो राजन्...॥
O King [Parikshit]! [Although] the munis had no need for the rules of moral conduct and had attained the nirgun state, they [still] engaged themselves in extolling the glory of God. - Shrimad Bhāgwat: 2.1.7

5. ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचती न कांक्षति।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्‌भक्तिं लभते पराम्॥
One who has become brahmarup remains joyful, grieves nothing, desires nothing, behaves equally with all beings, and attains my supreme bhakti. - Bhagwad Gitā: 18.54
૮. ગઢડાના ખોજા ભક્ત.

૧૦. વચનામૃત પં. ૨ની ટીપણી-૧૭માં આ શ્લોકનો અર્થ તથા સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંક દર્શાવ્યા છે: [અર્થ: શુકદેવજી કહે છે કે, “હું નિર્ગુણ બ્રહ્મમાં સ્થિતિ કરું છું, છતાં હે રાજર્ષિ! ઉત્તમ કીર્તિવાળા ભગવાનની લીલા મારા મનને આકર્ષે છે અને તેથી જ આ ભાગવત આખ્યાન હું ભણ્યો છું.” (ભાગવત: ૨/૧/૯).]
૧૧. અર્થ: ભગવાનના ગુણોથી જેની બુદ્ધિ આકર્ષિત થઈ છે અને વિષ્ણુજનો જેને પ્રિય છે એવા ભગવાન શુકમુનિ ભાગવતરૂપ જે મોટું આખ્યાન તેને નિરંતર ભણવા હવા. (ભાગવત: ૧/૭/૧૧).

૧૨. આ શ્લોકનો સંપૂર્ણ ભાગ વચનામૃત પં. ૨માં તથા તેનો અર્થ અને સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંક પાદ-ટીપણી-૧૬માં દર્શાવ્યા છે: [અર્થ: આત્મારામ અને રાગદ્વેષાદિરૂપ ગ્રંથિએ રહિત એવા મુનિઓ પણ ભગવાનની નિષ્કામ ભક્તિ કરે છે, કારણ કે ભગવાનમાં કારુણ્ય, સૌશીલ્ય, વાત્સલ્યાદિક ગુણો રહ્યા છે. (ભાગવત: ૧/૭/૧૦).]

૧૩. “પ્રાયેણ મુનયો રાજન્ નિવૃત્તા વિધિષેધતઃ। નૈર્ગુણ્યસ્થા રમન્તે સ્મ ગુણાનુકથને હરેઃ॥” અર્થ: હે રાજન્! પ્રાયઃ વિધિ-નિષેધની અટપટી ક્રિયાઓમાંથી નિવૃત્ત થયેલ, નિર્ગુણભાવને અર્થાત્ સત્ત્વાદિક ત્રણ ગુણોથી પર થયેલ મુનિઓ ભગવાનના ચરિત્રરૂપ ગુણોનું ગાન કરે છે. (ભાગવત: ૨/૧/૭).

૧૪. વચનામૃત લો. ૭ની ટીપણી-૩૦માં આ શ્લોકનો અર્થ તથા સંદર્ભ ક્રમાંક દર્શાવ્યા છે: અર્થ: જે બ્રહ્મરૂપ થયો છે અને પ્રસન્ન મન છે એટલે ક્લેશ કર્માદિક દોષથી જેનું મન કલુષિત નથી અને કોઈનો પણ શોક કરતો નથી, તેમ કોઈ પદાર્થને ઇચ્છતો નથી, સર્વ ભૂતોમાં સમભાવથી રહેતો, કશાની આકાંક્ષા નહીં કરનારો, તે પુરુષ મારે વિષે પરાભક્તીને પામે છે - અર્થાત્ જેને આત્માનો ‘બ્રહ્મરૂપે’ સાક્ષાત્ અનુભવ થયો હોય તેને જ પરાભક્તિમાં અધિકાર પ્રાપ્ત થાય છે. (ગીતા: ૧૮/૫૪).
૧૫. લોકમાં કથનમાત્ર બ્રહ્મરૂપ, વાસ્તવિકતામાં નહિ.
8. Gaḍhaḍānā Khojā bhakta.
9. Bhāgwat: 5/8.

10. Vachanāmṛut Pan. 2nī ṭīpaṇī-17mā ā shlokno arth tathā sandarbh kramānk darshāvyā chhe: Arth: Shukdevjī kahe chhe ke, “Hu nirguṇ brahmamā sthiti karu chhu, chhatā he Rājarṣhi! Uttam kīrtivāḷā Bhagwānnī līlā mārā manne ākarṣhe chhe ane tethī ja ā Bhāgwat ākhyān hu bhaṇyo chhu.” (Bhāgwat: 2/1/9).
11. Arth: Bhagwānnā guṇothī jenī buddhi ākarṣhit thaī chhe ane Viṣhṇujano jene priya chhe evā Bhagwān Shukmuni Bhāgwatrūp je moṭu ākhyān tene nirantar bhaṇavā havā. (Bhāgwat: 1/7/11).

12. Ā shlokno sampūrṇ bhāg Vachanāmṛut Pan. 2mā tathā teno arth ane sandarbh kramānk pād-ṭīpaṇī-16mā darshāvyā chhe: Arth: Ātmārām ane rāg-dveṣhādirūp granthie rahit evā munio paṇ Bhagwānnī niṣhkām bhakti kare chhe, kāraṇ ke Bhagwānmā kāruṇya, saushīlya, vātsalyādik guṇo rahyā chhe. (Bhāgwat: 1/7/10).

13. “Prāyeṇ munayo rājan nivṛuttā vidhiṣhedhatah | nairguṇyasthā ramante sma guṇānukathane harehe ||” Arth: He rājan! Prāyah vidhi-niṣhedhanī aṭ-paṭī kriyāomāthī nivṛutta thayel, nirguṇbhāvne arthāt sattvādik traṇ guṇothī par thayel munio Bhagwānnā charitrarūp guṇonu gān kare chhe. (Bhāgwat: 2/1/7).

14.
