259: Samvat 1885nā Vaishākh sudi 1 Paḍavāne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Gaḍhaḍā madhye Dādā Khācharnā darabārmāthī ghoḍīe chaḍhīne Shrī Lakṣhmīvāḍīe padhāryā hatā ne te vāḍīne madhye je oṭo te upar virājmān thayā hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Paramhansa tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje sarva Paramhansa tathā haribhakta pratye prashna karyo je, “Ā jīvne kalyāṇnu asādhāraṇ sādhan shu chhe je, jene viṣhe e pravarte to enu nishchay kalyāṇ thāy ne temā bījā koī vighna pratibandh kare nahī? Te kaho. Tathā evā kalyāṇnā sādhanmā moṭu vighna shu chhe je, jeṇe karīne temāthī nishchay paḍī jāy? Te paṇ kaho.” Pachhī sarvee potānī buddhi pramāṇe uttar karyo paṇ e prashnanu samādhān na thayu. Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Kalyāṇnu asādhāraṇ sādhan to e chhe je, Puruṣhottam Bhagwānne brahmajyotinā samūhne viṣhe anādi sākārmūrti samajavā ne tenā ja sarve avatār chhe em samajīne te pratyakṣh Bhagwānno je te bhāve karīne āshray karavo ne dharma sahit te Bhagwānnī bhakti karavī ne tevī bhaktie yukta je sādhu teno sang karavo, e kalyāṇnu asādhāraṇ sādhan chhe. Ane emā bījā koī vighna pratibandh karatā nathī. Ane e sādhanne viṣhe moṭu vighna e chhe je, Shuṣhk Vedāntīno sang karavo. Ane jo eno sang kare to shu vighna thāy? To teno sang karanāro je puruṣh tene tene viṣhe het thāy. Ane je het thāy te guṇe karīne thāy chhe, jem koīke kāḷmā anna āpīne jivāḍyo hoy tenī upar het thāy, evī rīte je jeṇe guṇ karyo hoy tenī upar het thāy. Tem te Shuṣhk Vedāntī te ene em guṇ dekhāḍe je, ‘Ātmā chhe tene janma-maraṇ nathī ne te nirākār chhe ane te game eṭalu pāp kare to paṇ tene doṣh na lāge.’[63] Evo ene guṇ batāvīne Bhagwānnī mūrtinā ākārnu khanḍan karī nākhe tyāre ene e moṭu vighna thayu; kem je, Bhagwānnī mūrtimāthī paḍī gayo. Māṭe e Shuṣhk Vedāntīno sang kyārey na karavo ane e Shuṣhk Vedāntī to mahā-agnānī chhe ne Bhagwānnā bhaktimārgmā evu moṭu koī vighna nathī.”

Eṭalī vārtā karīne Shrījī Mahārāj pāchhā Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā padhāryā ne ugamṇā dvārnā oraḍānī osarīe ḍholiyā upar besīne em vārtā karī je, “Ame sarva shāstrane sāmbhaḷīne e siddhānt karyo chhe ane ame ā pṛuthvīmā sarva ṭhekāṇe faryā ne tene viṣhe ghaṇāk siddha dīṭhā chhe.” Em kahīne Gopāḷdāsjī ādik sādhunī vārtā karī dekhāḍī ne pachhī em bolyā je, “Hu to em jāṇu chhu je, Bhagwānnī mūrtinī je upāsanā ne dhyān te vinā je ātmāne dekhavo ne Brahmane[64] dekhavu te to thāy ja nahī ne upāsanāe karīne ja ātmā dekhāy, Brahma dekhāy, paṇ te vinā to dekhāy ja nahī. Ane upāsanā vinā ātmā-Brahmane dekhavāne ichchhavu te kem chhe? To jem ākāshne jībhe karīne so varṣh sudhī chāṭīe to paṇ kyārey khāṭo-khāro svād āve ja nahī, tem Bhagwānnī mūrtinī upāsanā vinā ātmā-Brahma dekhāy ja nahī; te game teṭalu jatan kare to paṇ na dekhāy.[65] Ane nirbīj evā je Sānkhya ne Yog teṇe karīne je ātmānu darshan shāstramā kahyu chhe te bhale kahyu chhe, paṇ ame evo koī dīṭho nathī ne anubhavamā paṇ e vārtā maḷatī āvatī nathī. Māṭe e vārtā khoṭī chhe.”
1. Literally, ‘nirbij’ means ‘seedless’, but here it should be understood to mean ‘without the association of God’.
૬૩. અને પરમાત્મા પણ નિત્ય નિર્વિકારી ગુણે યુક્ત છે, તે પરમાત્મામાં અને જીવાત્મામાં વાસ્તવિક ભેદ ક્યારેય પણ નથી.
૬૫. માટે આત્મા-પરમાત્માનાં દર્શન કરવા ઇચ્છતા ભક્તોએ મનુષ્યરૂપે અવતરેલ ભગવાનનું ધ્યાન સર્વપ્રકારે કરવું; આવો અમારો સિદ્ધાંત છે.
63. Ane Paramātmā paṇ nitya nirvikārī guṇe yukta chhe, te Paramātmāmā ane jīvātmāmā vāstavik bhed kyāreya paṇ nathī.
65. Māṭe ātmā-Paramātmānā darshan karavā ichchhatā bhaktoe manuṣhyarūpe avatarel Bhagwānnu dhyān sarvaprakāre karavu; āvo amāro siddhānt chhe.
260: Samvat 1885nā Vaishākh sudi 3 Trījne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Gaḍhaḍā madhye Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā uttarāde dvār oraḍānī osarīe chākaḷā upar virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Paramhansa tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje sarve sādhu tathā sarve haribhakta pratye em vārtā karī je, “Jene Bhagwānnā swarūpnu yathārth gnān[66] ek vār thayu hoy ne pachhī tene desh, kāḷ, kriyā, sang viṣham thaī jāy to paṇ te gnānno lesh jāy nahī. Tyā draṣhṭānt chhe: jem koīk moṭo rājā hoy athavā moṭo lakhesharī shāhukār hoy ne tene prārabdhānusāre te adhikār chhūṭī gayo ne daridrapaṇu āvī gayu, teṇe karīne khaḍ-dhānya khāvā maḷe athavā ḍoḍīnī bhājī maḷe tathā koṭhā, borā, bāfelī pīparyo ityādik jevu-tevu khāvā maḷe tyāre tene khāy; paṇ more je pote bhāre bhāre mevā khādhā hoy tathā bhāre mūlyavāḷī chījo koīne na maḷe evī magāvīne khādhī hoy te sarve sāmbharī āve; ne manmā em ghāṭ kare je, ‘Evī evī bhāre chījone hu more khāto ne have hu āvu jevu-tevu anna khāu chhu.’ Evī rīte jyāre jyāre khāy tyāre te sāmbharī āve. Ane je prathamthī ja jevu-tevu anna khāto hoy ne tene daridrapaṇu vadhu āve tyāre paṇ te ja khāy, tyāre tene shu sāmbhare? Tem jeṇe Bhagwānnā swarūpnu sukh tathā Bhagwānnā bhajannu sukh potānā manmā ek vār yathārthpaṇe jāṇyu chhe ne tene pachhī samāgamno yog na rahyo ne bahār nīkaḷī gayo to paṇ te sukhne sambhārato thako ja sukh-dukhne prārabdhānusāre bhogave paṇ te sukhne bhūlī na jāy. Ane jeṇe Bhagwānnu sukh jāṇyu nathī ne teno anubhav thayo nathī te te shu sambhāre? E to pashu jevo chhe.

“Have te Bhagwānnu je swarūp tenu gnān kahīe chhīe je, Bhagwānno je ākār chhe tevo ākār bījā dev-manuṣhyādik je prakṛutimāthī ākār thayā chhe te koīno nathī. Ane Bhagwān vinā bījā sarvane kāḷ bhakṣhaṇ karī jāy chhe ne Bhagwānnā swarūpmā kāḷnu sāmarthyapaṇu nathī chālatu evā Bhagwān chhe. Ne Bhagwānnā jevā to ek Bhagwān ja chhe paṇ bījo koī nathī. Ane Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāmyā evā je Bhagwānnā dhāmmā bhakta chhe teno ākār paṇ Bhagwān jevo chhe, to paṇ te puruṣh chhe ne Bhagwān Puruṣhottam chhe ne te sarvamā shreṣhṭh chhe ne emane upāsya chhe ne sarvenā Swāmī chhe ne e Bhagwānnā mahimāno koī pār pāmatā nathī. Evā divyamūrti je Bhagwān te nirguṇ chhe, te dhyeya chhe ane enu je dhyān kare chhe te nirguṇ thaī jāy chhe, evu Bhagwānnu swarūp chhe. Ane e Bhagwān chhe te potānā dhāmrūp ek deshne viṣhe rahyā thakā ja anvayapaṇe anek brahmānḍne viṣhe rahyā je sarve jīvnā samūh temane viṣhe temanā yathāyogya karma-faḷ-pradātāpaṇe antaryāmīrūpe karīne rahyā chhe ane sarva jīvnā jīvan chhe ne e vinā e jīv kāī karavāne ne bhogavavāne samarth nathī thato. Ane e je Bhagwān te siddheshvar chhe; jem koīk siddhivāḷo puruṣh hoy te ahīyā beṭho thako Brahmānā lokmā padārth hoy tene ā hāthe karīne grahaṇ karī le, tem Bhagwān ek deshmā rahyā thakā ja potānī yogkaḷānā sāmarthye karīne sarve kriyāne kare chhe. Ane jem agni je te kāṣhṭhne viṣhe ne pāṣhāṇne viṣhe rahyo chhe, te agninu swarūp bījī rītnu chhe ne kāṣhṭh-pāṣhāṇnu swarūp bījī rītnu chhe;[80] tem Bhagwān sarva jīvne viṣhe rahyā chhe, te Bhagwānnu swarūp bījī rītnu chhe ne te jīvnu swarūp bījī rītnu chhe. Ane evī rītnā anant aishvarye yukta evā je e Bhagwān te ja pote jīvonā kalyāṇne arthe manuṣhya jevā thāy chhe. Te Bhagwānnā swarūpnu gnān jene āvī rīte thayu hoy ne te Bhagwānnī bhakti karī hoy ne te gnān-bhaktinā sukhno potānā jīvmā anubhav ek vār yathārth thayo hoy to tenī vismṛuti kyārey thāy nahī. Ane game tevu sukh-dukh paḍe to paṇ tene viṣhe te Bhagwānnā swarūpnā sukhno je anubhav te vīsarī jāy nahī. Jem te rājāne prathamnu je potānu sukh te daridrapaṇāmā paṇ vīsartu nathī tema. Ane ā vārtā shā sāru karīe chhīe? To āvo satsangno yog hamaṇā to chhe, paṇ kadāchit desh, kāḷ, prārabdhanā viṣhampaṇā thakī evo yog na rahe tyāre jo āvī vārtā samajī rākhī hoy to tenā jīvnu kalyāṇ thāy ane ene evo draḍh nishchay hoy to ene kyārey em na samajāy je, ‘Māru kyārey akalyāṇ thashe.’ Ane āvo yog rahevo bahu durlabh chhe ne āvī rīte dehe vartavu te paṇ durlabh chhe. Kem je, koīk divas bāher nīkaḷī javāy tyāre ām dehe na vartāy, to paṇ ā vārtā samajī rākhī hoy to enā jīvnu bahu sāru thāy; māṭe ā vārtā karī chhe.”

1. Here, Shriji Maharaj says that there is fire latent in wood and stone. Ordinarily, we think of fire as a burning flame or an explosion. Maharaj is speaking of the latent fire here, which is known scientifically as latent energy or the heat of combustion. This type of energy is present in all compounds.
The heat of combustion (ΔHC) is the energy released as heat when a compound undergoes complete combustion with oxygen under standard conditions. For example, the heat of combustion of wood is 24.2 MJ/kg.

૮૦. અહીં શ્રીજીમહારાજ કહે છે કે કાષ્ઠ અને પાષાણમાં (પથ્થરમાં) અગ્નિ રહેલો હોય છે. આ આશ્ચર્યકારી છે, કારણ કે સામાન્યપણે આપણા માટે અગ્નિની કલ્પના જુદી હોય છે. જ્યારે કોઈ વસ્તુ બળે અને ભડકો દેખાય એને આપણે અગ્નિ કહીએ છીએ. શ્રીજીમહારાજ અહીં જે અવ્યક્ત પ્રકારના અગ્નિની વાત કરે છે તેવી વાત વિજ્ઞાનમાં પણ મળતી આવે છે. વિજ્ઞાન એવું કહે છે કે દરેક પદાર્થમાં એક પ્રકારનો અગ્નિ રહેલો છે, જેને ‘લેટંટ એનર્જી’ (latent energy) અથવા ‘ધ હીટ ઓફ કમ્બશન’ (the heat of combustion) કહેવામાં આવે છે.
The Heat of Combustion: The heat of combustion (ΔHC) is the energy released as heat when a compound undergoes complete combustion with oxygen under standard conditions. For example, the heat of combustion of wood is 24.2 MJ/kg.

80. Ahī Shrījī Mahārāj kahe chhe ke kāṣhṭh ane pāṣhāṇmā (paththarmā) agni rahelo hoya chhe. Ā āshcharyakārī chhe, kāraṇ ke sāmānyapaṇe āpaṇā māṭe agninī kalpanā judī hoya chhe. Jyāre koī vastu baḷe ane bhaḍako dekhāy ene āpaṇe agni kahīe chhīe. Shrījī Mahārāj ahī je avyakta prakārnā agninī vāt kare chhe tevī vāt vignānmā paṇ maḷatī āve chhe. Vignān evu kahe chhe ke darek padārthmā ek prakārno agni rahelo chhe, jene ‘latent energy’ athavā ‘the heat of combustion’ kahevāmā āve chhe.
The Heat of Combustion: The heat of combustion (ΔHC) is the energya released as heat when a compounda undergoes complete combustion with oxygen under standarda conditions. For example, the heat of combustion of wood is 24.2 MJ/kg.
261: Samvat 1885nā Vaishākh sudi 14 Chaudashne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Gaḍhaḍā madhye Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā Shrī Gopīnāthjīnā Mandirne viṣhe virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Paramhansa tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ame Sānkhyādik shāstranā vichāre karīne em nishchay karyo chhe je, māyānā kāryamāthī utpanna thayā je ākārmātra te sarve mithyā chhe. Kem je, e sarve ākār kāḷe karīne nāsh pāme chhe. Ane Bhagwānnā Akṣhardhāmne viṣhe je Bhagwānno ākār chhe tathā te Bhagwānnā pārṣhad je mukta temanā je ākār chhe, te sarve satya chhe ne divya chhe ne atishay prakāshe yukta chhe. Ane te Bhagwānno ne te muktano je ākār te puruṣhnā jevo dvibhuj chhe ne sachchidānandrūp chhe. Ane te Akṣhardhāmne viṣhe rahyā je e Bhagwān te je te, te mukta puruṣh temaṇe divya evā je nānā prakārnā upachār teṇe karīne sevyā thakā ne te mukta puruṣhne param ānandne upajāvatā thakā sadā virājmān chhe. Ane evā sarvoparī je Puruṣhottam Bhagwān te ja dayāe karīne jīvonā kalyāṇne arthe ā pṛuthvīne viṣhe prakaṭ thayā thakā sarva jannā nayan-gochar varte chhe ne tamārā iṣhṭadev chhe ne tamārī sevāne angīkār kare chhe. Ane evā je e pratyakṣh Puruṣhottam Bhagwān tenā swarūpmā ne Akṣhardhāmne viṣhe rahyā je Bhagwān tenā swarūpmā kāī paṇ bhed nathī; e be ek ja chhe. Ane evā je ā pratyakṣh Puruṣhottam Bhagwān te Akṣharādik sarvanā niyantā chhe, īshvarnā paṇ īshvar chhe ne sarva kāraṇnā paṇ kāraṇ chhe ne sarvoparī varte chhe ne sarva avatārnā avatārī chhe ne tamāre sarvene ekāntikbhāve karīne upāsanā karavā yogya chhe. Ane ā Bhagwānnā je pūrve ghaṇāk avatār thayā chhe, te paṇ namaskār karavā yogya chhe ne pūjavā yogya chhe.”

Ane vaḷī Shrījī Mahārāje em vārtā karī je, “Ek dravyādikno lobh tathā strīne viṣhe beṭhā-ūṭhyānī vāsanā tathā rasne viṣhe jihvānī āsakti tathā dehābhimān tathā kusangīmā het rahī jāy tathā sambandhīmā het hoy, e chho vānā jene hoy tene koī divas jīvate ne marīne paṇ sukh to kyārey thāy ja nahī; māṭe jene sukh ichchhavu hoy tene evā swabhāv hoy to ṭāḷavā. Ne nivṛuttipar thavu ne barobariyānī sobat na rākhavī, ne dehābhimāne rahit ne vairāgye yukta ne Bhagwānnu alp vachan hoy temā fer paḍe to te mahat vachanmā fer paḍyo hoy tem mānatā hoy, evā je bhagwad-bhakta Moṭā Sādhu te sangāthe potānā jīvne jaḍī devo ne tenā vachanmā man-karma-vachane vartavu. Ne viṣhaynā sambandhthī to chheṭe ja rahevu paṇ eno sambandh potānā niyamno tyāg karīne thavā devo nahī. Ne jo viṣhayno sambandh karavā mānḍe to eno ṭhā rahe ja nahī, e siddhāntvārtā chhe.”
262: Samvat 1886nā Āṣhāḍh vadi 10 Dashamīne divas Shrījī Mahārāj Shrī Gaḍhaḍā madhye Dādā Khācharnā darabārmā ugamṇe dvār oraḍānī osarīe virājmān hatā ne sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Paramhansa tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje sarva Paramhansa tathā sarva satsangī āgaḷ vārtā karī je, “Bhagwānnī māyā te kaī chhe? To ‘dehne viṣhe ahambuddhi ne deh sambandhī padārthne viṣhe mamatvabuddhi’ e ja māyā chhe, te e māyāne ṭāḷavī. Ane e māyāne jeṇe ṭāḷī te māyāne taryo kahevāy. Ane ‘e māyāne ṭāḷīne Bhagwānmā prīti karavī,’ eṭalo sarva shāstrano siddhānt chhe. Tene āj samajo ke ghaṇe divase karīne samajo.[67] Ane Hanumān, Nārad, Prahlād e je moṭā moṭā Bhagwānnā bhakta temaṇe paṇ[68] Bhagwān pāse em ja māgyu chhe je, ‘Aham-mamatvarūp māyā thakī rakṣhā karajyo[69] ane tamāre viṣhe prīti thajyo, ane e māyāne taryā hoy ne tamāre viṣhe prītivāḷā hoy evā je sādhu teno sang thajyo ane sādhune viṣhe het ne mamatva thajyo.’ Māṭe āpaṇe paṇ em karavu ne em māgavu ane eno shravaṇ, manan, nididhyās karavo.

“Ane Bhagwānno je bhakta hoy, tene ātmaniṣhṭhānu baḷ tathā Bhagwānnā māhātmyanu baḷ e be baḷ joīe. Te ātmaniṣhṭhā te shu? To potānā ātmāne dehthī pṛuthak jāṇavo. Ane sādhu bheḷā rahetā hoīe temā paraspar koīk nimitte bolāchālī thāy tathā koīk jātno aham-mamatva thāy tathā mān, krodh, svād, lobh, kām, matsar, īrṣhyā e ādik avaguṇnī pravṛutti thāy tyāre jo ātmā potāne na jāṇatā hoīe to sādhuno avaguṇ āve, temāthī enu bahu bhūnḍu thāy; māṭe potāne dehthī pṛuthak ātmā jāṇavo. Ane te ātmā chhe te brāhmaṇ nathī, kṣhatriya nathī, kaṇabī nathī, koīno dīkaro nathī, koīno bāp nathī, enī koī jāt nathī, nāt nathī, evo chhe. Ane e ātmā to sūrya tathā agni jevo tejasvī chhe ne jāṇpaṇe yukta chhe. Ane te agninī jvāḷā tathā sūryanā kiraṇ te to jaḍ chhe.[82] Kem je, tene āngaḷī aḍāḍīe to khase nahī ane kīḍī hoy ne tene āngaḷī aḍāḍīe to khasīne avaḷī chāle; māṭe ātmā te jāṇpaṇe yukta chhe. Ane ene sūrya, agni jevo kahīe chhīe te to eno ākār evo tejasvī chhe te māṭe kahīe chhīe. Ane e ātmā anek yonine[83] pāmyo chhe. Ane em kahevāy chhe je, ‘Jeṭalu samudranu pāṇī chhe teṭalu e jīv potānī mātānu dūdh dhāvyo chhe.’ Ane tyā tyā anek prakāre marāṇo chhe to paṇ maryo nathī, jevo chhe tevo ne tevo ja chhe. Ane e agnān-avasthāmā potāne dehrūpe mānato hato tyāre paṇ na maryo, to have āpaṇe enu gnān thayu tyāre to e kem marashe? Evo je ātmā tene potānu swarūp mānavu.

“Ane Bhagwānnu māhātmya kem jāṇavu? To Bhagwān chhe te anek brahmānḍnā rājādhirāj chhe ane je brahmānḍnā e rājā chhe te brahmānḍnī paṇ gaṇatī nathī. Te kahyu chhe je, ‘Dyupataya ev te na yayurantamanantatayā tvamapi yadantarāṇḍanichayā nanu sāvaraṇāhā;’[70] Ane te ek ek brahmānḍmā Brahmā, Viṣhṇu, Shiv hoy tathā sāt dvīp, sāt samudra, Meru, Lokālok ādik parvat teṇe yukta pṛuthvīnī rachanā hoy tathā chaud loknī rachanā hoy tathā aṣhṭ āvaraṇnī rachanā hoy ityādik sāmagrīe sahit je anek brahmānḍ tenā rājā Bhagwān chhe. Ane jem ā pṛuthvīno chakravartī rājā hoy ne te rājānā je gāmaḍā te to gaṇāy evā hoy to paṇ tenī keṭalī moṭyap jāṇyāmā āve chhe! Ane Bhagwānne to evā brahmānḍnī paṇ gaṇatī nathī, māṭe Bhagwānnī to bahu ja moṭyap chhe. Ane te brahmānḍne viṣhe ā jīv chhe te Bhagwānnī āgaḷ shā lekhāmā chhe? Kāī nathī, ati tuchchha chhe. Ane te Bhagwāne e brahmānḍne viṣhe panch-viṣhay sambandhī sukh jīvone āpyu chhe te sukh kevu chhe? To e sukhne sāru keṭalāk potānā māthā kapāve chhe evu mahādurlabh jevu jaṇāy chhe. Tyāre potānī mūrtimā tathā potānā dhāmmā je sukh chhe te to bahu bhāre chhe. Ane prākṛut viṣhay-sukh chhe te to anya padārthne āsharīne rahyu chhe tathā pṛuthak pṛuthak chhe; ane je Bhagwān chhe te to sarve sukhmātranā rāshi chhe. Ne Bhagwān sambandhī je sukh chhe te avināshī chhe ne mahā-alaukik chhe. Ane jem koīk bhāre dhanāḍhya gṛuhasth hoy te potānā gharmā anek prakārnā bhojan jamato hoy ne te jamīne uchchhiṣhṭ kāīk baṭaku roṭalo vadhe te kūtarāne nākhe tyāre te atishay tuchchha kahevāy ne pote jamato hoy te mahāsukhmay kahevāy; tem Bhagwāne brahmānḍne viṣhe anek jīvone panch-viṣhay sambandhī sukh āpyu chhe te to kūtarāne nākhyo je baṭaku roṭalo tenī peṭhe ati tuchchha chhe ne potāne viṣhe je sukh chhe te to mahāmoṭu chhe. Ane vaḷī suṣhupti avasthāne viṣhe e jīvne Bhagwān moṭu sukh pamāḍe chhe, te game tevī vedanā thaī hoy ne suṣhuptimā jāy tyāre sukhiyo thaī jāy chhe. Ane vaḷī e Bhagwānnā charaṇkamaḷnī rajne Brahmā, Shiv, Lakṣhmījī, Rādhājī, Nārad, Shuk, Sanakādik, Nav Yogeshvar evā evā moṭā chhe te paṇ potānā mastak upar chaḍhāve chhe ne mānne mūkīne e Bhagwānnī nirantar bhakti karyā kare chhe. Ane vaḷī e Bhagwāne jagatmā vichitra sṛuṣhṭi kevī karī chhe ne temā kevu ḍahāpaṇ karyu chhe je, juo ne, māṇasmāthī māṇas thāy chhe, pashumāthī pashu thāy chhe, zāḍmāthī zāḍ thāy chhe, kīḍāmāthī kīḍo thāy chhe. Ane māṇasnā angmāthī koīk angno bhang thaī gayo hoy ne game tevo ḍāhyo hoy to paṇ te angne tevu ne tevu karavāne samarth koī rīte na ja thāy; ityādik anek kaḷā Bhagwānmā rahī chhe. Evī rīte Bhagwānnu māhātmya jāṇīne tathā Bhagwānne sukhmaymūrti jāṇīne bījā sarva padārthmā vairāgya thāy chhe ne ek Bhagwānmā ja prīti thāy chhe.

“Ane evī rīte pratham kahyu je potānā jīvātmānu gnān tathā Bhagwānnā māhātmyanu gnān e be jene siddha thayā hoy ne te jo game tevā panch-viṣhay sambandhī sukhmā kadāchit bandhāī gayo hoy to paṇ temā bandhāī rahe nahī, tene toḍīne nīkaḷe ja rahe chhe; ane je viṣhaynā sukhno tyāg karīne vartato hoy ne te na bandhāy emā te shu kahevu? Māṭe e be prakārnā gnānne sāmbhaḷīne eno potānā manmā veg lagāḍī devo. Jem koīk shūrvīr ne ākaro māṇas hoy ne teno koīk pratipakṣhī hoy, teṇe teno bāp mārī nākhyo hoy to tene tenī bahu dāzya thāy ne te dāzya thatī hoy ne vaḷī teno dīkaro mārī nākhe ne vaḷī bhāīne mārī nākhe ne vaḷī bāyaḍīne laī jāy ne vaḷī māne laīne Musalmānne āpe ne vaḷī gām-garās zūnṭī le, evī rīte jem jem eno parābhav kare tem tem ene bahu manmā dāzya thāy ne jāgrat-swapnamā sarvakāḷe ene e vātno ja āloch rahe. Tem jene ā be vātno nirantar āloch rahe tyāre ene e gnān siddha thāy ane ene game tevo āpatkāḷ paḍe to tene viṣhe enī sahāy kare. Ane jem vishalyakaraṇī oṣhadhi lāvīne Hanumānjīe Rāmchandrane pivāḍī[84] tyāre je dehmā shalya lāgyā hatā te sarve enī meḷe dehthī bāher nīkaḷī gayā; tem jene ā be vāt manmā lāgī gaī hoy tene indriyone viṣhay-bhognī ichchhā rahī chhe e shalya chhe te sarva nīkaḷī jāy; kahetā viṣhay-bhogmāthī enī indriyonī vṛutti nīkaḷīne ek Bhagwānmā vaḷage. Ane satsangī paṇ ene ja kahīe; kem je, satyarūp evo je potāno ātmā tathā satyarūp evā je Bhagwān teno jene āvī rīte sang thayo tene satsangī kahīe. Ane ā be prakāre je vārtā chhe tene daivī jīv sāmbhaḷe tyāre tenā hṛudaymā lāgīne rag-ragmā pravartī jāy ane je āsurī jīv hoy ne te sāmbhaḷe tyāre tene to kānthī bāher ja nīkaḷī jāy paṇ hṛudaymā ūtare nahī. Jem shvān hoy ne te khīr khāy te tenā peṭmā rahe ja nahī, vaman thaī jāy. Ne khīr jevu kāī bhojan saras na kahevāy, to paṇ te shvānnā peṭmā rahīne rag-ragmā pravarte nahī; ne te khīrne māṇas khāy tyāre tene peṭmā rahe ne rag-ragmā pravarte ne bahu sukh thāy. Tem shvān jevo je āsurī jīv tenā hṛudaymā to ā vāt pese ja nahī ne māṇas jevo je daivī jīv tenā hṛudaymā ūtare ne rag-ragmā vyāpī jāy.

“Ane vaḷī je Bhagwān chhe te jevā to e ek ja chhe ane Bhagwānne bhajī bhajīne ghaṇāk Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāmyā chhe,[85] to paṇ te Bhagwān jevā to thatā ja nathī. Ane jo e Bhagwān jevā ja thāy to to Bhagwān ghaṇāk thāy, tyāre to jagatnī sthiti te ek jātnī ja na rahe. Kem je, ek Bhagwān kaheshe, hu jagatnī utpatti karīsh ne bījo kaheshe, hu jagatno pralay karīsh; ane vaḷī ek Bhagwān kaheshe, hu varasād karīsh ne bījo kaheshe, hu nahī karu; ne ek kaheshe, hu māṇasnā dharma pashumā karīsh ane bījo kaheshe, hu pashunā dharma māṇasmā karīsh; evī rīte sthiti na rahe. Ane ā to juo ne, jagatmā kevī rīte barābar adal pramāṇe sarvatra kriyānī pravṛutti thāy chhe paṇ talbhār paṇ fer paḍato nathī! Māṭe sarva kriyānā pravartāvanārā ne sarvanā Swāmī ek ja Bhagwān chhe. Tathā Bhagwān sangāthe bījāne dāv bandhāy em paṇ jaṇātu nathī. Māṭe Bhagwān te ek ja chhe paṇ bījo e jevo thato nathī. Ane ā sarve vāt karī te thoḍīk chhe paṇ emā sarve vāt āvī gaī. Ane ā vātnu je rahasya chhe te je ḍāhyo hoy tene samajāy paṇ bījāne samajāy nahī. Ane āṭalī vāt samajīne jeṇe draḍh karī tene sarve vāt sanpūrṇa thaī, ene kāī karavu bākī na rahyu. Ane āvī rīte je ame vāt karī tene sāmbhaḷīne ne te vātnī je Bhagwānnā bhaktane draḍhatā hoy teno sang rākhavo, to ene ā vārtānī divase divase draḍhatā thatī jāy. Ane ā vāt ame karīe chhīe te kāī buddhinī kalpanāe nathī karatā tathā siddhāī jaṇāvavā sāru nathī karatā; ā to amārī ajamāvel vāt chhe ne jem ame vartīe chhīe tem vāt karīe chhīe. Kem je, amāre strī-dhanādik padārthno bhāre yog chhe tathā panch-viṣhayno bhāre yog chhe tathā Surat, Amdāvād, Vaḍodare, Vartāle jaīe chhīe tyāre hajāro māṇas bhegā thāy chhe ne te māne chhe tathā vājate-gājate ati sanmān karīne padharāve chhe tathā tyā tyā bhāre bhāre jāyagāo joyāmā āve chhe tathā bhāre vastra-vāhanādikno yog thāy chhe; e sarve chhe tathāpi potānā ātmā sāmī draṣhṭi karīe chhīe tathā Bhagwānnā māhātmya sāmī draṣhṭi karīe chhīe tyāre e sarvenu ati tuchchhapaṇu thaī jāy chhe ne emā koī ṭhekāṇe bandhāī javātu nathī ne pūrva dehnī jem vismṛuti chhe tem e sarvenī vismṛuti thaī jāy chhe. Māṭe e be vāt amāre siddha thaī chhe te sāru em amāre vartāy chhe. Ane bījo paṇ jo e be vātne siddha kare to tene kadāchit evo koīk yog thaī jāy to paṇ ene em vartāy; māṭe ā vāt avashya samajavānī chhe.” Evī rīte Shrījī Mahārāje kṛupā karīne bījāne samajāvavā sāru potānu vartan laīne vārtā karī ne pote to sākṣhāt Shrī Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇ chhe.

1. Are sunrays (or any rays from a light source) living or not? If they are living, why do they not travel independently? Ordinary people may not ponder this question, however, scientists have struggled to answer this question. In 1919, according to Einstein’s theories, science showed that the rays of light are non-living.
Shriji Maharaj actually concluded the same 90 years earlier when he said, “The flames of fire and the rays of the sun are jad (non-living) because they do not try to circumvent a finger blocking their path. However, when an ant’s path is blocked by a finger, it [consciously] changes its course and turns back.”

2. Here, lifeforms refers to deities, ghosts, humans, animals, birds, plants, etc. equaling 8.4 million lifeforms. The categories of the 8.4 lifeforms are as follows:
2.1 million jarāyuj: lifeforms born from the womb
2.1 million andaj: lifeforms born from an egg
2.1 million svedaj: lifeforms born from sweat
2.1 million udbhij: lifeforms that grow from the ground
See Vachanamrut Gadhada I-13 for the explanation of lifeforms.
[Garud Puran: 2/12/2,3]

3. द्युपतय एव ते न ययुरन्तमनन्ततया
त्वमपि यदन्तराण्डनिचया ननु सावरणाः।
Even the masters of the higher realms [i.e. deities such as Brahmā] cannot fathom your greatness - because it is endless. [In fact,] neither can you yourself [fathom your own greatness]. Indeed, in your each and every hair countless brahmānds accompanied with their barriers fly simultaneously at immense speed - like mere specks of dust flying in the air. Even the Shrutis, describing you as ‘neti neti’ [i.e. indescribable and unfathomable], ultimately perish in you [i.e. fail to extol your complete glory]. - Shrimad Bhāgwat: 10.87.41

4. When Ram waged a war with Ravan to retrieve Sitaji, Ravan’s son Indrajit shot the Brahmāstra weapon that made Ram, Lakshman, and the army of monkeys unconscious. Jāmbavān told Hanumanji to bring herbal medicines from a mountain in the Himalayas. When Hanumanji reached the mountain, the herbal medicines disappeared. So, Hanumanji brought the whole mountain to Lanka. There were four major types of herbal medicines: (1) Mrut-sanjivani, (2) Vishalyakarani, (3) Suvarnakarani, and (4) Sandhāni. Ram, Lakshman, and the monkey army regained consciousness by smelling the herbal medicines.
[Valmiki Ramayan, Yuddha-kand: 72-74]

5. Here “many have attained qualities similar to [God’s]” should be understood as attaining qualities similar to Aksharbrahman.
Explanation: According to Shriji Maharaj’s principles, devotees of God cannot become God, because God is singular and remains singular. Therefore, attaining qualities of God should be understood as attaining some virtues and powers like God. Just as God is divine, is not influenced by māyā, and is not bound to good or bad karmas, similarly, the devotee of God also becomes divine, is not influenced by māyā, and is not bound by good or bad karmas. The devotee also transcends kāl, karma, and māyā.
Moreover, the devotee acquires the virtues of Satya, Shauch, etc. (Gadhada I-62, I-77). Nevertheless, the devotee of God never completely acquires all of the virtues or powers of God. God’s power of kartum, akartum and anyathākartum, power to create and destroy the infinite universes, and being the controller of all elements are not acquired by the devotee of God. Therefore, the master-servant relationship always exists between God and his devotees.
If the devotee of God were to fully acquire all qualities of God, then he would become exactly like God. So then, who does the devotee of God serve and offer devotion and upāsanā to? Therefore, attaining qualities of God should be understood as attaining the qualities of Aksharbrahman, because Shriji Maharaj has explained that: to serve God and offer devotion and upāsanā to God, one must acquire the qualities of Aksharbrahman. Only when the devotee of God acquires the virtues of Aksharbrahman (i.e. becomes brahamrup) does that devotee attain the aforementioned virtues of God.
૬૭. પણ સમજીને જે ભક્ત એવી રીતે કરશે તે જ સુખી થશે, બીજો સુખી થશે નહિ.
૬૮. અહં-મમત્વરૂપ માયાનો ત્યાગ કરીને ભગવાનમાં દૃઢ પ્રીતિ કરી છે અને.

૬૯. હનુમાનજીએ શ્રીરામચંદ્રજી પાસે પ્રાર્થના દ્વારા માંગેલ વરદાન (વાલ્મીકિ રામાયણ, ઉત્તરકાંડ: ૩૯/૧૫-૧૬); નારદજીએ નૃસિંહ ભગવાન પાસે કરેલ પ્રાર્થના (ભાગવત: ૫/૧૯/૧૫); પ્રહ્‌લાદજીએ નૃસિંહ ભગવાન પાસે માગેલ વરદાન (ભાગવત: ૭/૧૦/૨-૧૦)નો સારાંશ અહીં શ્રીજીમહારાજ કહે છે.

૭૦. અર્થ: બ્રહ્માદિ દેવો પણ તમારા મહિમાના પારને પામતા નથી, કેમ કે તમારો મહિમા અપાર છે. વધારે તો શું કહિએ! તમે પણ તમારા મહિમાના પારને પામતા નથી. જેના એક એક રોમછિદ્રમાં આઠ આવરણે સહિત અનેક બ્રહ્માંડો ઊડતાં ફરે છે તેવા તમે છો. (ભાગવત: ૧૦/૮૭/૪૧).

૮૨. પ્રકાશના મૂળ સ્રોતમાંથી વહી આવતાં કિરણો સજીવ હોવાં જોઈએ કે નહીં? નહીં તો તેની સ્વતંત્ર ગતિ હોય જ કેવી રીતે? આવો પ્રશ્ન મોટા ભાગે તો સામાન્ય માણસોને ઊઠે પણ નહીં, પણ વિજ્ઞાનીઓ એની પાછળ મંડી પડ્યા હતા. આખરે ૧૯૧૯માં આઇન્સ્ટાઇનના સિદ્ધાંતોમાં સાબિત થયું કે પ્રકાશનાં કિરણો જડ છે. આ સંશોધનનો સાર શ્રીહરિ બરાબર તેના ૯૦ વર્ષ પહેલાં કહી બતાવે છે: “અને અગ્નિની જ્વાળા તથા સૂર્યનાં કિરણ તે તો જડ છે, કેમ કે તેને આંગળી અડાડીએ તો ખસે નહીં ને કીડી હોય તેને આંગળી અડાડીએ તો ખસીને અવળી ચાલે.” સૂર્યના પ્રકાશ આગળ હાથ રાખીને લઈ લઈએ, તો તે તેની દિશા નથી બદલી દેતો પણ કીડીને અડીએ તો તે તેની દિશા બદલી નાખે છે.

૮૩. અહીં યોનિ એટલે દેવ, ભૂત, મનુષ્ય, પશુ, પક્ષી, વનસ્પતિ વગેરે ચોરાસી લાખ યોનિ, જે આ પ્રમાણે છે:
૨૧ લાખ જરાયુજ - ગર્ભમાંથી જન્મેલું
૨૧ લાખ અંડજ - ઈંડામાંથી જન્મેલું
૨૧ લાખ સ્વેદજ - પરસેવામાંથી જન્મેલું
૨૧ લાખ ઉદ્ભિજ્જ - જમીન કે બીજમાંથી જન્મેલું
[ગરુડપુરાણ: ૨/૧૨/૨, ૩]

૮૪. રાવણ સામે યુદ્ધ વખતે રાવણપુત્ર ઇન્દ્રજિતના બ્રહ્માસ્ત્રના પ્રયોગથી શ્રીરામ, લક્ષ્મણ સહિત અનેક વાનર યોદ્ધાઓ મૂર્છિત થયા ત્યારે જામ્બવાનના આદેશથી હનુમાનજી હિમાલયમાં આવેલા પર્વત પરથી ઔષધિ લેવા ગયા. પર્વત પર પહોંચ્યા ત્યારે ઔષધિઓ અદૃશ્ય થઈ ગઈ. આથી હનુમાનજી આખો પર્વત જ લઈ આવ્યા. તેમાં ચાર મુખ્ય ઔષધિ હતી. (૧) મૃતસંજીવની (૨) વિશલ્યકરણી (૩) સુવર્ણકરણી (૪) સંધાની. તેની સુગંધ દ્વારા શ્રીરામ, લક્ષ્મણ સહિત તમામ વાનર યોદ્ધાઓ સ્વસ્થ થઈ ગયા.
[વાલ્મીકિ રામાયણ, યુદ્ધકાંડ: ૭૨-૭૪]

૮૫. અહીં “ભગવાનના સાધર્મ્યપણાને પામવું એટલે અક્ષરબ્રહ્મના સાધર્મ્યને પામવું એવું તાત્પર્ય સમજવું.
સમજૂતી: શ્રીજીમહારાજના સિદ્ધાંત અનુસાર કોઈ પણ ભક્ત ભગવાન થઈ શકતો નથી. (કારિયાણી ૮, કારિયાણી ૧૦, લોયા ૪, લોયા ૧૩; ગઢડા મધ્ય ૬૭) કારણ કે ભગવાન એક જ છે અને એક જ રહે છે. (લોયા ૪, ૧૩; અંત્ય ૩૦, ૩૯) તેથી “ભગવાનના સાધર્મ્યપણાને પામવું” એટલે ભગવાનના કેટલાક ગુણ-સામર્થ્યને પામવું. જેમકે ભગવાન જેમ દિવ્ય છે, માયિક ભાવોથી લેવાતા નથી, તેમને શુભ-અશુભ કર્મોનું બંધન થતું નથી; તેમ તે ભક્ત પણ દિવ્ય થઈ જાય છે, એટલે એમને પણ માયિક ભાવ કે શુભ-અશુભ કર્મોનું બંધન નથી. ભક્ત પણ કાળ, કર્મ અને માયાથી રહિત થાય છે. (ગઢડા પ્રથમ ૬૨; સારંગપુર ૧૧; ગઢડા મધ્ય ૬૬)
તદ્ઉપરાંત ભક્ત ભગવાનના સત્યશૌચાદિક કલ્યાણકારી ગુણો પ્રાપ્ત કરે છે. (ગઢડા પ્રથમ ૭૭; ગઢડા મધ્ય ૬૭) તેમ છતાં ભક્ત ક્યારેય પણ ભગવાનનું સંપૂર્ણ સાધર્મ્ય અર્થાત્ બધા જ ગુણ-ઐશ્વર્ય પામી શકતો નથી. કારણ કે ભગવાનનું કર્તુમ્-અકર્તુમ્-અન્યથાકર્તુમ્ સામર્થ્ય, જગતનું સર્વકર્તાહર્તાપણું અને નિયંતાપણું વગેરે ગુણો ભક્તમાં આવતા નથી. તેથી જ તો ભગવાન અને ભક્ત વચ્ચે સ્વામી-સેવકપણું હંમેશાં રહે જ છે. (સારંગપુર ૧૦; કારિયાણી ૧૦; લોયા ૧૩; ગઢડા મધ્ય ૬૦; ગઢડા અંત્ય ૩૦)
જો ભક્ત “ભગવાનના સાધર્મ્યપણાને પામે” એનો અર્થ એવો કરીએ કે ભક્ત ભગવાન જેવો જ થાય છે, તો પછી એ ભક્ત સેવા-ભક્તિ-ઉપાસના કોની કરે? તેથી અહીં ભગવાનનું સાધર્મ્ય એટલે અક્ષરબ્રહ્મનું સાધર્મ્ય સમજવું જોઈએ, કારણ કે શ્રીજીમહારાજ કહે છે કે પરબ્રહ્મની સ્વામી-સેવકપણે ભક્તિ-ઉપાસના કરવા માટે અક્ષરબ્રહ્મના સાધર્મ્યને પામવું અનિવાર્ય છે. (લોયા ૭, ૧૨; ગઢડા મધ્ય ૩) જ્યારે તે ભક્ત અક્ષરબ્રહ્મના સાધર્મ્યને પામે છે (અર્થાત્ બ્રહ્મરૂપ થાય છે) ત્યારે જ તેનામાં ઉપરોક્ત વર્ણવેલા પરબ્રહ્મના ગુણો આવે છે. માટે અહીં અક્ષરબ્રહ્મના સાધર્મ્યને પામવાનું તાત્પર્ય છે.
વળી, “ભક્ત ભગવાનના સાધર્મ્યપણાને પામે છે” એના તાત્પર્યાર્થમાં જ અર્થાત્ એના પર્યાય તરીકે વચનામૃત ગઢડા પ્રથમ ૬૪માં “બ્રહ્મભાવને પામે છે” એમ કહ્યું છે અને વચનામૃત ગઢડા મધ્ય ૬૭માં “બ્રહ્મરૂપ થાય છે” એમ કહ્યું છે. તેથી નિશ્ચિત થાય છે કે “ભગવાનના સાધર્મ્યપણાને પામવું” એટલે અક્ષરબ્રહ્મના સાધર્મ્યને પામવું.
આ રીતે “ભગવાનના સાધર્મ્યપણાને પામવું” એટલે અક્ષરબ્રહ્મના સાધર્મ્યને પામવું એવું તાત્પર્ય અહીં સમજવું.
67. Paṇ samajīne je bhakta evī rīte karashe te ja sukhī thashe, bījo sukhī thashe nahi.
68. Aham-mamatvarūp māyāno tyāg karīne Bhagwānmā draḍh prīti karī chhe ane.

69. Hanumānjīe Shrī Rāmchandrajī pāse prārthanā dvārā māgel varadān (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇ, Uttarkānḍ: 39/15-16); Nāradjīe Nṛusinha Bhagwān pāse karel prārthanā (Bhāgwat: 5/19/15); Prahlādjīe Nṛusinha Bhagwān pāse māgel varadān (Bhāgwat: 7/10/2-10)no sārānsh ahī Shrījī Mahārāj kahe chhe.

70. Arth: Brahmādi devo paṇ tamārā mahimānā pārne pāmatā nathī, kem ke tamāro mahimā apār chhe. Vadhāre to shu kahie! Tame paṇ tamārā mahimānā pārne pāmatā nathī. Jenā ek ek rom-chhidramā āṭh āvaraṇe sahit anek brahmānḍo ūḍatā fare chhe tevā tame chho. (Bhāgwat: 10/87/41).

82. Prakāshanā mūḷ srotamāthī vahī āvatā kiraṇo sajīv hovā joīe ke nahī? Nahī to tenī swatantra gati hoy ja kevī rīte? Āvo prashna moṭā bhāge to sāmānya māṇasone ūṭhe paṇ nahī, paṇ vignānīo enī pāchhaḷ manḍī paḍyā hatā. Ākhare 1919mā Einsteinnā siddhāntomā sābit thayu ke prakāshnā kiraṇo jaḍ chhe. Ā sanshodhanno sār Shrī Hari barābar tenā 90 varṣha pahelā kahī batāve chhe: “Ane agninī jvāḷā tathā sūryanā kiraṇ te to jaḍ chhe, kem ke tene āngaḷī aḍāḍīe to khase nahī ne kīḍī hoy tene āngaḷī aḍāḍīe to khasīne avaḷī chāle.” Sūryanā prakāsh āgaḷ hāth rākhīne laī laīe, to te tenī dishā nathī badalī deto paṇ kīḍīne aḍīe to te tenī dishā badalī nākhe chhe.

83. Ahī yoni eṭale dev, bhūt, manuṣhya, pashu, pakṣhī, vanaspati vagere chorāsī lākh yoni, je ā pramāṇe chhe:
21 lākh jarāyuj - garbhamāthī janmelu
21 lākh anḍaj - īnḍāmāthī janmelu
21 lākh svedaj - parsevāmāthī janmelu
21 lākh udbhijja - jamīn ke bījmāthī janmelu
[Garud Puran: 2/12/2, 3]

84. Rāvaṇ sāme yuddha vakhate Rāvaṇ-putra Indrajitnā brahmāstranā prayogathī Shrī Rām, Lakṣhmaṇ sahit anek vānar yoddhāo mūrchhit thayā tyāre Jāmbavānnā ādeshthī Hanumānjī Himālaymā āvelā parvat parthī auṣhadhi levā gayā. Parvat par pahochyā tyāre auṣhadhio adṛushya thaī gaī. Āthī Hanumānjī ākho parvat ja laī āvyā. Temā chār mukhya auṣhadhi hatī. (1) mṛut-sanjīvanī (2) vishalyakaraṇī (3) suvarṇakaraṇī (4) sandhānī. Tenī sugandha dvārā Shrī Rām, Lakṣhmaṇ sahit tamām vānar yoddhāo swastha thaī gayā.
[Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇ, Yuddhakānḍ: 72-74]

85. Ahī “Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāmavu eṭale Akṣharbrahmanā sādharmyane pāmavu evu tātparya samajavu.
Samajūtī: Shrījī Mahārājnā siddhānt anusār koī paṇ bhakta Bhagwān thaī shakato nathī. (Kāriyāṇī 8, Kāriyāṇī 10, Loyā 4, Loyā 13; Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 67) kāraṇ ke Bhagwān ek ja chhe ane ek ja rahe chhe. (Loyā 4, 13; Antya 30, 39) tethī “Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāmavu” eṭale Bhagwānnā keṭalāk guṇ-sāmarthyane pāmavu. Jem ke Bhagwān jem divya chhe, māyik bhāvothī levātā nathī, temane shubh-ashubh karmonu bandhan thatu nathī; tem te bhakta paṇ divya thaī jāy chhe, eṭale emane paṇ māyik bhāv ke shubh-ashubh karmonu bandhan nathī. Bhakta paṇ kāḷ, karma ane māyāthī rahit thāy chhe. (Gaḍhaḍā Pratham 62; Sārangpur 11; Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 66)
Taduparānt bhakta Bhagwānnā satya-shauchādik kalyāṇkārī guṇo prāpta kare chhe. (Gaḍhaḍā Pratham 77; Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 67) tem chhatā bhakta kyārey paṇ Bhagwānnu sampūrṇa sādharmya arthāt badhā ja guṇ-aishvarya pāmī shakato nathī. Kāraṇ ke Bhagwānnu kartum-akartum-anyathākartum sāmarthya, jagatnu sarva-kartā-hartāpaṇu ane niyantāpaṇu vagere guṇo bhaktamā āvatā nathī. Tethī ja to Bhagwān ane bhakta vachche Swāmī-sevakpaṇu hammeshā rahe ja chhe. (Sārangpur 10; Kāriyāṇī 10; Loyā 13; Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 60; Gaḍhaḍā Antya 30)
Jo bhakta “Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāme” eno arth evo karīe ke bhakta Bhagwān jevo ja thāy chhe, to pachhī e bhakta sevā-bhakti-upāsanā konī kare? Tethī ahī Bhagwānnu sādharmya eṭale Akṣharbrahmanu sādharmya samajavu joīe, kāraṇ ke Shrījī Mahārāj kahe chhe ke Parabrahmanī Swāmī-sevakpaṇe bhakti-upāsanā karavā māṭe Akṣharbrahmanā sādharmyane pāmavu anivārya chhe. (Loyā 7, 12; Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 3) Jyāre te bhakta Akṣharbrahmanā sādharmyane pāme chhe (arthāt brahmarūp thāy chhe) tyāre ja tenāmā uparokta varṇavelā Parabrahmanā guṇo āve chhe. Māṭe ahī Akṣharbrahmanā sādharmyane pāmavānu tātparya chhe.
vaḷī, “Bhakta Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāme chhe” enā tātparyārthamā ja arthāt enā paryāya tarīke Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Pratham 64mā “brahmabhāvne pāme chhe” em kahyu chhe ane Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 67mā “brahmarūp thāy chhe” em kahyu chhe. Tethī nishchit thāy chhe ke “Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāmavu” eṭale Akṣharbrahmanā sādharmyane pāmavu.
Ā rīte “Bhagwānnā sādharmyapaṇāne pāmavu” eṭale Akṣharbrahmanā sādharmyane pāmavu evu tātparya ahī samajavu.
263: [Shrījī Mahārāje Āṣhāḍhī varṣh 1876nā Bhādarvā sudi 11 Ekādashīnā roj Gaḍhaḍāmā Bhaktibāgmā haramānā vṛukṣh taḷe besīne Shukānand Muni pāse harijano upar Bhūdvīp Khanḍ, Yugparimāṇ ane pralay-varṇan-pūrvak Bharat-Khanḍmā manuṣhya-janmanī durlabhtā varṇavī, tenāthī anya laukik pravṛuttino āgrah nahī karatā mokṣhrūpī kārya siddha karī levānā uddeshthī patra lakhāvelo. Te vāt Harilīlāmṛutnā 6 Kaḷashmā 11-12 Vishrāmmā varṇavī chhe. Ā patra te ja ānupūrvīvāḷo hashe ke anyathā hashe teno vichār karyā vinā upyogno jāṇī pṛuthak chhapāvyo chhe.]

Shrīmad Bhāgwatādi sadgranthone[1] viṣhe lakhyu chhe je, Bharat-Khanḍmā manuṣhyano deh pāmavo te ati durlabh chhe, chintāmaṇi tulya chhe. Je dehne Indrādik devatā ichchhe chhe. Te devatāne viṣhay ne vaibhav-vilās ne āyuṣh te to manuṣhyanā thakī ghaṇu adhik chhe, paṇ tyā mokṣhnu sādhan nathī thātu. Mokṣhnu sādhan to Bharat-Khanḍne viṣhe manuṣhya deh pāmyā thakī thāy chhe, te vinā bīje koī ṭhekāṇe ne koī dehne viṣhe thātu nathī. E hetu māṭe sarva deshthī mṛutyulokmā Bharat-Khanḍne viṣhe manuṣhyano deh pāmavo te adhik chhe, tene tulya bīju koī chaud lokmā sthānak nathī. Te chaud loknā nām – ā Mṛutyulok chhe, tethī ūrdhva chha lok chhe. Temā pratham Bhuvarlok chhe 1, temā malin dev rahe chhe. Tethī ūrdhva bījo Swargalok chhe 2, temā Indrādi dev rahe chhe. Tethī ūrdhva trījo Maharlok chhe 3, temā Aryamādi pitrīdev rahe chhe. Tethī ūrdhva chotho Janlok chhe 4, tethī ūrdhva pānchamo Taplok chhe 5, e be lokmā Bhṛugvādi Ṛuṣhi rahe chhe. Tethī ūrdhva chhaṭhṭho Satyalok chhe 6, temā Brahmā rahe chhe. E Satyalok sahit sāt lok chhe. Te Mṛutyulokthī adho je heṭhā sāt lok chhe. Temā pratham to Ataḷ 1, bījo Vitaḷ 2, trījo Sutaḷ 3, e traṇene viṣhe daitya rahe chhe. Tethī heṭho Taḷātaḷ 1, bījo Mahātaḷ 2, trījo Rasātaḷ 3, e traṇmā nishāchar rahe chhe 6. Ene heṭhā kahyā tethī heṭho sātmo Pātāḷ chhe 7, temā sarp rahe chhe. E sāt lok te Mṛutyulokthī heṭhā chhe. Te sahit sarva thaīne chaud lok thayā. Temā Mṛutyulok chhe te shreṣhṭh chhe. Te Mṛutyuloknā sāt dvīp chhe. Te chakrākār chhe ne tene madhye Jambudvīp chhe, te ek lakṣh jojanno chhe. Tene farato khārā jaḷno samudra chhe te paṇ ek lākh jojanno chhe 1. Tethī bījo Plakṣh nāme dvīp chhe, te be lākh jojanno chhe. Tene farato samudra te paṇ be lākh jojanno chhe. Tenu jaḷ ikṣhu je sheraḍīnā ras jevu chhe 2. Ne tethī trījo Shālmalidvīp chhe. Te farato chhe. Te chār lākh jojanno chhe. Tene farato samudra chhe, te chār lākh jojanno chhe. Tenu jaḷ te surā je dārū tenā jevu chhe 3. Tethī chotho Kushdvīp chhe. Te farato chhe ne te āṭh lākh jojanno chhe ne tevaḍo farato samudra chhe ne tenu jaḷ ghṛut je ghī te jevu chhe 4. Ane tethī pānchamo Kraunchdvīp chhe, te soḷ lākh jojanno chhe ne tevaḍo farato soḷ lākh jojanno samudra chhe. Tenu jaḷ te kṣhīr je dūdh te jevu chhe 5. Tethī chhaṭhṭho Shākdvīp chhe. Te batrīs lākh jojanno chhe. Tene farato samudra chhe te te jevaḍo chhe. Tenu jaḷ te dadhimanḍod je dahī tenā ghoḷavā jevu chhe 6. Tethī sātamo Puṣhkardvīp chhe. Te chosaṭh lākh jojanno chhe. Ne tene farato samudra chhe. Te paṇ chosaṭh lākh jojanno chhe. Tenu jaḷ je sudhā te jevu mīṭhu chhe 7. Evī rīte sāt dvīp chhe.

“Temā ā Jambudvīp chhe te shreṣhṭh chhe ne te Jambudvīpnā nav khanḍ chhe. Te kem chhe? To e dvīp chhe tene madhye suvarṇano Meru Parvat chhe. Te parvatnī talāṭīmā chāre pāse farato ek Ilāvart nāme khanḍ chhe; temā Sankarṣhaṇnī upāsanā chhe ne tyā Shivjī mukhya bhakta chhe. Ane vaḷī te Meruthī pashchim dishāe ek Ketumāḷ nāme khanḍ chhe tenu Subhag evu bīju paṇ nām chhe; ne temā Pradyumnanī upāsanā chhe ne tyā Lakṣhmījī mukhya bhakta chhe. Ane vaḷī te Meruthī uttar dishāe traṇ khanḍ chhe. Temā pratham Ramyak nāme khanḍ chhe temā Matsya Bhagwānnī upāsanā chhe ne tyā Sāvarṇi Manu mukhya bhakta chhe. Ne tethī uttarmā bījo Hiraṇyamay khanḍ chhe ne temā Kūrmajīnī upāsanā chhe ne tyā Aryamā mukhya bhakta chhe. Ne tethī uttarmā bījo Kuru khanḍ chhe ne temā Vārāhnī upāsanā chhe ne tyā pṛuthvī mukhya bhakta chhe. E pāch khanḍ thayā. Ne vaḷī te Meruthī pūrva dishāmā Bhadrāshva nāme khanḍ chhe ne tyā Hayagrīvnī upāsanā chhe ne temā Bhadrashravā nāme mukhya bhakta chhe. Ane vaḷī te Meruthī dakṣhiṇ dishāmā traṇ khanḍ chhe. Ne temā pratham Harivarṣh khanḍ chhe, tene viṣhe Nṛusinhajīnī upāsanā chhe ne Prahlādjī mukhya bhakta chhe. Ne tethī dakṣhiṇ dishāmā bījo Kimpuruṣh nāme khanḍ chhe, temā Rām-Lakṣhmaṇjīnī upāsanā chhe, tyā Hanumānjī mukhya bhakta chhe. Ane tethī dakṣhiṇ dishāmā Bharat-Khanḍ chhe ne temā Narnārāyaṇ Devnī upāsanā chhe ne tyā Nāradjī mukhya bhakta chhe. Evī rīte ā Jambudvīp tenā nav khanḍ kahyā.[2] Temane viṣhe Bharat-Khanḍ chhe te ati shreṣhṭh chhe. Te shā hetu māṭe? To bījā āṭh khanḍ chhe temā bhog-vilāsnā sukh to ghaṇā adhik chhe paṇ mokṣhnu sādhan tyā thātu nathī ne mokṣhnu sādhan te to ek Bharat-Khanḍmā ja thāy chhe. Te hetu māṭe ā Bharat-Khanḍne tulya chaud lokne viṣhe bīju koī ṭhekāṇu nathī.

“Ane vaḷī Bharat-Khanḍ chhe temā paṇ ter desh chhe te anārya kahetā kaṭhor chhe. Te kahīe chhaiye – ek to Bangāḷ 1, bījo Nepāḷ 2, trījo Bhūṭ 3, chotho Kāmākṣhī 4, pānchamo Sindh 5, chhaṭhṭho Kābul 6, sātmo Lāhor 7, āṭhmo Mulatān 8, navmo Īrān 9, dashmo Astambol 10, agiyārmo Arabstān 11, bārmo Svāl 12, termo Pilapilām 13. E ter desh malin chhe, temā je manuṣhya deh pāme tene mokṣhnā dātā evā je sadguru teno jog maḷavo ne mokṣhnā dharmane samajavu te ghaṇu kaṭhaṇ chhe. Have bījā sāḍā bār desh chhe te ārya kahetā uttam chhe. Temanā nām je, pratham to ek Pūrva 1, bījo Vraj 2, trījo Mālav 3, chotho Māru 4, pānchamo Panjāb 5, chhaṭhṭho Gujarāt 6, sātmo Dakṣhiṇ 7, āṭhmo Malabār 8, navmo Tilang 9, dashmo Drāviḍ 10, agiyārmo Bārmalār 11, bārmo Soraṭh 12, aradho Kachchha,[3] e sāḍā bār desh uttam chhe. Temā sadguru ne brahmavettā sant chhe temanu pragaṭpaṇu ghaṇu rahe chhe. Ne te deshmā manuṣhya deh pāme chhe temane dharma, bhakti, vairāgya, gnān e samajāy em chhe ne mokṣhnā māragne jāṇe em chhe. Te kem jāṇe? To e je uttam desh chhe tene viṣhe Bhagwānnā avatār ghaṇāk thāy chhe eṭalā māṭe e desh shreṣhṭh chhe. Ane Bharat-Khanḍnā sarva manuṣhya chhe te mokṣhno upāy kare to mokṣh thāy em chhe ne na kare to na thāy. Māṭe je vivekī chhe tene hinsā-doṣh-rahit thaīne kusangno tyāg karī, sadguru ne brahmavettā santno āshray karīne temane sevavā. Ne te sadguru ne sant temanā lakṣhaṇ sadgranthne viṣhe lakhyā chhe je, dharma, bhakti, vairāgya, gnān e ādik shubh-guṇ-sampanna hoy tene oḷakhīne teno āshray karavo ne te kahe tevī rīte tenā vachanmā potānā deh, indriyo ne antahkaraṇ te rākhavā ne Bhagwānnu bhajan karavu; e ja mokṣhnu sādhan chhe. Te jeṇe bhūt-kāḷe kīdhu ne vartamān-kāḷe kare chhe ne bhaviṣhya-kāḷe karashe tene amūlya manuṣhya dehno lābh thayo em jāṇavu ne tene samaju ne moṭo jāṇavo. Ane em nathī samajato ne tuchchha sansārnā sukhmā lobhāīne kāḷnā koḷiyā evā je khoṭā matvādī guru tenā vachan mānīne āvo manuṣhya deh amūlya chhe tene khue chhe; ne te ja bhaktamā to ḍāhyā kahevātā hoy tathā samaju kahevātā hoy tathā moṭā kahevātā hoy ne tenī jagatmā yash-kīrti ghaṇī hoy te to sarva swapna tulya chhe. Tene sāchu mānīne temā moh pāmyā chhe ne mokṣhno upāya nathī samajatā to tene brahmavettā sādhu ne sadgranth chhe te temane mūrkh kahe chhe, ātmaghātī kahe chhe ne temane pāchho farīne āvo mokṣh-kṣhetramā manuṣhyano deh maḷavo teno vilamb to ghaṇo chhe.

“Te sadgranthne[4] anusāre lakhyu chhe je, āpaṇā varṣh 666 chhase ne chhāsaṭh ne mās 8 āṭh jāy chhe tyāre Brahmāno 1 ek lav thāy chhe. Evā 60 sāṭh lavnu 1 ek nimiṣh te āpaṇā varṣh 40,000 chāḷīs hajār jāy tyāre Brahmānu ek nimiṣh thāy. Evā 60 sāṭh nimiṣhnu ek paḷ te āpaṇā varṣh 24,00,000 chovīs lākh jāy tyāre Brahmānu 1 ek paḷ thāy. Evā 60 sāṭh paḷnī 1 ek ghaḍī te āpaṇā varṣh 14,40,00,000 chaud karoḍ chāḷīs lākh jāy tyāre Brahmānī 1 ek ghaḍī thāy chhe. Evī 30 trīsh ghaḍīno 1 ek divas te āpaṇā varṣh 4,32,00,00,000 chār abaj ne batrīs karoḍ thāy tyāre Brahmāno 1 ek divas thāy chhe. Te chār jugnī 1 ek chokaḍī. 17,28,000 sattar lākh ne aṭhṭhāvīs hajār Saty-Yug. 12,96,000 bār lākh ne chhanu hajār Tretā-Yug. 8,64,000 āṭh lākh ne chosaṭh hajār Dvāpar. 4,32,000 chyār lākh ne batris hajār Kaḷinā. 43,20,000 tretāḷīs lākh ne vīs hajār varṣh thāy tyāre 1 ek chokaḍī thāy. Evī Brahmānā ek divasmā 1 ek hajār chokaḍī jugnī thāy chhe. Te Brahmānā 1 ek divasmā 14 chaud Manu ne 14 chaud Indra te tulya rājya karīne nāsh pāme chhe. 1 ek Manu ne 1 ek Indra āpaṇā varṣh 30,85,71,428 trīs koṭi ne panchāsī lākh ne ikoter hajār ne chārse aṭhṭhāvīs ne te uparānt mās 6 chho ne divas 25 pachīs, ghaḍī 42 betāḷīs, paḷ 51 ekāvan, nimiṣh 25 pachīs, lav 42 bentāḷīs ne uparānt 12 bār lavno chaudmo bhāg, eṭalu ek ek rahīne chaud Indra thaī jāy chhe. Te Brahmānā lav-nimiṣhādik sarva divasmā ūpajīne nāsh thāy chhe; tenu nām pratham nitya pralay kahevāy chhe. Ne te Brahmānī ek rātri thāy chhe tyāre Brahmā sūe chhe tyāre swarga, mṛutyu, pātāḷ e Trilokīno nāsh thāy chhe. Te jevaḍo divas chhe tevaḍī rātri chhe, te āpaṇā varṣh 8,64,00,00,000 āṭh abaj ne chosaṭh karoḍ thāy tyāre Brahmānī ahorātri thaīne ek divas thāy chhe. Te divas-divas prati nāsh thāy chhe ne divasāntare pāchhu fare chhe ne te nāsh thāy chhe. Tenu nām 2 bījo nimitta pralay kahevāy chhe. E Brahmānā 1 ek divasnī avadhi kahī. Evā 30 trīs divasno 1 ek mās, evā bār māsnu ek varṣh, evā 100 so varṣh Brahmā deh rākhe chhe. Te Brahmā deh mūke tyāre e chaud lok sahit brahmānḍno nāsh thāy chhe, tyāre prakṛutithī ūpajyu kāraj te sarva prakṛutimā laya pāme chhe. E trījo prākṛut pralay kahevāy chhe. Chotho ātyantik pralay thāy chhe tyāre to anant koṭi brahmānḍno nāsh thāy chhe. Te divas to Pradhān-Puruṣhnu kāraṇ e je Prakṛuti-Puruṣh te potāne viṣhe anant brahmānḍne pratilom karīne pote Akṣhar-Puruṣhnā tejmā līn thāy chhe. Tenu nām chotho ātyantik pralay kahevāy chhe. Te pralaykāḷe jem pratilom thāy chhe tem utpattikāḷe anukrame tethī anulom ja ūpaje chhe. E to chār prakārnā pralaynu kahyu, paṇ trījo prākṛut pralay te Brahmānī āyuṣha-avadhino kīdho. Evā sāḍī traṇ koṭi prākṛut pralay thaī jāy chhe tyāre e jīv chhe te āvo manuṣhya deh pāmyo hoy; te deh vṛuthā khoṭā māyik sukh ne matvādī gurune āshare rahīne hāre chhe. Te jīv Yam-yātanā ne narak-kunḍnā dukh ne lakh-chorāsī jātnā je deh chhe tenā dukh bhogavīne temā farīne pāchho sāḍī traṇ koṭi prākṛut pralay kahyā evā thashe tyāre farīne mokṣh-kṣhetramā āvo manuṣhyano deh pāme chhe; eṭalo farīne manuṣhya deh pāmavāno vilamb chhe. Māṭe he bhāī, sūze to āj samajīne mokṣhnā dātā je sadguru ne sant teno āshray karīne tenī āgnāmā potāno deh ne indriyo ne antahkaraṇne vartāvīne potānā ātmānu shrey karīne Bhagwānnā dhāmne pahocho. Ne jo āj e vāt nahī samajo ne āvo manuṣhya deh mokṣhnā sādhannu dhām chhe te vṛuthā hārasho to farī pāchho āvo jog maḷavāno vilamb to more lakhyo eṭalo chhe. Te pramāṇe bhogavīne te avadhi pūrī thāshe te divas jog mokṣh thāvāno thāshe. Te dī jo vichārsho to thāshe ne nahī vichāro to te dī paṇ mokṣh thāshe nahī; e siddhānt-vārtā chhe. Samaju hoy te vichārjo ne mūrakhne māthe to Shruti-Smṛutinī āmanyā nathī; te to koī e vātne samajashe nahī. Shrīrastu.
૨. જંબુદ્વીપના નવખંડ તથા ચૌદ લોકના વર્ણન માટે જુઓ ભાગવતપુરાણ: ૫/૨૦, દેવી ભાગવત: ૮/૪/૭-૧૮, પદ્મોદ્ભવસંહિતા: ૧૩.
2. Jambudvīpnā nav-khanḍ tathā Chaud Loknā varṇan māṭe juo Bhāgavat-Purāṇ: 5/20, Devī Bhāgwat: 8/4/7-18, Padmodbhav-sanhitā: 13.
264: Samvat 1882nā Fāgaṇ vadi 3 Tṛutiyāne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amadāvād madhye Shrī Narnārāyaṇnā Mandirne sanmukh vedikā upar gādītakiye yukta je ḍholiyo te upar virājmān hatā ane sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne mastak upar gulābī rangnī pāgh virājmān hatī ane pāghne viṣhe gulābnā torā zūkī rahyā hatā ane shravaṇ upar gulābnā guchchha khosyā hatā ane gulābnā bahu hār kanṭhne viṣhe virājmān hatā ne be bāhye gulābnā bājubandh bāndhyā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj muni-manḍaḷ tathā haribhakta pratye em bolyā je, “Sarve sāmbhaḷo, ek vāt karīe je, pratham Bhagwānnā swarūpno draḍh nishchay karavo. Te Bhagwān kevā chhe? To potānī ichchhāe karīne jīvnā kalyāṇne arthe janma dhare chhe. Ne janmane dharatā thakā paṇ ajanmā chhe ne dehne mūkatā thakā paṇ ajar, amar chhe. Ne niranjan chhe kahetā māyānā anjne karīne rahit chhe ne mūrtimān chhe. Ane swaprakāsh chhe, Parabrahma chhe, Akṣharātīt chhe, antaryāmī chhe, anant koṭi brahmānḍnā ādhār chhe. Ane manuṣhya dehne je dharavu ne mūkavu te to naṭnī peṭhe indrajāl sarakhu chhe. Ane anant koṭi akṣharādi muktanā niyantā chhe ne sarvenā Swāmī chhe. Evā je Shrī Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇ te pratham Dharmadev thakī Mūrtine viṣhe Shrī Narnārāyaṇrūpe pragaṭ thaīne[5] Badarikāshramne viṣhe tap kare chhe. Ane vaḷī te Shrī Narnārāyaṇ te pṛuthvīne viṣhe koīk kāryane arthe Machchha, Kachchha, Varāh, Vāman, Rām, Kṛuṣhṇādik je deh tene grahaṇ karīne ane te potāne dehe karīne anya jīvnā dehābhimānno tyāg karāvīne ane brahma-abhimānne grahaṇ karāvīne potānā dehne ane anya jīvnā dehne sam dekhāḍe chhe. Jem kāṭe karīne kāṭāne kāḍhīne be kāṭāno tyāg kare tem Bhagwān potānā dehno anya jīvnā dehne tulyapaṇe tyāg kare chhe. Te Bhāratne viṣhe ākhyān chhe je, Nṛusinhajīne jyāre dehtyāg karyānī ichchhā thaī tyāre antaryāmīrūpe karīne Shivnā hṛudayne viṣhe prerīne Shiv pāse Sharabhno deh dharāvyo. Ane te Sharabhne ne Nṛusinhajīne yuddha thayu, ne pachhī Nṛusinhajīe potāno deh mūkī dīdho.[6] Evī rīte swatantra thakā potānī ichchhāe karīne dehne grahaṇ kare chhe ne te dehno tyāg kare chhe. Te jem Ruṣhabhdevno deh dāvānalne viṣhe baḷī gayo[7] ane Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwānnā pagmā tīr lāgyo ne dehno tyāg karyo,[8] te charitrane dekhīne je nāstik mativāḷā chhe ne abhakta chhe temanī mati bhramī jāy chhe ane potānī peṭhe Bhagwānne viṣhe paṇ janma-mṛutyunu āropaṇ kare chhe. Ane temanī matine viṣhe em jaṇāy chhe je, Bhagwān paṇ karme karīne dehne dhare chhe ane karme karīne dehne mūke chhe; ane jyāre naiṣhkarmya karmane karashe tyāre karma khapīne mukta thashe. Ane je āstik buddhivāḷā chhe ane haribhakta chhe te em jāṇe chhe je, nāstiknī samajaṇ chhe te khoṭī chhe ne Bhagwānno deh to nitya chhe, ane Bhagwānne viṣhe janma, bālya, yauvan, vṛuddhapaṇu ne mṛutyu ityādik je dehnā bhāv te to Bhagwānnī līlā chhe. Ane kāḷ ne māyā te Bhagwānnā dehne viṣhe cheṣhṭā karavāne arthe samarth thatā nathī. Ane Bhagwānnā dehne viṣhe pariṇāmpaṇu jaṇāy chhe te to e Bhagwānnī yog-māyāe karīne jaṇāy chhe. Ane tene viṣhe je Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe te moh nathī pāmatā ne je abhakta chhe tenī mati bhramī jāy chhe. Jem naṭnā charitrane dekhīne jagatnā jīvnī mati bhramī jāy chhe ane naṭnī vidyānā jāṇtalnī mati nathī bhramatī, tem Puruṣhottam evā je Shrī Narnārāyaṇ te anek deh dharīne naṭnī peṭhe te dehno tyāg kare chhe. Ne e Shrī Narnārāyaṇ sarve avatārnā kāraṇ chhe. Ne Shrī Narnārāyaṇne viṣhe je maraṇbhāv kalpe chhe tene anek deh dharavā paḍe chhe ne chorāsīnā dukhno ne Yampurīnā dukhno tene pār āvato nathī; ane je Shrī Narnārāyaṇne viṣhe ajar, amarpaṇu samaje chhe te karma thakī ne chorāsī thakī mukāī jāy chhe. Māṭe āpaṇā Uddhav Sampradāynā sarve satsangī, sādhu Bhagwānnī mūrtiyu je thaī gaiyu ne hamaṇā chhe ne āgaḷ thashe, tene viṣhe maraṇbhāv koī kalpasho mā. Ane ā vārtā sau lakhī lejyo.” Em kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj potānu pragaṭpaṇu jaṇāvatā havā ne te vārtāne sāmbhaḷīne sarve tevī ja rīte Shrījī Mahārājno nishchay karatā havā.

1. The story of sharabh fighting with Nrusinha is in the Ling-Puran, Purvardha 95/60-62. Nrusinha had killed Hiranyakashipu. Afterward, the whole brahmānd started to burn from the intense light of Nrusinha. The devas went to Shiva to find a solution to this. Shivaji assumed the form of a sharabh and killed Nrushinha. The body of Nrusinha became a slab of stone and is known as Nārsinha Shilā. (Maharaj has mentioned this in Loya 18 as well.)

2. When the Yādavas mutually killed themselves when they fought internally, Shri Krishna Bhagwan sat under a pipal tree in Prabhās. A hunter named Jarā saw the red sole of Krishna’s foot and mistook it for a deer’s mouth. He shot Krishna’s foot. When he came closer, he realized he had shot God himself. He rested his head on Krishna’s feet and asked for forgiveness. Krishna Bhagwan forgave him and gave him a place in swarga. He told Dāruk to protect the family and he left for his abode. [Bhagwat: 10/31/6]

૫. પુરુષોત્તમ નારાયણના અનુપ્રવેશથી નરનારાયણ વગેરે ઈશ્વરો ઐશ્વર્ય પામીને અવતરે છે. તેથી પુરુષોત્તમ નારાયણ અને નરનારાયણ બંને તદ્દન ભિન્ન છે. તેમ છતાં સભામાં બેઠેલ ભક્તનાં જીવમાં નરનારાયણની પ્રધાનતા હોવાથી બંનેની એકતા જણાવે છે.

૬. નૃસિંહની શરભ સાથેના યુદ્ધની કથા લિંગપુરાણ, પૂર્વાર્ધ: ૯૫/૬૦-૬૨માં છે. પૂર્વ અધ્યાયમાં નૃસિંહે હિરણ્યકશિપુનો વધ કર્યો તે કથા આવે છે. પછી નૃસિંહના તેજથી સમગ્ર બ્રહ્માંડ બળવા લાગ્યું. ત્યારે દેવો શિવ પાસે ગયા અને આનો ઉપાય કરવા કહ્યું. ત્યારે શિવજીએ શરભનું રૂપ ધારણ કરીને નૃસિંહના શરીરને નાશ કર્યો. તે શરીરની શિલા થઈ. જે નારસિંહી શિલા કહેવાય છે. (જુઓ વચનામૃત લોયા ૧૮, ટીપણી-૧૦૨)

૮. ભાગવત: ૧૧/૩૦/૩૩.
જ્યારે યાદવો પરસ્પર યુદ્ધમાં લડ્યા અને બધાનો નાશ થયો ત્યારે ભગવાન શ્રીકૃષ્ણ પ્રભાસતીર્થમાં એક પીપળાના વૃક્ષ નીચે બેઠા હતા. જરા નામના પારધીએ દૂરથી ભગવાનનાં ચરણના લાલ તળિયાં જોઈને હરણનું મુખ સમજી બાણથી તેમને વીંધી નાંખ્યા. તેણે નજીક જઈને જોયું. “અરે! આ તો ભગવાન સ્વયં છે.” ત્યારે ભગવાન શ્રીકૃષ્ણનાં ચરણો પર માથું મૂકી ક્ષમા માગી. ભગવાન શ્રીકૃષ્ણ તેને માફી આપી અને સદેહે સ્વર્ગમાં નિવાસ આપ્યો. પોતે દારુકને પરિવારની સુરક્ષા કરવાનું જણાવી પોતાના ધામમાં ચાલ્યા ગયા.
[ભાગવત: ૧૦/૩૧/૬]

5. Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇnā anupraveshthī Narnārāyaṇ vagere īshvaro aishvarya pāmīne avatare chhe. Tethī Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇ ane Narnārāyaṇ banne taddan bhinna chhe, tem chhatā sabhāmā beṭhel bhaktana jīvmā Narnārāyaṇnī pradhāntā hovāthī bannenī ekatā jaṇāve chhe.
265: Samvat 1882nā Fāgaṇ vadi 4 Chaturthīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amdāvād madhye Shrī Narnārāyaṇnā Mandir thakī uttarādī dishe vedikāne viṣhe ḍholiyā upar gādītakiyānu uṭhingaṇ deīne virājmān hatā ne sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane kanṭhne viṣhe gulābno moṭo hār virājmān hato ne pāghne viṣhe puṣhpanā torā laṭakatā hatā ne jamaṇā hastane viṣhe Tulsīnī māḷāne feravatā hatā ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ moṭā moṭā muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Te same Kubersinhajī Chhaḍīdāre Shrījī Mahārājne prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Shrī Puruṣhottam Bhagwānnu asādhāraṇ lakṣhaṇ te shu chhe?” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Anek jīvnā prāṇ-nāḍīne sankelo karīne je tatkāḷ samādhi karāvavī te bījāthī thāy nahī ne lakṣhāvadhi manuṣhya niyammā rahyā thakā vash varte te bījā koīthī thāy nahī ane Akṣharādik je mukta tene paṇ niyammā rākhavāne samarthpaṇu te paṇ bījāmā hoy nahī. Evī rīte Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇnu asādhāraṇ lakṣhaṇ chhe.”

Pachhī vaḷī Kubersinhajīe bījo prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Brahmānḍ to asankhya koṭi chhe. Ne Bhagwānno avatār to ā brahmānḍmā Jambudvīpnā Bharat-Khanḍne viṣhe chhe ane bījā brahmānḍomā asankhya jīv chhe, te jīvno uddhār Bhagwān shī rīte karatā hashe? Te kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Je Bhagwān ā brahmānḍmā virāje chhe te ja Bhagwān sarvenā Swāmī chhe ne anant koṭi brahmānḍne viṣhe asankhya jīvnā kalyāṇne arthe brahmānḍ-brahmānḍ pratye te ja Bhagwān pote deh dhāraṇ kare chhe. Tene sharaṇe asankhya jīv thāy chhe teṇe karīne Akṣhardhāmmā Shrī Puruṣhottamnā charaṇārvindne ghaṇāk jīv pāme chhe. E uttar eno chhe.”

Ane vaḷī Kubersinhe pūchhyu je, “He Mahārāj! Bhagwānne jāṇavāvāḷā je satsangī tene shu shu tajavu ne shu shu grahaṇ karavu? Te kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ā māyik padārthnī āshā te sarve prakāre tyāg karavī ne Bhagwān sambandhī āshānu grahaṇ karavu. Ne jo dhanne viṣhe āshā hoy to em āshā bāndhavī je, Bhagwānnā dhāmmā sonāmahoru tathā hīrā, ratna, māṇek ādik amūlya amūlya padārth chhe, e sarva Bhagwānne bhajashu to pāmashu; em āshā bāndhavī paṇ māyik padārthnī āshā na bāndhavī. Ane jo strī sambandhī kāmanā hoy to em vichār kare je, parastrī sāmī khoṭī najar karashu to narak-chorāsīmā javu paḍashe ne tyā mahādukh thashe. Ne viṣhay to kūtarā, gadheḍā paṇ bhogave chhe, ane mane to pragaṭ Puruṣhottam maḷyā chhe, te kurājī thashe to moṭī khoṭ āvashe. Em jāṇīne kām-vāsanāno tyāg karavo ane Bhagwān sambandhī sukhnu grahaṇ karavu. Ne dehnā sambandhīmā prīti hoy to teno tyāg karavo ne Bhagwānnā dās je sant te sangāthe prīti karavī, e grahaṇ karavu. Ne dehne viṣhe ahambuddhi hoy to teno tyāg karīne Bhagwānnā dāspaṇānī buddhinu grahaṇ karavu. Ne Bhagwān athavā Sādhu te potāne koīk rīte kachavāyā hoy ne tiraskār karyo hoy teṇe karīne Bhagwānno tathā santno potāne avaguṇ āvyo hoy to teno manmāthī tyāg karavo ne potānī bhūl jāṇavī ne Bhagwān ne santno guṇ grahaṇ karavo. Evī rīte savaḷu vichārvu paṇ avaḷu to koī divas vichārvu ja nahī. Evī rīte e prashnano uttar chhe.”

Ane vaḷī Kubersinhe prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Dharma, arth, kām ne mokṣh e chārenu rūp kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj mand mand hasīne em bolyā je, “Arthnu rūp to e chhe je, jene karīne dhan bheḷu karavu; athavā mokṣh sambandhī potāno arth sādhavo e paṇ arthnu rūp chhe. Ane dharmanu rūp to e chhe je, te dhan dharmane arthe satsangmā vāvare paṇ kumārge kyāy na vāvare e dharmanu rūp chhe. Ane kāmnu rūp to e chhe je, ek paraṇel strī rākhe ane teno paṇ ṛutukāḷe sang kare ane bījī strīyu jagatmā chhe teno mā, ben, dīkarī tulya jāṇīne tyāg rākhe e kāmnu rūp chhe. Ane mokṣhnu rūp to e chhe je, satsang sambandhī je sarve vartamān tene khabaḍdār thaīne rākhe ne Bhagwānno achaḷ nishchay rākhe e mokṣhnu rūp chhe. E chāreno uttar chhe.” Em kahīne pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj poḍhī jatā havā.
266: Samvat 1882nā Fāgaṇ vadi 6 Chhaṭhane divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amdāvād madhye Shrī Narnārāyaṇnā Mandirne sanmukh vedikā upar gādītakiye yukta je ḍholiyo te upar virājmān hatā ne sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne koṭane viṣhe gulābnā hār paheryā hatā ne pāghne viṣhe beu kore chamelīnā puṣhpanā torā zūkī rahyā hatā ne beu kān upar gulābnā guchchha virājmān hatā ne gulābno moṭo guchchha hast-kamaḷmā laīne mukhārvind upar feravatā hatā ne potonā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī sandhyā ārtī thaī rahī, te keḍe Kubersinhe Shrījī Mahārāj pratye prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Je puruṣhne Bhagwānno nishchay potānā hṛudaymā yathārth thayo hoy te nishchay kyārey na ḍage te upāya kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ā vāt to saune sāmbhaḷvā yogya chhe. Te māṭe sarve sāvadhān thaīne sāmbhaḷo je, pratyakṣh evā je Bhagwān tenu āvī rīte māhātmya jāṇe to nishchay ḍage nahī. Te māhātmya kahīe chhīe je, ā satsangne viṣhe je Bhagwān virāje chhe te ja Bhagwānmāthī sarve avatār thayā chhe ne pote to avatārī chhe ne e ja sarvenā antaryāmī chhe. Ne e ja Akṣhardhāmne viṣhe tejomay chhe ne sadā sākārrūp chhe ne anant aishvaryayukta chhe. Ne e ja anant brahmānḍnā rājādhirāj chhe ne Akṣharbrahmanā paṇ kāraṇ chhe. Te Bhagwān jyāre pragaṭ thaīne Ṛuṣhabhdevnī kriyāne grahaṇ kare tyāre jāṇīe je, Ṛuṣhabhadev chhe; ane jyāre Rāmāvatārnu charitra kare tyāre jāṇīe je, Rāmchandrajī chhe; ne jyāre Shrī Kṛuṣhṇanī līlā āchare tyāre jāṇīe je, Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa chhe. E j prakāre je je avatārnī kriyā jāṇyāmā āve tyāre em samajavu je, more Bhagwānnā jeṭalā avatār thayā chhe te sarve āmāthī thayā chhe ne e ja Bhagwān sarve avatārnā kāraṇ chhe. Em samaje to teno nishchay ḍage nahī ne em na samaje to kāīk ḍag-magāṭ thāy kharo, eno e uttar chhe. Ne te ja Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Bhagwān pote Shrī Narnārāyaṇrūpe[9] thaīne dharma ne bhakti thakī pragaṭ thayā chhe. Te māṭe ā Shrī Narnārāyaṇne ame amāru rūp jāṇīne ati āgrah karīne sarvethī pratham ā Shrīnagarne viṣhe padharāvyā chhe. Māṭe ā Shrī Narnārāyaṇne viṣhe ne amāre viṣhe lagāre paṇ bhed samajavo nahī. Ne Brahmadhāmnā nivāsī paṇ e ja chhe.”

Evī rītnā Shrījī Mahārājnā vachan sāmbhaḷīne vaḷī Kubersinhe pūchhyu je, “He Mahārāj! Te Brahmapur kevu chhe tenu rūp kaho, ne tene viṣhe je Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe tenu rūp kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Akṣharrūp je Brahma chhe te ja Shrī Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇne rahevā sāru dhāmrūp thayu chhe ne sarva Akṣharbrahma[10] thakī Bhagwānnā dhāmrūp je Akṣharbrahma te anādi chhe. Ne te Brahmadhāmne viṣhe bahu prakārnā mohol chhe, te moholune viṣhe bahu prakārnā gokh chhe ne bahu prakārnā zarūkhā chhe ne bahu prakārnī tene agāsiyu chhe ne tene viṣhe bahu chitra-vichitrapaṇu chhe ne bahu prakārnā fuvārā chhe ne bahu prakārnā bāg-bagīchā chhe ne temā fūl paṇ anant jātnā chhe[11] ne tejomay chhe ne anant chhe ne ene koī dhāmnī upamā na devāy tevu chhe. Ane Golok paṇ ene kahīe chhīe.[12] Ne anant anya dhāmnī vibhūtiyu te thakī asankhya koṭi jātnī shobhānu adhikpaṇu chhe ne apār chhe. Tyā draṣhṭānt chhe: jem ākāsh apār chhe, tenī chāre kore joīe te koī dishāmā ant āvato nathī; tem e Bhagwānnā dhāmno heṭhe, upar ne chāre kore ant nathī. Kem je, e apār chhe, teno jo pār levā mānḍe to pār āve nahī, evu moṭu Brahmapur chhe. Te Brahmapurne viṣhe je padārth chhe te sarve divya chaitanyamay chhe. Ne te dhāmne viṣhe asankhya pārṣhad rahyā chhe te kevā chhe? To divya ākār sahit ne tejomay chhe ne sarvabhūt-prāṇīmātranā antaryāmī chhe, te sarve Bhagwānnī sevāmā nirantar tatpar rahyā chhe. Ne te ja dhāmnā je pati ane Akṣharādik muktanā Swāmī ne Parabrahma Puruṣhottam je chhe te ja ā satsangne viṣhe virājmān chhe. Āvo jene nishchay chhe te ja Brahmadhāmne pāme chhe.”
1. Here, ‘other aksharbrahmas’ should be understood to mean ‘muktas who have become like Aksharbrahma’.
૯. સર્વાવતારીપણે પોતાનો મહિમા નિરૂપીને શ્રોતાઓને પચે તેવી હળવી વાત કરતાં જણાવે છે.
૧૦. ‘સર્વ અક્ષરબ્રહ્મ થકી’ એટલે બ્રહ્મ સંજ્ઞાને પામેલા અનંત મુક્તો, તે કરતાં ભગવાનના ધામરૂપ જે અક્ષરબ્રહ્મ અર્થાત્ મૂર્તિમાન અક્ષર તે અનાદિ છે અને શ્રેષ્ઠ છે.
૧૧. અક્ષરધામમાં બાગબગીચા વગેરેનું વર્ણન ભગવાનની વિશેષ સામર્થીરૂપે સમજવું. વસ્તુતઃ મુક્તને ભગવાનની મૂર્તિ સિવાય આવા કોઈ પદાર્થ અથવા ભોગની અપેક્ષા અને ઇચ્છા નથી.
૧૨. ગો = કિરણો + લોક = સ્થાન = તેજોમય અક્ષરધામ; તેવો અર્થ ‘ગોલોક’ શબ્દનો સમજવો.
9. Sarvāvatārīpaṇe potāno mahimā nirūpīne shrotāone pache tevī haḷavī vāt karatā jaṇāve chhe.
10. ‘Sarva Akṣharbrahma thakī’ eṭale brahma sangnāne pāmelā anant mukto, te karatā Bhagwānnā dhāmrūp je Akṣharbrahma arthāt mūrtimān Akṣhar te anādi chhe ane shreṣhṭh chhe.
11. Akṣhardhāmmā bāg-bagīchā vagerenu varṇan Bhagwānnī visheṣh sāmarthīrūpe samajavu. Vastutah muktane Bhagwānnī mūrti sivāy āvā koī padārth athavā bhognī apekṣhā ane ichchhā nathī.
12. Go = kiraṇo + lok = sthān = tejomaya Akṣhardhām; tevo arth ‘Golok’ shabdano samajavo.
267: Samvat 1882nā Fāgaṇ vadi 7 Saptamīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amdāvād madhye Shrī Narnārāyaṇnā Mandirne viṣhe darvājānā meḍā upar Vāsudev-Māhātmya vanchāvatā hatā. Pachhī ūṭhīne darvājā pāse līmaḍānā vṛukṣh taḷe ḍholiyā upar sandhyā same virājmān thayā hatā ane mastak upar gulābī rangnī pāgh bāndhī hatī. Temā gulābnā torā khosyā hatā ne gulābnā hār paherīne garakāv thayā hatā ne shvet pachheḍī oḍhī hatī ne shvet survāḷ paheryo hato ne ugamṇe mukhārvinde virājmān hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Te same Prāgjī Davee Shrījī Mahārājne prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Tamāre viṣhe kiye prakāre man sthir thāy ne vyabhichārne koī kāḷe na pāme? Te kaho.” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Tamārā prashnano uttar kahīe tene tame sāmbhaḷo.” Em kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Bhagwānnu māhātmya jāṇavā thakī Bhagwānne viṣhe man sthir thāy chhe. Te māhātmya jāṇavānī rīt kahīe chhīe je, pratham ame Pīpalāṇāmā Lādhā Brāhmaṇne gher Rāmānand Swāmīne em pūchhyu hatu je, ‘Tame sanātan īshvar chho ke ādhunik īshvar chho?’ Tyāre Rāmānand Swāmī to bolyā ja nahī. Ne tyār pachhī Agaṇotarā Kāḷmā ame māndā thayā hatā tyāre ame Kṣhīr-Sāgarne viṣhe Sheṣh-shayyāne viṣhe Sheṣh-shāyī Nārāyaṇ sūtā chhe tyā gayā. Tyāre tyā ame Rāmānand Swāmīne joyā, te dhoḷī dhotī paherī hatī ne pachheḍī oḍhī hatī. Evā bījā paṇ ghaṇāk Sheṣh-shāyī Nārāyaṇnā charaṇārvindne samīpe beṭhā hatā, te ame joyā. Tyāre ame Nārāyaṇne pūchhyu je, ‘Ā Rāmānand Swāmī te koṇ chhe?’ Pachhī Nārāyaṇne kahyu je, ‘E to brahmavettā chhe.’ Em Nārāyaṇne bolate sate Rāmānand Swāmī to te Nārāyaṇnā sharīrne viṣhe līn thayā. Ne tyār pachhī ame dehne viṣhe āvyā. Ne te pachhī ame antardraṣhṭi karī tyāre praṇav-nādne joyo. Te jotā jotā Nandīshvar poṭhiyo āvyo, te upar besīne Kailāsmā Shivjī pāse gayā. Ne tyā Garuḍ āvyo, te upar besīne Vaikunṭh tathā Brahmadhāmne viṣhe jātā havā. Tyā Garuḍ paṇ ūḍī shakyo nahī, eṭale ame ekalā ja te sarva thakī par evu je Shrī Puruṣhottamnu dhām temā gayā. Tyā paṇ hu ja Puruṣhottam chhu, mārā vinā bījo moṭo koī dekhyo nahī. Eṭale ṭhekāṇe faryā ane pachhī ame dehne viṣhe āvyā ne fer antar sāmu joyu tyāre em jaṇāṇu je, sarve brahmānḍnī utpatti, sthiti ne pralay teno kartā paṇ hu ja chhu. Ne anant brahmānḍnā asankhya Shiv, asankhya Brahmā, asankhya Kailās, asankhya Vaikunṭh ane Golok, Brahmapur ane asankhya karoḍ bījī bhūmikāo e sarve māre teje karīne tejāyamān chhe. Ane vaḷī hu kevo chhu? To mārā pagne angūṭhe karīne pṛuthvīne ḍagāvu to asankhya brahmānḍnī pṛuthvī ḍagavā lāge ne māre teje karīne sūrya, chandramā, tārā ādik sarva tejāyamā chhe. Evo je hu te māre viṣhe em samajīne nishchay kare to Bhagwān evo je hu te māre viṣhe man sthir thāy ne koī kāḷe vyabhichārne pāme nahī. Ne je je jīv māre sharaṇe āvyā chhe ne em samajashe tene sarvene hu sarvoparī evu je māru dhām chhe tene pamāḍīsh ane te sarvene antaryāmī jevā karīsh. Ne brahmānḍonī utpattyādik kare evā samarth karīsh. Paṇ pachhī sāmarthī pāmīne em jāṇe je, ‘Hu ja moṭo chhu,’ em jāṇīne ṛuṣhirūp evā je pratyakṣh Shrī Narnārāyaṇ[13] tene gaṇavā ja nahī evo ahankār āvavā devo nahī ne em jāṇavu je, ‘Shrī Narnārāyaṇnī karuṇāe karīne hu moṭap pāmyo chhu.” Em Shrījī Mahārāje e prashnano uttar karyo.
૧૩. અહીં નરનારાયણના મિષે પોતાનો જ સર્વોપરીપણે મહિમા જણાવે છે, તે આ વાક્યમાં આવેલ ‘પ્રત્યક્ષ શ્રીનરનારાયણ’ શબ્દથી સ્પષ્ટ જણાય છે.
13. Ahī Narnārāyaṇnā miṣhe potāno ja sarvoparīpaṇe mahimā jaṇāve chhe, te ā vākyamā āvel ‘pratyakṣh Shrī Narnārāyaṇ’ shabdathī spaṣhṭa jaṇāy chhe.
268: Samvat 1882nā Fāgaṇ vadi 8 Aṣhṭamīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amdāvād madhye Shrī Narnārāyaṇnā Mandirthī uttar dishe dharmashāḷāne viṣhe sādhune jamāḍatā hatā ne sundar shvet rūmāl mastak upar bāndhyo hato ne shvet khes paheryo hato ne ḍābā khabhā upar khes nākhīne keḍ bāndhī hatī ne kanṭhne viṣhe gulābno moṭo hār virājmān hato.

Ne pachhī panktimā lāḍu feravatā feravatā Shrījī Mahārāje sarve sādhune em vārtā karī je, “Sādhune sarve prakāre krodh jītavo. Te krodh kevo chhe? To jap, tap, gnān e ādik sarve shubh guṇne nāsh kare evo chhe. Ne have je nimitte krodh ūpaje chhe te nimittane kahīe chhīe je, sādhune māhomāhī prashna-uttar karatā krodh ūpaje tathā vād-vivād karatā krodh ūpaje tathā koī padārth levā-devāmā krodh ūpaje tathā koīkne shikṣhā karatā hoīe ne krodh ūpaje tathā potānī shushrūṣhāne viṣhe raheto hoy je sādhu tene pakṣhpāte karīne krodh ūpaje tathā apamāne karīne krodh ūpaje tathā īrṣhyāe karīne krodh ūpaje tathā āsan karavāne viṣhe krodh ūpaje tathā Bhagwānnī prasādī vahechavāne viṣhe nyūnādhikpaṇu kare ne krodh ūpaje, e prakāre krodh ūpajyānā nimitta ghaṇāk chhe. Māṭe te krodh jo moṭā sādhune ūpaje athavā nānā sādhune ūpaje, to jenī upar krodh ūpaje tene sāṣhṭāng danḍvat praṇām karavo ane gad-gad-hṛuday thaīne dīnatāe niṣhkapaṭpaṇe karīne rūḍā rūḍā vachan bolīne tene prasanna karavo; em amārī āgnā chhe. Ane jo koīk sādhu upar droh-buddhie sankalp thāy to niṣhkapaṭ thaīne potāne mukhe te sankalp kahevo je, ‘He Mahārāj! Ā rītno bhūnḍo sankalp tamārī upar thayo.’ Ne te sankalpno je doṣh tenī nivṛuttine arthe hāth joḍīne tenī prārthanā karavī. Ane jo sādhune gṛuhasth haribhakta upar krodh ūpaje to te sādhu gṛuhasthnī vachane karīne prārthanā kare ane beṭhe thake namaskār kare, paṇ sāṣhṭāng danḍvat na kare. Ane je sānkhyayogī bāīo chhe temane paṇ jo paraspar krodh ūpaje tathā karmayogī strīone viṣhe krodh ūpaje to vachane karīne prārthanā karavī ne beṭhe thake namaskār karavo. Ane sānkhyayogī puruṣh tathā sādhu temanī to ek ja rīt chhe. Ane jenī upar krodh ūpaje tene āpaṇā Swāmī[14] je Shrī Narnārāyaṇ teno bhakta jāṇīne tatkāḷ mān mūkīne namaskār karavo ne prārthanā karavī paṇ deh-draṣhṭi na rākhavī je, ‘Hu moṭo chhu ne uttam chhu ne ā to moṭo nathī ne nāno chhe,’ evī rīte deh-draṣhṭi na karavī. Ne āpaṇā iṣhṭadev je Shrī Narnārāyaṇ te paṇ krodh tathā mān nathī rākhatā. Māṭe te Shrī Narnārāyaṇnā āshrit evā je Uddhav Sampradāynā āpaṇ sarve temaṇe krodh tathā mān teno sarva prakāre tyāg karavo. Ane ā je ame krodhnu prāyashchitta kahyu chhe tene je karashe tene upar Shrī Narnārāyaṇ prasanna thashe ne tenu antahkaraṇ shuddha thashe ne tenā kām, krodh, mān, lobh, mad, matsar te sarva nāsh pāmī jashe. Ane krodh ūpanyo ne je ā prāyashchitta nahī kare tene sarp tulya jāṇavo paṇ tene Bhagwānno bhakta jāṇavo nahī.” Evī rīte Shrījī Mahārāje vārtā karī tene sāmbhaḷīne sādhu tathā sarva haribhakta puruṣh ne strīo param ānand pāmatā havā.
૧૪. શ્રીહરિ અમદાવાદમાં બિરાજતા હોવાથી નરનારાયણને સ્વામી અને ઇષ્ટદેવ તરીકે અહીં નિરૂપે છે. વસ્તુતાએ તો તેઓ જ સર્વના ઇષ્ટદેવ અને સ્વામી છે.
14. Shrī Hari Amdāvādmā birājtā hovāthī Narnārāyaṇne Swāmī ane iṣhṭadev tarīke ahī nirūpe chhe. Vastutāe to teo ja sarvanā iṣhṭadev ane swāmī chhe.
269: Samvat 1882nā Chaitra sudi 2 Dvitīyāne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj Shrī Amadāvād Nagarthī gājate-vājate chālyā, te sāyankāḷe gām Shrī Ashlālīe padhāryā. Ne te gāmthī uttarādī dishe āmbāvāḍiyāmā ūtaryā ne tyā manch upar virājmān thayā. Ne sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe sundar puṣhpanā hār paheryā hatā ne pāghne viṣhe puṣhpanā torā laṭakatā hatā. Ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Te same Shrījī Mahārāj Muktānand Swāmī tathā Brahmānand Swāmī ādik sādhu sarve pratye em bolyā je, “Sarve sāmbhaḷo, ek vāt karavī chhe je, je bhaktane Bhagwānnu swarūp jāṇavāne viṣhe kāīk nyūntā rahe chhe tene moṭī khoṭ āve chhe. Ne Bhagwān je Puruṣhottam jene Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa kahīe, jene Shrī Vāsudev kahīe, jene Shrī Narnārāyaṇ kahīe, jene Parabrahma kahīe, jene Shrī Nārāyaṇ kahīe, tenu yathārth sukh paṇ āvatu nathī ne ekāntik bhakta thavātu nathī. Māṭe ekāntik evā je Bhagwānnā gnānī bhakta temano samāgam karīne gnānnī draḍhatā karavī. Kem je, Bhagwānnā swarūpnā gnānnī draḍhatā vinā to Prajāpati ādi daīne je jagatnā sraṣhṭā chhe te paṇ vāramvār sṛuṣhṭi bheḷā utpanna thāy chhe ne pāchhā ante māyāne viṣhe ja līn thāy chhe, paṇ Shrī Puruṣhottam Bhagwānnā Akṣhardhāmne to e pāmatā ja nathī. Te shā sāru? To temanī samajaṇmā bhūl chhe.” Tyāre sarve muni bolyā je, “He Mahārāj! Emane viṣhe shī jātnī bhūl chhe te kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Lyo, emanī bhūl kahīe te sāmbhaḷo je, ek to potānī mukti thavī tene viṣhe potānī kriyānu ja baḷ samaje chhe paṇ Bhagwānnā āsharānu baḷ nathī samajatā; ne bīju, Akṣharrūp thaīne je Shrī Puruṣhottam Nārāyaṇnī sevā karavī te ja mukti chhe em nathī mānatā; e bhūl chhe. Ane trīju, Rām-Kṛuṣhṇādik je Bhagwānnā anant avatār tene to e sarva anshe karīne jāṇe chhe;[22] e ja emane viṣhe moṭī bhūl chhe. Ne chothu em je, ā brahmānḍnī utpatti kem thātī hashe? Ek vār joīe to kharā! Evo sankalp potānā manmā pūrve mṛutyusame rahyo hato, te sankalp joīne Bhagwāne temane brahmānḍnī utpattyādik karmane viṣhe joḍyā chhe. Te jyāre Bhagwānnā ekāntik bhaktanā samāgame karīne samyak prakāre gnānne pāmashe tyāre ja brahmarūp thaīne Bhagwānnā dhāmne pāmashe ne mahāsukhiyā thashe. Māṭe Bhagwānnā je bhakta temane Bhagwānnī sevā vinā bījī ichchhā rākhavī nahī. Ne Bhagwānnā bhakta paṇ traṇ prakārnā chhe te lakṣhaṇe karīne jāṇavā. Temā je Bhagwānne bhajīne vishvanī utpattyādik sāmarthyane ichchhe chhe te bhaktane aishvaryārthī jāṇavo ne kaniṣhṭh jāṇavo. Ne je kevaḷ ātmānā swarūpne jāṇavāne arthe Bhagwānne bhaje tene kaivalyārthī jāṇavo ne te bhaktane madhyam jāṇavo. Ne trījo je pratyakṣh Puruṣhottam Bhagwānnī nirantar ananyapaṇe karīne sevāne viṣhe niṣhṭhā rākhe chhe tene bhagwan-niṣhṭhārthī jāṇavo ne te bhaktane sarva thakī uttam jāṇavo. Māṭe āpaṇ to sarve pragaṭ pramāṇ Shrī Narnārāyaṇ tenī niṣhṭhāvāḷā chhīe, māṭe uttam chhīe; emā kāī sanshay nathī.” Evī rīte Shrījī Mahārājnā vachan sāmbhaḷīne sarva param ānandne pāmatā havā.

1. God is indivisible. Therefore, Ram, Krishna and other avatārs of God are not a part or piece of God. However, the avatārs are either a jiva or ishwar entity that incarnates only when God enters the entity and empowers it to incarnate. To believe the avatārs are a part of God is a grave mistake.
૨૨. ભગવાન નિરંશ અને અચ્યુત હોવાથી રામકૃષ્ણાદિક અવતારો ભગવાનના અંશ (ટુકડો, એક ભાગ) નથી, પરંતુ ભગવાનના અનુપ્રવેશથી અવતારો થાય છે. આવી સાચી સમજણને બદલે અવતારોને ભગવાનના અંશ (ટુકડા) માનવા તે ભૂલ છે.

22. Bhagwān niransh ane achyut hovāthī Rām-kṛuṣhṇādik avatāro Bhagwānnā ansh (ṭukaḍo, ek bhāg) nathī, parantu Bhagwānnā anupraveshthī avatāro thāy chhe. Āvī sāchī samajaṇne badale avatārone Bhagwānnā ansh (ṭukaḍā) mānavā te bhūl chhe.
270: Samvat 1882nā Chaitra sudi 3 Trījne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Jetalpur madhye moholnī jagyāmā āsopālavnī heṭhe ḍholiyo bichhāvyo hato te upar virājmān hatā ane sarva shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe guladāvadīnā bahu hār paheryā hatā ane pāghmā ḍolariyānā torā zūkī rahyā hatā ane be kān upar karṇikārnā be puṣhpa khosyā hatā ane hastakamaḷne viṣhe sundar līmbunā faḷne feravatā hatā ne dahāḍo chār ghaḍī chaḍhyo hato ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ sant tathā desh-deshnā satsangī bāī-bhāī sarvenī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj sarve sabhā pratye prashna pūchhatā havā je, “Ā lokne viṣhe sarve vādnā karanārā chhe temanā be mat chhe. Temā ek to dvait mat chhe ne ek advait mat chhe.[23] Temāthī mumukṣhu hoy te kiyā matne grahaṇ kare? Te kaho.” Tyāre Puruṣhottam Bhaṭṭa bolyā je, “He Mahārāj! Advait matmā to potānā ātmāne ja Bhagwān jāṇī game tevu ācharaṇ kare tethī mokṣhnā mārgmāthī paḍī jāy; māṭe je mumukṣhu hoy te to dvait matne grahaṇ kare.” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāje āshankā karī je, “Dvait matne viṣhe to jīv, īshvar ne māyā e satya chhe. Te jyāre māyā rahe tyāre jīvno mokṣh kem thāy?” Tyāre Puruṣhottam Bhaṭṭa bolyā je, “Shubh karma karatā thakā mokṣh thāy.” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāje vaḷī āshankā karī je, “Nivṛutti ne pravṛutti e be prakārnā je karma chhe te to suṣhuptirūp māyāmā līn thaī jāy chhe. Te suṣhupti to kevī chhe? To jem Lokālok Parvat ullanghavā koī samarth nathī, tem suṣhuptine ullanghavāne jīv koī samarth thāto nathī. To tethī par sāmyāvasthārūp māyā chhe; te to bahu moṭī chhe, te to koī jīvthī na ullanghāy. Tyāre te māyā taravāno upāy e chhe je, jyāre sarva karma ane māyā teno nāsh karanārā ne māyāthī par je sākṣhātkār Shrī Puruṣhottam Bhagwān athavā te Bhagwānnā maḷel sant temanī jīvne prāpti jyāre thāy chhe tyāre temanā āshraythī māyā ullanghāy chhe.” Em kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj mohol upar bhojan karavā padhāryā.

Pachhī bhojan karīne pāchhā āsopālav heṭhe ḍholiyā upar virājmān thayā ane sarva santne ane haribhaktane amṛut-draṣhṭie jotā thakā Shrījī Mahārāj em bolyā je, “Pratham to ā jīvne koī na mānato hoy tyāre enī vṛutti kevī hoy! Ane pachhī jyāre so manuṣhya ene māne tyāre eno ahankār te paṇ nokhī jātno thāy chhe ane hajār manuṣhya māne tathā lākh manuṣhya māne tathā karoḍ manuṣhya māne tyāre eno ahankār te judī jātno thāy chhe. Ane kyārek Brahmā jevo thāy, kyārek Shiv jevo thāy, kyārek Indra jevo thāy, tyāre te savaḷā vichārvāḷo em jāṇe je, ‘Ā mārī moṭyap chhe te ā vaḍe nathī.’ Tyāre shā vaḍe chhe? To ātmā vaḍe moṭap chhe. Ane bīju, santne samāgame karīne moṭap chhe; kem je, Brahmādik jevā moṭā chhe te paṇ santnā charaṇnī rajne ichchhe chhe. Tyāre santne viṣhe shī moṭap chhe? Te kahīe chhīe je, dravya, padārthe karīne ke rājye karīne to kāī santne moṭap nathī paṇ santne to moṭap Bhagwānnī upāsanā ne bhakti te vaḍe chhe. Ne bīju, santne ātmaniṣhṭhā chhe te moṭape moṭap chhe. Ane em na jaṇāy to ātmāno em nishchay karavo je, pragaṭ Bhagwān jene maḷyā hoy evā je sant tene viṣhe ātmabuddhi rākhavī ne tene ja potānu swarūp mānavu. Tyāre koīk āshankā kare je, swāmī-sevakpaṇu kem rahe? To tyā draṣhṭānt chhe je, Gālav Rājā hatā tene yagna karavo hato, tyāre tene shyāmkarṇa ghoḍā lāvavā hatā. Te shyāmkarṇa ghoḍā to Varuṇne gher hatā, tyā to potāthī javāya nahī. Tyāre te Gālav Rājāe Garuḍjīne teḍāvyā ne Garuḍ upar besīne ghoḍā tyāthī laī āvyā.[15] Tyāre shu Garuḍjīne viṣhethī Gālav Rājāne dāspaṇu maṭī gayu? E to na maṭyu, tem brahmavettāne viṣhe ātmabuddhi[16] mānavī, te shā sāru je, ene āvaraṇ bhedyānī gati chhe, te sāru ene viṣhe ātmabuddhi rākhavī.” Pachhī em kahyu je, “Ā vārtā sarve rākhajo ne ā vāt sarvenu jīvan chhe!”

1. Philosophical traditions (sampradāys) are broadly categorized into two groups:
Advait: Doctrines believing in only one eternal entity.
Dvait: Doctrines believing in more than one eternal entity.
Explanation: In the Vedantic philosophical tradition, various āchāryas established their own doctrines. Within the Vedānta Darshan, the following āchāryas propagated their respective doctrines:
1. Shri Shankarāchārya: Advait
2. Shri Rāmānujāchārya: Vishishtādvait
3. Shri Madhvāchārya: Dvait
4. Shri Nimbārkāchārya: Dvaitādvait
5. Shri Vallabhāchārya: Shuddhādvait
6. Shri Chaitanya Mahāprabhu: Achintya Bhedābhed
Keeping all of these in mind, Shriji Maharaj explains two types of doctrines in this Vachanamrut. The first is Shri Shankarāchārya’s Advait doctrine, which posits that only Brahman is the true, eternal entity and that everything else—including the jivas and the world—is illusory (mithya).
The second is referred to as the ‘Dvait’ doctrine. Strictly speaking, the specific Dvait doctrine belongs to Shri Madhvāchārya. However, in this context, Shriji Maharaj uses the term ‘Dvait’ as an umbrella term encompassing all the Vaishnav sampradāys established by Shri Rāmānujāchārya, Shri Madhvāchārya, Shri Nimbārkāchārya, Shri Vallabhāchārya, and Shri Chaitanya Mahāprabhu.
Shriji Maharaj applies the term ‘Dvait’ to any sampradāy that understands entities like jiva and māyā to be distinct from Parabrahman and eternally real. In this sense, Maharaj also accepts the Dvait doctrine, as he, like the Vaishnav āchāryas, explains that jiva, māyā, etc., are distinct from Parabrahman and real. However, while the other āchāryas primarily accept three entities—jiva, māyā, and Ishwar (i.e. God, not the ishwar entity)—Shriji Maharaj accepts five distinct and eternal entities: jiva, ishwar, māyā, Brahman, and Parabrahman. (Vachanamrut Gadhada I-7; Gadhada III-10)

૨૩. સંપ્રદાયોનો વિભાગ બે વર્ગમાં કરવામાં આવેલો છે:
૧. અદ્વૈત એટલે કેવળ એક તત્ત્વમાં માનનાર સંપ્રદાય અને
૨. દ્વૈત એટલે અનેક તત્ત્વમાં માનનાર સંપ્રદાય.
સમજૂતી: ભારતીય દર્શન પરંપરામાં જુદા જુદા આચાર્યોએ પોતપોતાના મતનું સ્થાપન કર્યું છે. આ પૈકી વેદાંત દર્શનમાં:
૧. શ્રીશંકરાચાર્યે અદ્વૈત મત,
૨. શ્રીરામાનુજાચાર્યે વિશિષ્ટાદ્વૈત મત,
૩. શ્રીમધ્વાચાર્યો દ્વૈત મત,
૪. શ્રીનિમ્બાર્કાચાર્યે દ્વૈતાદ્વૈત મત,
૫. શ્રીવલ્લભાચાર્યે શુદ્ધાદ્વૈત મત,
૬. શ્રીચૈતન્ય મહાપ્રભુએ અચિન્ત્ય ભેદાભેદ મત
વગેરે જુદા-જુદા મતનું પ્રવર્તન કર્યું.
શ્રીજીમહારાજ ઉપરોક્ત સર્વે મતને ધ્યાનમાં રાખીને આ વચનામૃતમાં બે પ્રકારના મતની વાત સમજાવે છે. એ પૈકી પ્રથમ પ્રકારનો મત શ્રીશંકરાચાર્યનો અદ્વૈત મત છે, જેમાં એકમાત્ર બ્રહ્મ જ સત્ય તત્ત્વ છે અને એ સિવાય જીવ-જગત બધું જ મિથ્યા છે. બીજા પ્રકારનો મત ‘દ્વૈત મત’ તરીકે જણાવે છે. વસ્તુતઃ તો દ્વૈત મત શ્રીમધ્વાચાર્યનો છે, પરંતુ અહીં પ્રયોજાયેલો ‘દ્વૈત’ શબ્દ કેવળ શ્રીમધ્વાચાર્યના દ્વૈત મત પરક નથી, પરંતુ શ્રીરામાનુજાચાર્ય, શ્રીમધ્વાચાર્ય, શ્રીનિમ્બાર્કાચાર્ય, શ્રીવલ્લભાચાર્ય, શ્રીચૈતન્ય મહાપ્રભુ વગેરે વૈષ્ણવ સંપ્રદાય પરક છે.
જે જે સંપ્રદાયમાં જીવ, માયા વગેરે પરબ્રહ્મથી જુદા અને સત્ય સમજવામાં આવ્યા છે, તેના માટે મહારાજે ‘દ્વૈત’ શબ્દ પ્રયોજ્યો છે. શ્રીજીમહારાજ પણ આ અર્થ પ્રમાણે દ્વૈતમતનો સ્વીકાર કરે છે, કારણ કે તેઓ પણ વૈષ્ણવ આચાર્યોની જેમ જીવ, માયા વગેરેને પરબ્રહ્મથી ભિન્ન અને સત્ય સમજાવે છે. જોકે અન્ય આચાર્ય મુખ્યત્વે જીવ, માયા અને ઈશ્વર આ ત્રણ તત્ત્વોનો સ્વીકાર કરે છે, જ્યારે શ્રીજીમહારાજ જીવ, ઈશ્વર, માયા, બ્રહ્મ અને પરબ્રહ્મ આ પાંચ નિત્ય તત્ત્વોનો સ્વીકાર કરે છે. (વચનામૃત ગઢડા પ્રથમ ૭; ગઢડા અંત્ય ૧૦)

23. Sampradāyono vibhāg be vargmā karavāmā āvelo chhe:
1. Advait eṭale kevaḷ ek tattvamā mānnār sampradāy ane
2. Dvait eṭale anek tattvamā mānnār sampradāy.
Samjūtī: Bhāratīy darshan paramparāmā judā judā āchāryoe potpotānā matnu sthāpan karyu chhe. Ā paikī Vedānta Darshanmā,
1. Shrī Shankarāchārye Advait Mat,
2. Shrī Rāmānujāchārye Vishiṣhṭādvait Mat,
3. Shrī Madhvāchāryo Dvait Mat,
4. Shrī Nimbārkāchārye Dvaitādvait Mat,
5. Shrī Vallabhāchārye Shuddhādvait Mat,
6. Shrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhue Achintya Bhedābhed Mat
vagere judā-judā matnu pravartan karyu.
Shrījī Mahārāj uparokta sarve matne dhyānmā rākhīne ā Vachanāmṛutmā be prakārnā matnī vāt samajāve chhe. E paikī pratham prakārno mat Shrī Shankarāchāryano Advait Mat chhe, jemā ek-mātra Brahma ja satya tattva chhe ane e sivāy jīv-jagat badhu ja mithyā chhe. Bījā prakārno mat ‘Dvait Mat’ tarīke jaṇāve chhe. Vastutah to Dvait Mat Shrī Madhvāchāryano chhe, parantu ahī prayojāyelo ‘Dvait’ shabda kevaḷ Shrī Madhvāchāryanā Dvait Mat parak nathī, parantu Shrī Rāmānujāchārya, Shrī Madhvāchārya, Shrī Nimbārkāchārya, Shrī Vallabhāchārya, Shrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu vagere Vaiṣhṇav sampradāy parak chhe.
Je je sampradāymā jīv, māyā vagere Parabrahmathī judā ane satya samajavāmā āvyā chhe, tenā māṭe Mahārāje ‘Dvait’ shabda prayojyo chhe. Shrījī Mahārāj paṇ ā arth pramāṇe Dvait-Matno svīkār kare chhe, kāraṇ ke teo paṇ Vaiṣhṇav āchāryonī jem jīv, māyā vagerene Parabrahmathī bhinna ane satya samajāve chhe. Joke anya āchārya mukhyatve jīv, māyā ane īshvar ā traṇ tattvono svīkār kare chhe, jyāre Shrījī Mahārāj jīv, īshvara, māyā, Brahma ane Parabrahma ā pānch nitya tattvono svīkār kare chhe. (Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Pratham 7; Gaḍhaḍā Antya 10)
