271: Samvat 1882nā Chaitra sudi 4 Chaturthīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Jetalpur madhye sandhyā samaye Shrī Baldevjīnā Mandirnā chok vachche ḍholiyo bichhāvyo hato te upar virājmān hatā ne sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne pāghne viṣhe ḍolariyānā puṣhpanā torā virājmān hatā ne ḍābā hāthne viṣhe rūmāl dharī rahyā hatā ne jamaṇā hāthmā Tulsīnī māḷāne feravatā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj pratye Brahmānand Swāmīe namaskār karīne prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Yati te kone kahīe te kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jene draḍh brahmacharya hoy ne sarva indriyo potāne vash hoy tene yati jāṇavo. Te je Hanumānjī tathā Lakṣhmaṇjī jevo hoy tene yati jāṇavo. Te Hanumānjī jyāre Rāmchandrajīnī āgnāne karīne Sītājīne khoḷavā sāru Lankāmā gayā, tyāre Jānakījīne oḷakhavā hatā te sāru jeṭalī strīo Lankāmā hatī te sarvane jotā havā. Te jotā jotā, ‘Ā to Jānakījī nahī, ā to Jānakījī nahī,’ em vichāratā satā Mandodarīne Hanumānjī dekhatā havā. Tyāre pote em jāṇyu je, ‘Ā Jānakījī hashe?’ Pachhī em manmā vichār karyo je, ‘Jānakījīne to Bhagwān Raghunāthjīno viyog chhe teṇe karīne āvu sharīr puṣhṭ hoy ja nahī ne āvī nidrā paṇ na hoy.’ Evo manmā vichār karīne Hanumānjī pāchhā vaḷī nīsaryā. Pachhī potāne manmā evo sankalp thayo je, ‘Hu yati chhu ne me ā sarve strīone joīyo teno mune kāī bādh hashe ke nahī?’ Pachhī vaḷī pote em vichār karyo je, ‘Me to Raghunāthjīnī āgnāe karīne Jānakījīnī khabar kāḍhavī chhe te sāru strīone joīyo. Teno mune sho bādh chhe?’ Ne vaḷī manmā em vichār karyo je, ‘Mārī vṛuttimā ne mārī indriyomā Raghunāthjīnī kṛupāe karīne kṣhobh paṇ nathī ūpajyo.’ Em vichārīne nihsanshay thakā farīne Sītājīne khoḷatā havā.[17] Māṭe Hanumānjīnī peṭhe vikārno hetu sate paṇ jenu antahkaraṇ nirvikār rahe evo je hoy te yati kahevāy. Ane vaḷī jyāre Jānakījīnu haraṇ thayu tyāre Raghunāthjī ne Lakṣhmaṇjī e bey vanmā Sītājīne khoḷatā khoḷatā jyā Sugrīv faṭakshīlā upar hato tyā gayā. Tyāre Sugrīvne jaṇāvyu je, ‘Jānakījīnu haraṇ thayu chhe, te māṭe āhī āvyā chhīe. Te jo tamane kāī khabar hoy to kaho.’ Tyāre Sugrīve kahyu je, ‘He Mahārāj! Ākāshne viṣhe, He Rām! He Rām! Evo shabda thato hato je me sāmbhaḷyo hato. Ane bīju je, ā chīrmā bāndhīne ghareṇā paḍatā mūkyā hatā te mārī pāse me rākhyā chhe.’ Tyāre Raghunāthjīe kahyu je, ‘Lāvo, te joīe.’ Tyāre te ghareṇā Sugrīve Raghunāthjīne āpyā. Pachhī Raghunāthjīe laīne Lakṣhmaṇjīne dekhāḍyā. Te pratham to kānnā dekhāḍyā. Pachhī hāthnā bājubandh ādik dekhāḍyā. Te Lakṣhmaṇjīe na oḷakhyā. Tyār pachhī pagnā zānzar dekhāḍyā tyāre Lakṣhmaṇjīe kahyu je, ‘He Mahārāj! Ā to Jānakījīnā zānzar chhe.’ Tyāre Raghunāthjīe pūchhyu je, ‘He Lakṣhmaṇjī! Bījā gharenā na oḷakhyā ne pagnā zānzar kem oḷakhyā?’ Tyāre Lakṣhmaṇjīe kahyu, ‘He Mahārāj! Jānakījīnu swarūp te me nathī dīṭhu ane me charaṇārvind vinā bīju Sītājīnu koī ang dekhyu nathī. Ane sānje page lāgavā jato tyāre zānzar dīṭhā hatā, māṭe me zānzar oḷakhyā.’[18] Evī rīte chaud varṣh sudhī sevāmā rahyā paṇ draṣhṭie karīne Jānakījīnu swarūp ek charaṇārvind vinā bīju dīṭhu nahī; māṭe evo hoy te yati jāṇavo.” Em kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Ā Brahmānand Swāmī chhe te paṇ te jevā ja chhe.” Em sarve sabhāne sāmbhaḷate sate Brahmānand Swāmīnī Shrījī Mahārāje yatipaṇānī bahu prashansā karīne gām bahār padhāryā ne yagna thayā hatā te ṭhekāṇe parathār upar ḍholiyo bichhāvyo hato te upar pote virājmān thayā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāje kahyu je, “Kāī prashna-uttar karo.” Tyāre Paṭel Āshjībhāīe prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Ā jīvnu swarūp kevu chhe te mane yathārth kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Jīv to achhedya, abhedya, avināshī, chaitanyarūp, aṇumātra evo chhe. Tyāre tame kahesho je, te jīv kyā rahe chhe? To hṛudākāshne viṣhe rahe chhe ane tyā rahyo thako vividh kriyāne kare chhe. Ane temā jyāre rūp jovu hoy tyāre netra dvāre karīne jue chhe; ane shabda sāmbhaḷavo hoy tyāre kān dvāre āvīne sāmbhaḷe chhe; ne nāsikā dvāre sāro-naraso gandh le chhe; ne rasnā dvāre ras le chhe; ne tvachā dvāre sparshnu sukh le chhe; ne man dvāre manan kare chhe; chitta dvāre chintvan kare chhe; buddhi dvāre nishchay kare chhe; em das indriyo dvāre tathā chār antahkaraṇ dvāre sarve viṣhaynu grahaṇ kare chhe. Ne nakhthī shikhā paryant sharīrmā vyāpīne rahyo chhe ne ethī nokho paṇ chhe. Evī rīte jīvnu swarūp chhe. Tene bhaktajan je te pragaṭ pramāṇ Puruṣhottam evā je Shrī Narnārāyaṇ tenā pratāpe karīne yathārth dekhe chhe ne bījāne to e jīvnu swarūp jāṇyāmā paṇ āvatu nathī.” Em prashnano uttar karīne sarvane rājī karīne ‘Jay Sachchidānand’ kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj moholmā poḍhavā padhāratā havā.
272: Samvat 1882nā Chaitra sudi 5 Panchamīne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Jetalpur madhye potāne rahevāno je mohol tenī āthamṇī kore samīpe je fūlvāḍī tene viṣhe prātahkāḷe padhāryā hatā ne te vāḍīne madhye moṭu borsallīnu vṛukṣh tenī heṭhe vedikā upar gādītakiye sahit je ḍholiyo te upar ugamṇe mukhārvinde virājmān hatā ne sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ne kanṭhne viṣhe champānā tathā borsallīnā tathā guladāvadīnā hār paheryā hatā ne pāghne viṣhe chamelī ne ḍolariyānā torā laṭakatā melyā hatā ne shravaṇ upar hajārī puṣhpanā guchchha khosyā hatā ne be hastakamalne viṣhe dāḍam tathā līmbunā faḷne feravatā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ Muktānand Swāmī tathā Brahmānand Swāmī ādik muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj ghaḍīk sudhī vichārīne em bolyā je, “Sarve sānbhaḷo, ek vārtā karīe chhīe je, Bhagwānnā bhaktane duṣhṭ vāsanā rākhavī tethī bīju kāī bhūnḍu nathī; kā je, duṣhṭ vāsanāvāḷā bhakta chhe te amāre samīpe rahe chhe to paṇ te sukhiyā nathī rahetā. Kem je, temaṇe Prabhu bhajatā pratham em māgyu hatu je, ‘He Mahārāj! Tamārī samīpe rākhajo.’ Paṇ duṣhṭ vāsanā ṭāḷī nahī te sāru dukhiyā chhe.”

Tyāre Muktānand Swāmīe kahyu je, “He Mahārāj! E duṣhṭ vāsanā kem ṭaḷe?” Tyāre Shrījī Mahārāj bolyā je, “Duṣhṭ vāsanā ṭāḷavāno to e upāy chhe je, jyāre ame bāndhī evī je dharma-maryādā tethī bahār sankalp thāy tathā koī harijannā tathā santnā abhāvno sankalp thāy tyāre ‘Narnārāyaṇ, Swāminārāyaṇ’ em vāramvār ūche sware karīne uchchāraṇ karavu, ane bīju, māhātmye sahit ne dharme sahit Bhagwānnī nav prakārnī bhakti kare, tyāre Bhagwān tenā hṛudāmā nivās karīne durvāsanāne nāsh pamāḍe chhe; jem gajne grāhnā mukh thakī Bhagwāne chhoḍāvyo. E prakāre duṣhṭ vāsanā ṭāḷavāno upāy kahyo. Ne vaḷī tamārā sarvenā hitne kare evo bījo upāy kahu chhu tene tame sāmbhaḷo je, panch vartamān sambandhī je potānī dharma-maryādā tenu jāṇīne to kyārey ullanghan karavu nahī ane jo ajāṇe tenu ullanghan thāy to tenu tatkāḷ prāyashchitta karavu, ne potānu swarūp sākṣhī mānavu je, ‘Sankalp tathā nānā prakārnā tark te thakī par je chaitanyarūp ātmā te hu chhu ne mane sahit je deh te hu nahī,’ em vichāre. Ne Bhagwān koīnā sāmu joīne hasatā hoy vā koīne bolāvatā hoy vā bījā game tevā charitra kare temā koī dahāḍe abhāv na levo. Evī rītnī samajaṇ rākhavī.

“Ane vaḷī koīk em jāṇe chhe je, ‘Me to Mahārājne bahu bhajyā ne ghaṇīk sevā karī paṇ āpaṇne to Mahārāj bolāvatā nathī ne bījāne to bahu bolāve chhe; tyāre āpaṇe gher beṭhā ja Prabhu bhajashu.’ Em avaguṇ le chhe. Tyāre ame paṇ em dhārīe je, e jīvne ne amāre shu? To e jīvnu kāī ṭhekāṇu rahe nahī. Paṇ ame to koīno avaguṇ letā ja nathī ane amāro swabhāv te to sadā guṇ-grāhak ja chhe. Ne have e bhaktane guṇ grahaṇ karavo ne avaguṇ ṭāḷavo teno upāy kahīe chhīe je, e bhakta em vichāre je, ‘Hu satsang mor kevo hato? To kāḷ, karma, janma, maraṇ, chorāsī teno bhoktā hato. Te mane sarve thakī chhoḍāvīne nirbhay kīdho ne rūḍā guṇ āpīne moṭo kīdho. Te Bhagwānno abhāv hu kem lau ne Prabhunu gamatu mūkīne potānu gamatu kem karu?’ Em vichārīne abhāv na le tyāre ja te sukhiyo thāy chhe. Ane je ā dehe karīne Bhagwānnu gamatu karavu ethī bījī vāt koī moṭī nathī. Ne e ja bhakti chhe ne eṇe karīne ja Bhagwānne pamāya chhe. Māṭe mān, īrṣhyā tathā kām, krodh, lobh e ādik kalyāṇnā virodhī chhe; te sarvane tyāg karavā. Ne temā mān chhe te to ati bhūnḍāmā bhūnḍu chhe. Te juo ne, bījā vartamānmā kāī kāchyap thoḍī-ghaṇī hoy to paṇ satsangmā nabhyo jāy chhe paṇ mānvāḷā to nabhī shakyā ja nahī. Māṭe he santo! Nirmān ādik vartamānmā koī divas chūk paḍavā desho nahī, ati kushaḷ rahevu ane deh thakī potānu swarūp judu jāṇavu ane Shrī Puruṣhottam evā je Shrī Narnārāyaṇ temanī nirantar khaṭake sahit bhakti karavī. Ne Bhagwānnī akhanḍ smṛutie sahit bhajan karavu te to Bhagwānnā pragaṭ darshannā sukh tulya chhe. Bīju, āpaṇā satsangmā shāstra bhaṇatā āvaḍe teṇe karīne kāī moṭo nahī. Tyāre koṇ moṭo? To chaud lok paryant tṛuṇ samān jāṇe evā vairāgyanī avadhie yukta hoy; ane jem dehne viṣhe ātmabuddhi chhe tem Paramātmā je Puruṣhottam tenā swarūpnī draḍhatā sākṣhātkār bodhe yukta hoy; ne suṣhuptine viṣhe jem jagatnī vismṛuti chhe tem jāgrat avasthāne viṣhe jagatnī vismṛutie yukta varte; evo je hoy te āpaṇā satsangmā moṭero chhe.”
273: Samvat 1882nā Chaitra sudi 6 Chhaṭhane divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Jetalpur madhye moholne viṣhe dakṣhiṇādā gokhne viṣhe gādī-takiyānu uṭhingaṇ deīne virājmān hatā ne mastakne upar puṣhpano khūmp teṇe yukta shvet pāgh shobhatī hatī ne shvet puṣhpanī pachheḍī oḍhī hatī ne kesar-chandane karīne sarva ang charachyā hatā ne shvet hīrkorī khes paheryo hato ne kanṭhne viṣhe guladāvadīnā hār paheryā hatā ne potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj sarva sabhā pratye bolyā je, “Ā lokne viṣhe jīvnu kalyāṇ to eṭalā vaḍe ja chhe je, pratyakṣh Bhagwānno nishchay ne temanā darshan ne temanī akhanḍ smṛuti teṇe karīne thāy chhe. Kā je, Bhāgwatmā em kahyu chhe je, Kans, Shishupāl, Dantavaktra, ādik je nindānā karanārā tene Bhagwānnī akhanḍ smṛuti rahī teṇe karīne temanu kalyāṇ thayu chhe. Māṭe Bhagwānnī nirantar je smṛuti teṇe karīne kalyāṇ thāy chhe. Evī je smṛuti te tamāre sarvane chhe, māṭe tamāru kalyāṇ thaī ja rahyu chhe. To paṇ mārī bāndhelī je dharma-maryādā tene jyā sudhī dehnī smṛuti rahe tyā sudhī tamāre sarva prakāre pāḷavī. Tyāre tame kahesho je, ‘Bhagwān to maḷyā chhe ne tenī smṛuti paṇ nirantar rahe chhe, tene vartamān pāḷyānu shu prayojan chhe?’ To tenu to em chhe je, ek to vartamān draḍh rākhe chhe ne ek to vartamānmā kasarvāḷo chhe, te bemā fer keṭalo chhe te kahīe chhīe je, smṛuti to beyne chhe, paṇ je niyam-dharmarahit chhe te to potānu ja kalyāṇ kare chhe paṇ enāthī bījā jīvnu kalyāṇ thāy nahī ne te ekāntik bhakta paṇ na thāy ne te Bhagwānnā nirguṇdhāmane paṇ na pāme ne janma-maraṇthī rahit to thāy ne tethī satsangmā paṇ na besāy.[24] Ane tame to sarva uttam bhakta chho, te dharma-niyamyukta evā je tam jevā sādhu tenī to vāt ja nokhī chhe. Te hetu māṭe tamane je koī bhāve karīne jamāḍshe tene koṭi yagnanu puṇya thashe ne te ante mokṣhne pāmashe; ane tamārā charaṇno je koī sparsh karashe tenā koṭi janmanā pāp nāsh pāmashe; ne tamane bhāve karīne vastra oḍhāḍshe tenu paṇ param kalyāṇ thashe; ne tame je je nadī, taḷāvne viṣhe pag boḷo chho te te sarve tīrthrūp thāy chhe; ane tam je je vṛukṣh taḷe beṭhā ho ne je vṛukṣhnu faḷ jamyā ho te te sarvenu rūḍu ja thāy chhe; ne tamārā koīk bhāve karīne darshan kare chhe, koīk tamane bhāve karīne namaskār kare chhe, tenā sarva pāpno kṣhay thāy chhe; ne vaḷī tame jene Bhagwānnī vāt karo chho ane koīkne dharma sambandhī niyam dharāvo chho teno mokṣh thāy chhe; ityādik dharma-niyamvāḷā tam jevā santnī sarva kriyā kalyāṇrūp chhe. Kem je, je pratyakṣh Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Ṛuṣhino tamāre draḍh āsharo chhe ne te Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Ṛuṣhi tamārī sabhāmā nirantar virāje chhe, e bey vātno e uttar chhe.

“Ane vaḷī tame kahesho je, ‘Bhagwānno draḍh āsharo chhe ne māyik guṇ kem vyāpe chhe?’ To te kahīe je, ṣhaḍūrmie rahit ne māyik guṇe rahit sarvane karavā temā to kāī vār nathī. Ane asankhya janmanī smṛuti thaī āve ne anant brahmānḍnī utpattyādik kriyāne kare evā sarvane karavā temā to kāī vār nathī. Paṇ amārī ichchhāe karīne em tamane rākhyā chhe ne tamārā sāmarthyane rūndhī rākhyu chhe, te pratyakṣh Bhagwānnā sukhnī prāptine arthe chhe. Ne Shrī Puruṣhottam te je te āj tamane sarvane Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Ṛuṣhirūp thaīne pragaṭ maḷyā chhe. Māṭe nihsanshay thaīne ānandmā bhajan karajo.” Em kahīne Shrījī Mahārāj maun rahyā.

Te samaye Āshjībhāīe Shrījī Mahārājne prashna pūchhyo je, “He Mahārāj! Vairbhāve karīne je kalyāṇ thāy chhe te kem thāy chhe? Te kaho.” Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj em bolyā je, “Drupad Rājā hato, tene Draupadī je potānī putrī tene paraṇāvavā hatā te sāru swayamvar rachyo hato. Tyā rājāmātrane teḍāvyā hatā ane Droṇāchārya paṇ āvyā hatā ne Pānḍav paṇ āvyā hatā. Pachhī bījā sarve rājāe maḷīne matsya vendhavā mānḍyo, paṇ koīthī matsya na vendhāyo. Tyāre Yudhiṣhṭhire kahyu je, ‘Hu matsya vendhu.’ Em kahīne Yudhiṣhṭhire sūrat bāndhī. Tyāre Droṇāchārye kahyu je, ‘Ā sabhā dekhāy chhe?’ Tyāre kahyu je, ‘Dekhāy chhe.’ Ane vaḷī kahyu je, ‘Tamāru sharīr dekhāy chhe?’ Tyāre kahyu je, ‘Dekhāy chhe.’ Tyāre Droṇāchārye kahyu je, ‘Tamthī matsya nahī vendhāy.’ Evī rīte chār bhāī thakī matsya na vendhāṇo. Tyār pachhī Arjune ūṭhīne dhanuṣhya laīne sūrat bāndhī. Tyāre Droṇāchārye pūchhyu je, ‘Ā sabhāne dekho chho?’ Tyāre Arjune kahyu je, ‘Sabhāne to nathī dekhato ne matsyane paṇ nathī dekhato ane matsya upar je pakṣhī chhe tene dekhu chhu.’ Tyāre Droṇāchārye kahyu je, ‘Enā māthā sāmī sūrat rākho.’ Tyāre Arjune sūrat bāndhīne kahyu je, ‘Pakṣhīne nathī dekhato ne ekalu mastak dekhu chhu.’ Tyāre vaḷī Droṇāchārye kahyu je, ‘Have ghā karo.’ Tyāre Arjun matsyanā mastakne vendhatā havā.[19] Evī rīte jo sarve vṛuttiono ek Bhagwānnā swarūpne viṣhe nirodh thāy tyāre te vairbhāve karīne mukti thāy chhe. Jem Shishupāl tathā Kansa e ādiknī Shrī Kṛuṣhṇanā swarūpne viṣhe tadākār vṛuttio thaī gaī hatī, tyāre kalyāṇ thayu. Evī rītno droh jo na āvaḍe to te drohno karanāro nārakī thāy chhe. Ane te karatā Bhagwānnī bhakti karavī te sulabh chhe. Ane droh-buddhi rākhīne bhaje tenu asur evu nām kyārey maṭe ja nahī ne te bhakta paṇ kahevāy ja nahī. Māṭe asurnī rīt melīne jene Dhruv, Prahlād, Nārad, Sanakādiknī panktimā bhaḷavu hoy tene to bhaktie karīne ja Bhagwānne bhajavā te ati shreṣhṭh chhe.” Evī rīte Shrījī Mahārāje vārtā karī tene sāmbhaḷīne sarve param ānandne pāmatā havā!

1. These words can be understood this way:
(a) Ultimate Liberation Requires Strict Discipline: True faith in God naturally results in strictly following moral and spiritual disciplines (niyam-dharma). Therefore, if someone lapses in their discipline, it shows their faith is incomplete. Because their faith is deficient, they cannot attain ultimate liberation (Akshardham) in this lifetime. (Vachanamrut Gadhada II-13, II-16, II-27, I-63, I-72, Panchal 7, II-14)
(b) Slight Faith Provides a Safety Net: Even if someone fails to follow niyam-dharma, having even a slight amount of faith in God still saves them. While they won’t achieve ultimate liberation right away, this slight faith protects them from suffering in narak and from cycling through the 8.4 million lower lifeforms. Instead, their faith earns them another human birth, giving them a second chance to perfect their discipline and eventually reach Akshardham. (Vachanamrut Sarangpur 4, 11, Gadhada II-16, II-25)
(c) Hypocrisy Prevents Guiding Others: While slight faith might save the individual (as noted in Point 2), a lack of discipline destroys their ability to help others. Devotees who strictly follow niyam-dharma can inspire and guide others toward liberation. However, if someone has faith but fails to practice discipline, their words carry no spiritual weight. They cannot inspire or guide anyone else on the spiritual path. (Vachanamrut Jetalpur 1)
૧૯. અહીં વિજયાર્થીઓની પરીક્ષારૂપ લક્ષ્યવેધ (આદિપર્વ: ૧૨૩/૫૮-૬૬) તથા દ્રોપદી સ્વયંવરરૂપ મત્સ્યવેધ (આદિપર્વ: ૧૭૯/૧૪-૧૬) બંનેની મિશ્ર કથા છે.

૨૪. આ કથનનું તાત્પર્ય નીચે પ્રમાણે સમજી શકાય:
૧. જો પ્રત્યક્ષ ભગવાનનો યથાર્થ નિશ્ચય હોય તો નિયમ-ધર્મની દૃઢતા હોય જ. (વચનામૃત ગઢડા મધ્ય ૧૩, ૧૬, ૨૭) તેથી એવું કહી શકાય કે જે નિયમ-ધર્મથી રહિત છે તેને ભગવાનના નિશ્ચયમાં કંઈક કચાશ છે અને જો નિશ્ચયમાં કચાશ હોય તો તેનું આત્યંતિક કલ્યાણ ન થાય. (વચનામૃત ગઢડા પ્રથમ ૬૩, ૭૨; પંચાળા ૭; મધ્ય ૧૩, ૧૪) એટલે કે તે ભગવાનના નિર્ગુણધામને અર્થાત્ અક્ષરધામને પામી શકતો નથી.
૨. જે નિયમ-ધર્મે રહિત છે પણ તેને ભગવાનનો થોડોક પણ નિશ્ચય હોવાથી, તે પોતાનું કલ્યાણ કરે છે એટલે કે તે જન્મમરણથી રહિત થાય છે અર્થાત્ તેને જમપુરી અને લખચોરાશીનું દુઃખ રહેતું નથી. (વચનામૃત સારંગપુર ૪, ૧૧) તેને નિશ્ચય અને સંસ્કારને બળે ફરી વાર મનુષ્ય જન્મ મળે અને અંતે કસર ટાળીને અક્ષરધામને પામે. (વચનામૃત ગઢડા મધ્ય ૧૬, ૨૫)
૩. નિશ્ચય હોવા છતાં જે નિયમ-ધર્મથી રહિત છે, એનાથી બીજા જીવનું કલ્યાણ થાય નહીં. નિયમધર્મવાળા સંતો-ભક્તો મુમુક્ષુને કંઈક માર્ગદર્શન અને પ્રેરણા આપીને સાધના માર્ગમાં સહાયરૂપ થઈ શકે, પરંતુ જે નિયમધર્મથી રહિત છે તેના ઉપદેશની કોઈ અસર ના થાય. તેથી એના થકી બીજાને અધ્યાત્મમાર્ગમાં વિશેષ વર્તવાની પ્રેરણા ન મળે. તેથી અહીં કહ્યું છે કે એનાથી બીજા જીવનું કલ્યાણ થાય નહીં.
19. Ahī vijayārthīonī parīkṣhārūp lakṣhyavedh (Ādiparva: 123/58-66) tathā Dropadī swayamvarrūp matsyavedh (Ādiparva: 179/14-16) bannenī mishra kathā chhe.

24. Ā kathannu tātparya nīche pramāṇe samajī shakāy:
1. Jo pratyakṣha Bhagwānno yathārth nishchay hoy to niyam-dharmanī dṛuḍhatā hoy ja. (Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 13, 16, 27) Tethī evu kahī shakāy ke je niyam-dharmathī rahit chhe tene Bhagwānnā nishchaymā kaīk kachāsh chhe ane jo nishchaymā kachāsh hoy to tenu ātyantik kalyāṇ na thāy. (Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Pratham 63, 72; Panchāḷā 7; Madhya 13, 14) Eṭale ke te Bhagwānnā nirguṇ-dhāmne arthāt Akṣhardhāmne pāmī shakato nathī.
2. Je niyam-dharme rahit chhe paṇ tene Bhagwānno thoḍok paṇ nishchay hovāthī, te potānu kalyāṇ kare chhe eṭale ke te janma-maraṇthī rahit thāy chhe arthāt tene Jampurī ane lakh-chorāshīnu dukh rahetu nathī. (Vachanāmṛut Sārangpur 4, 11) Tene nishchay ane sanskārne baḷe farī vār manuṣhya janma maḷe ane ante kasar ṭāḷīne Akṣhardhāmne pāme. (Vachanāmṛut Gaḍhaḍā Madhya 16, 25)
3. Nishchay hovā chhatā je niyam-dharmathī rahit chhe, enāthī bījā jīvanu kalyāṇ thāy nahī. Niyam-dharmavāḷā santo-bhakto mumukṣhune kaīk mārg-darshan ane preraṇā āpīne sādhanā mārgmā sahāyarūp thaī shake, parantu je niyam-dharmathī rahit chhe tenā upadeshnī koī asar nā thāy. Tethī enā thakī bījāne adhyātma-mārgmā visheṣh vartavānī preraṇā na maḷe. Tethī ahī kahyu chhe ke enāthī bījā jīvanu kalyāṇ thāy nahī.
274: Samvat 1882nā Chaitra sudi 7 Sātamne divas Swāmī Shrī Sahajānandjī Mahārāj gām Shrī Jetalpur madhye dakṣhiṇādī kore jagyānī māhī chokne viṣhe uttarāde mukhārvinde pāṭ upar virājmān hatā ne sarve shvet vastra dhāraṇ karyā hatā ane mastak upar zīṇ-potī shvet pāgh dharī rahyā hatā ne shvet zīṇī chādar oḍhī hatī ane shvet dhotiyu paheryu hatu ane potānā mukhārvindnī āgaḷ muni tathā desh-deshnā haribhaktanī sabhā bharāīne beṭhī hatī.

Ane rāt doḍh pahor vītī hatī. Pachhī Shrījī Mahārāj ghaḍīk vichārīne bolyā je, “Sarve sāmbhaḷo, āje to amāre jem chhe tem vāt karavī chhe je, Bhagwānne bhajavā ethī bījī vāt moṭī nathī. Kā je, Bhagwānnu karyu sarve thāy chhe. Ane ā same to ā sabhānu karyu paṇ thāy chhe. Ane Shrī Narnārāyaṇne pratāpe karīne amāru karyu paṇ thāy chhe. Te lyo, kahīe je, jevo ame manmā ghāṭ karīe chhīe tevo ā jagatne viṣhe pravarte chhe, ane jem dhārīe chhīe tem paṇ thāy chhe kharu je, āne rāj āvo to tene rāj āve chhe, ane ānu rāj jāo to tenu jāy chhe; ane dhārīe je, ā paḷe āṭalo varsād āhī thāo to te tyā jarūr thāy chhe, ane āhī na thāo to tyā nathī thāto; ane vaḷī dhārīe je, āne dhan prāpt thāo to te thāy chhe, ane āne na thāo to tene thātu ja nathī; ane āne dīkaro āvo to tene dīkaro āve chhe, ane dhārīe je, āne dīkaro na āvo to tene āvato ja nathī; ane āne rog thāo to tene rog paṇ thāy chhe, ane āne rog na thāo to tene rog paṇ nathī thato. Evī rīte ame dhārīe chhīe tem thāy chhe kharu. Tyāre tame kahesho je, ‘Satsangīne sukh-dukh thāy chhe ane rogādik prāpt thāy chhe ane kāīk dhan-samṛuddhinī hāni thāy chhe ane mahenat karīne marī jāy chhe to paṇ e daridrī jevo rahe chhe.’ To enu to em chhe je, ene Bhagwān bhajyāmā jeṭalī kasar chhe teṭalī tene sarva kriyāne viṣhe barakat thatī nathī. Ane Bhagwānne to enu sāru ja karavu chhe je, shūḷīnu dukh hashe te Bhagwān potānā āshrit jannu kāṭe karīne ṭāḷatā hashe. Ane ame to em jāṇīe chhīe je, ‘Satsangīne to ek vīchhīnī pīḍā thatī hoy to amane hajār gaṇī thāo, paṇ te pīḍāthī te haribhakta rahit thāo ane sukhiyā raho,’ em ame Rāmānand Swāmī āgaḷ māgyu chhe. Māṭe amārī to najar evī chhe je, sarvenu sāru thāo. Ane Bhagwānne viṣhe jīvnā mannī vṛuttine rākhavāno upāy nirantar karīe chhīe. Te shā sāru je, hu to bhūt, bhaviṣhya ne vartamān e traṇe kāḷne viṣhe sarva kriyāne jāṇu chhu ane āhī beṭhā satā paṇ sarvene jāṇīe chhīe ane mātānā udarne viṣhe hatā te divase paṇ jāṇatā hatā ane udarne viṣhe nahotā āvyā te divas paṇ jāṇatā hatā; kem je, ame to Bhagwān je Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Ṛuṣhi te chhīe[20]. Ane mahāpāpvāḷo jīv hashe ne amāre āshare āvashe ne dharma-niyammā raheshe tene ame antkāḷe darshan daīne Bhagwānnu je Akṣhardhām tene pamāḍīe chhīe. Ne have te Akṣhardhāmnā pati Shrī Puruṣhottam te je te pratham Dharmadev thakī Mūrti nāme devī, jene Bhakti kahīe, tene viṣhe Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Ṛuṣhirūpe pragaṭ thaīne Badarikāshramne viṣhe tapne karatā havā. Ne te Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Ṛuṣhi ā Kaḷi-Yugne viṣhe pākhanḍī mat tenu khanḍan karavā ane adharmanā vanshno nāsh karavā ane dharmanā vanshne puṣhṭ karavā ne dharma, gnān, vairāgya teṇe sahit je bhakti tene pṛuthvīne viṣhe vistārvā sāru Shrī Dharmadev thakī Bhaktine viṣhe Nārāyaṇmunirūpe pragaṭ thaīne ā sabhāne viṣhe virāje chhe.” Em kahīne potānā janne ati magna karatā havā. Ane vaḷī bolyā je, “Ame vārevāre Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Devnu mukhyapaṇu lāvīe chhīe tenu to e ja hārad chhe je, Shrī Kṛuṣhṇa Puruṣhottam Akṣhardhāmnā Dhāmī[21] je Shrī Narnārāyaṇ te ja ā sabhāmā nitya virāje chhe. Te sāru mukhyapaṇu lāvīe chhīe ane te sāru ame amāru rūp jāṇīne lākho rūpiyānu kharach karīne shikharbandha mandir Shrī Amdāvādmā karāvīne Shrī Narnārāyaṇnī mūrtiyu pratham padharāvī chhe. Ane e Shrī Narnārāyaṇ to anant brahmānḍnā rājā chhe. Ane temā paṇ ā je Bharat-Khanḍ tenā to visheṣhe rājā chhe. Ane pratyakṣh Shrī Narnārāyaṇ tene melīne ane ā Bharat-Khanḍnā manuṣhya bījā devne bhaje chhe, te to jem vyabhichāriṇī strīo hoy te potānā dhaṇīne melīne bījā jārne bhaje tem chhe. Ane Shrī Narnārāyaṇ Bharat-Khanḍnā rājā chhe te Shrīmad Bhāgwatmā kahyu chhe. Ane ame ā sant sahit jīvonā kalyāṇne arthe pragaṭ thayā chhīe. Te māṭe tame jo amāru vachan mānasho to ame je dhāmmāthī āvyā chhīe te dhāmmā tamane sarvene teḍī jāshu. Ane tame paṇ em jāṇajo je, ‘Amāru kalyāṇ thaī chūkyu chhe.’ Ane vaḷī amāro draḍh vishvās rākhasho ne kahīe tem karasho to tamane mahākaṣhṭ koīk āvī paḍashe tethī athavā sāt dakālī jevu paḍashe te thakī rakṣhā karashu ane koī ūgaryāno āro na hoy evu kaṣhṭ āvī paḍashe toy paṇ rakṣhā karashu; jo amārā satsangnā dharma bahu rīte karīne pāḷasho to ne satsang rākhasho to. Ane nahī rākho to mahādukh pāmasho. Temā amāre leṇā-deṇā nathī. Ne ame to ā same koī vātnu kāchu rākhyu nathī. Ne juo ne, ā Jetalpur Gāmmā ame keṭalāk yagna karyā ane keṭalāk varas thayā āhī rahīe chhīe. Ane juo ne, ā taḷāvne viṣhe ame sarve sante sahit hajāro vār nāhyā chhīe. Ane Jetalpur gāmmā ame gher gher so vār faryā chhīe ne gher gher bhojan karyā chhe. Ane ā gāmnī sīm ne gām te Vṛundāvan karatā paṇ visheṣh ramaṇ sthaḷ karyu chhe.” Em vāt Mahārāj kare chhe eṭalāmā to ākāshmā ek moṭo tejno goḷo dekhāṇo ane te ek goḷānā traṇ goḷā thaī gayā ne mohol upar ghaḍīk ākāshmā dekhāīne adrashya thaī gayā. Tyāre sarvee kahyu je, “He Mahārāj! E shu hatu?” Tyāre Mahārāje kahyu je, “Brahmā, Viṣhṇu ne Shiv e traṇ dev nitye ā santnī sabhānā ne amārā darshan karavā āve chhe. Paṇ āj to vimāne sahit Hari-ichchhāe karīne tamane dekhāṇā.”
૨૦. નરનારાયણનો જ મહિમા જાણનાર ગુણભાવી ભક્તોને પણ સમાસ થાય તે હેતુથી શ્રીહરિ અહીં પોતાને નરનારાયણ સ્વરૂપે નિરૂપે છે.
૨૧. નરનારાયણદેવ તો બદરિકાશ્રમમાં તપ કરે છે. તેમની સાથે ‘અક્ષરધામના ધામી’ શબ્દ જોડીને શ્રીહરિ નરનારાયણના મિષે પોતાના સ્વરૂપમાં વૃત્તિ રાખવાનો નિર્દેશ કરે છે.
20. Narnārāyaṇno ja mahimā jāṇnār guṇbhāvī bhaktone paṇ samās thāy te hetuthī Shrī Hari ahī potāne Narnārāyaṇ swarūpe nirūpe chhe.
21. Narnārāyaṇdev to Badarikāshrammā tap kare chhe. Temanī sāthe ‘Akṣhardhāmnā dhāmī’ shabda joḍīne Shrī Hari Narnārāyaṇnā miṣhe potānā swarūpmā vṛutti rākhavāno nirdesh kare chhe.
